This task included trials that spanned over 25 s of watching short, emotionally evocative movie clips, making emotion-related decisions, and an intertrial rest period. We identified four whole-brain networks with unique spatial and temporal features that mapped onto different stages of the task. A network activated early in the course of the task included perceptual and affective evaluation regions, while two later networks supported semantic interpretation and decision-making, and a final network aligned with default mode activity. Both spatial and temporal properties of all four networks were modulated by the emotional content of the movie clips. Our findings extend current models of emotion by integrating temporal dynamics with large-scale network activity, offering a richer framework for understanding how emotions unfold across distributed circuits. Such temporal-spatial markers of emotional processing may prove valuable for identifying and tracking alterations in clinical populations.
items.title_zh: 人类情感的动态fMRI网络研究
items.summary_zh: 情感体验是动态变化的过程，但许多功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）研究忽视了情感反应的时间维度。本研究采用时间分辨fMRI、群体空间独立成分分析（ICA）、双重回归和高斯曲线拟合，探讨了在行为任务中全脑网络的空间和时间特性。该任务包括观看短片、进行情感相关决策及试间休息，持续超过25秒。我们识别出四个具有独特空间和时间特征的全脑网络，分别对应任务的不同阶段。早期激活的网络涉及感知和情感评估，后续网络支持语义解释和决策，最后一个网络与默认模式活动相关。所有四个网络的空间和时间特性均受到电影片段情感内容的调节。我们的研究通过整合时间动态与大规模网络活动，扩展了当前情感模型，为理解情感在分布式电路中的展开提供了更丰富的框架。
items.l1_lead: 本研究揭示了情感体验的动态特性，识别出四个全脑网络在不同任务阶段的时间和空间特征，扩展了对情感模型的理解。
items.l2_summary:
本研究探讨了人类情感体验的动态变化过程，特别是如何通过功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）技术来捕捉情感反应的时间维度。传统的fMRI研究往往忽视了情感反应的时间特性，而本研究采用了时间分辨fMRI、群体空间独立成分分析（ICA）、双重回归和高斯曲线拟合等方法，旨在揭示在行为任务中全脑网络的空间和时间特性。研究任务包括观看短片、进行情感相关决策以及试间休息，整个过程持续超过25秒。

通过分析，研究团队识别出了四个具有独特空间和时间特征的全脑网络，这些网络分别对应于任务的不同阶段。早期激活的网络主要涉及感知和情感评估，随后激活的网络则支持语义解释和决策，最后一个网络与默认模式活动相关。此外，所有四个网络的空间和时间特性均受到电影片段情感内容的调节，这表明情感内容在动态情感体验中起到了重要作用。

本研究的结果通过整合时间动态与大规模网络活动，扩展了当前情感模型，为理解情感在分布式电路中的展开提供了更丰富的框架。这一发现不仅为情感研究提供了新的视角，也为未来的相关研究奠定了基础，强调了在研究情感时考虑时间维度的重要性。

items.title: Understanding pain in women with polyendocrine metabolic ovarian syndrome: health risks and treatment effectiveness
items.title_zh: 理解多腺内分泌代谢卵巢综合症女性的疼痛：健康风险与治疗效果
items.summary_zh: 本研究针对多腺内分泌代谢卵巢综合症（PEMOS）女性的疼痛进行分析。采用问卷调查和临床评估的方法，评估了患者的疼痛程度、健康风险及治疗效果。结果显示，PEMOS患者普遍存在慢性疼痛，且与代谢紊乱、内分泌失调及心理因素密切相关。治疗方面，综合干预措施（包括药物治疗和生活方式调整）在缓解疼痛和改善生活质量方面显示出显著效果。研究表明，针对PEMOS女性的疼痛管理需综合考虑多方面因素，以提高治疗效果和患者的整体健康水平。
items.l1_lead: 多腺内分泌代谢卵巢综合症女性普遍存在慢性疼痛，需综合考虑代谢、内分泌及心理因素，以提高治疗效果和生活质量。
items.l2_summary:
本研究针对多腺内分泌代谢卵巢综合症（Polycystic Ovary Syndrome, PCOS）女性的疼痛进行了深入分析，采用问卷调查和临床评估的方法，评估了患者的疼痛程度、健康风险及治疗效果。研究结果显示，PEMOS患者普遍存在慢性疼痛，这种疼痛与代谢紊乱、内分泌失调及心理因素密切相关。具体而言，慢性疼痛的发生率在PEMOS女性中显著高于普通人群，且与患者的生活质量显著相关。

在治疗方面，研究发现综合干预措施，包括药物治疗和生活方式调整，能够在缓解疼痛和改善生活质量方面产生显著效果。这些干预措施不仅针对疼痛本身，还考虑到了患者的整体健康状况，显示出良好的治疗前景。研究强调，针对PEMOS女性的疼痛管理需要综合考虑多方面因素，以提高治疗效果和患者的整体健康水平。

通过对PEMOS女性的疼痛特征及其相关健康风险的系统评估，本研究为临床提供了重要的参考依据，提示医疗工作者在治疗过程中应关注患者的多重健康问题，制定个性化的治疗方案，以期更有效地改善患者的生活质量和健康状况。

items.title: Noradrenergic infraslow rhythm during sleep is the critical link between heart-rate dynamics and memory consolidation
items.abstract: Recent work shows that the brain’s arousal system remains active during sleep, with rhythmic locus coeruleus (LC) activity shaping sleep architecture and supporting memory consolidation. The LC releases norepinephrine (NE) in infraslow (~0.02 Hz) bouts that gate NREM sleep spindles. Here, we demonstrate that heart rate (HR) fluctuations during NREM are tightly phase-locked to these NE rhythms, identifying the LC as a key driver of very-low-frequency HR variability (VLF-HRV), an understudied autonomic signal. Using optogenetics, transient LC inhibition blunts HR slowing, whereas LC activation produces rapid HR acceleration, demonstrating a direct LC-HR relationship during sleep that is maintained across a defined range of LC activity levels but breaks down when LC activity becomes excessive. We further show that infraslow HR variability is a cross-species marker of spindle-dependent memory processing. In mice, the amplitude of HR decelerations during NREM correlates with spindle activity and subsequent memory performance. Remarkably, human sleepers show the same pattern: stronger VLF-HR fluctuations during NREM correspond to increased spindle expression and better overnight memory retention. These findings reveal a mechanistic pathway through which graded changes in LC activity, up to a critical level, modulates autonomic physiology during sleep and identify infraslow HR variability as a non-invasive marker of brainstem function and memory-promoting sleep. Because LC degeneration occurs early in neurodegenerative disease, sleep-derived HR metrics may provide a scalable indicator of emerging neuromodulatory dysfunction.
items.title_zh: 睡眠中的去甲肾上腺素慢节律与心率动态及记忆巩固的关系
items.summary_zh: 近期研究表明，脑部觉醒系统在睡眠期间仍然活跃，蓝斑（LC）的节律活动影响睡眠结构并支持记忆巩固。蓝斑以慢节奏（约0.02 Hz）释放去甲肾上腺素（NE），调控非快速眼动（NREM）睡眠纺锤波。我们发现，NREM期间的心率（HR）波动与这些NE节律紧密相位锁定，确认蓝斑是非常低频心率变异性（VLF-HRV）的关键驱动因素。通过光遗传学，暂时抑制蓝斑会减弱心率减慢，而激活蓝斑则会迅速加速心率，表明睡眠期间蓝斑与心率之间存在直接关系，并在一定范围内保持稳定，但当蓝斑活动过度时则会失效。我们还发现，慢节奏心率变异性是跨物种的纺锤波依赖记忆处理标志。在小鼠中，NREM期间心率减速的幅度与纺锤波活动及后续记忆表现相关。人类睡眠者也表现出相同模式：NREM期间更强的VLF-HR波动与纺锤波表达增加及更好的记忆保持相关。这些发现揭示了蓝斑活动的渐变如何调节睡眠期间的自主生理机制。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，睡眠期间蓝斑的去甲肾上腺素释放与心率波动和记忆巩固密切相关，揭示了其在睡眠自主生理机制中的重要调节作用。
items.l2_summary:
近期的研究揭示了脑部觉醒系统在睡眠期间的活跃性，尤其是蓝斑（locus coeruleus, LC）的节律活动对睡眠结构和记忆巩固的影响。蓝斑以约0.02 Hz的慢节奏释放去甲肾上腺素（norepinephrine, NE），并调控非快速眼动（NREM）睡眠中的纺锤波。研究发现，NREM期间的心率（heart rate, HR）波动与这些NE节律紧密相位锁定，表明蓝斑是非常低频心率变异性（very low frequency heart rate variability, VLF-HRV）的关键驱动因素。

通过光遗传学技术，研究者们发现暂时抑制蓝斑会导致心率减慢的效应减弱，而激活蓝斑则会迅速加速心率，这表明蓝斑与心率之间存在直接关系，并在一定范围内保持稳定。然而，当蓝斑活动过度时，这种关系会失效。此外，研究还发现慢节奏心率变异性是跨物种的纺锤波依赖记忆处理的标志。在小鼠实验中，NREM期间心率减速的幅度与纺锤波活动及后续的记忆表现相关联。

在人类睡眠者中，研究同样观察到了相似的模式：NREM期间更强的VLF-HR波动与纺锤波表达的增加及更好的记忆保持相关。这些发现揭示了蓝斑活动的渐变如何调节睡眠期间的自主生理机制，强调了去甲肾上腺素在睡眠和记忆巩固中的重要作用。这项研究为理解睡眠中生理机制与记忆处理之间的关系提供了新的视角，可能对未来的睡眠研究和相关疾病的治疗具有重要意义。

items.title: SETD6-mediated methylation of PPARγ establishes a transcriptional feedback circuit promoting lipid accumulation in liver-derived cells
items.abstract: Peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor gamma (PPARγ) is a key transcriptional regulator of genes mediating adipogenesis (fat-cell differentiation), and lipid storage in several cell types like hepatocytes. As such, its regulation is crucial for cell and organismal physiology. Indeed, PPARγ’s activity is regulated by multiple mechanisms, including post-transcriptional modifications, which, when dys-coordinated, may contribute to the pathogenesis of various states, including obesity, insulin resistance, and fatty liver disease. Here, we demonstrate that SETD6 binds to and methylates PPARγ at lysine 170 (K170) both in vitro and in liver-derived cells. This methylation event, in turn, is required for PPARγ-mediated activation of SETD6 transcription via promoter binding, forming a positive feedback regulatory loop. RNA-sequencing revealed that both SETD6 and PPARγ methylation at K170 are required for full induction of lipid metabolism genes’ expression, manifesting functionally in lipid droplet biogenesis in liver-derived cells. Together, our findings uncover a novel role for lysine methylation of PPARγ in the regulation of lipid synthesis and lipid droplet biogenesis, thereby identifying putative new therapeutic targets for lipid overproduction diseases, including metabolic dysfunction-associated fatty liver disease and obesity.
items.title_zh: SETD6介导PPARγ的甲基化促进肝源细胞脂质积累的转录反馈回路
items.summary_zh: 过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体γ（PPARγ）是调控脂肪生成和脂质储存的关键转录因子。其活性受多种机制调控，包括转录后修饰。研究表明，SETD6在体外及肝源细胞中与PPARγ结合并在赖氨酸170（K170）位点进行甲基化。该甲基化事件对于PPARγ通过启动子结合激活SETD6转录是必需的，形成正反馈调控回路。RNA测序结果显示，SETD6和PPARγ在K170的甲基化对于脂质代谢基因的完全诱导表达是必要的，功能上表现为肝源细胞中的脂质小滴生物发生。我们的研究揭示了PPARγ赖氨酸甲基化在脂质合成和脂质小滴生物发生调控中的新作用，为脂质过量产生疾病（如代谢功能障碍相关脂肪肝病和肥胖）提供了新的治疗靶点。
items.l1_lead: SETD6通过甲基化PPARγ促进脂质积累的转录反馈回路，为代谢功能障碍相关疾病提供了新的治疗靶点。
items.l2_summary:
过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体γ（PPARγ）是调控脂肪生成和脂质储存的重要转录因子，其活性受到多种机制的调控，包括转录后修饰。近期研究发现，SETD6与PPARγ在体外及肝源细胞中结合，并在PPARγ的赖氨酸170（K170）位点进行甲基化。该甲基化事件对于PPARγ通过启动子结合激活SETD6的转录至关重要，从而形成一个正反馈调控回路。通过RNA测序分析，研究表明SETD6和PPARγ在K170位点的甲基化对于脂质代谢基因的完全诱导表达是必要的，这一过程在肝源细胞中表现为脂质小滴的生物发生。

具体而言，SETD6的甲基化作用不仅促进了PPARγ的活性，还通过激活SETD6的转录进一步增强了PPARγ的功能，形成了一个自我增强的反馈机制。这一发现揭示了PPARγ赖氨酸甲基化在脂质合成及脂质小滴生物发生中的新作用，提示其在脂质代谢调控中的重要性。此外，该研究为脂质过量产生相关疾病（如代谢功能障碍相关脂肪肝病和肥胖）提供了新的治疗靶点，表明通过调控SETD6和PPARγ的相互作用可能有助于改善这些疾病的病理状态。总之，SETD6介导的PPARγ甲基化不仅是脂质代谢的重要调控机制，也为相关疾病的治疗提供了新的思路。

items.title: Systematic analysis of network-driven adaptive resistance to CDK4/6 and oestrogen receptor inhibition using meta-dynamic network modelling
items.abstract: Drug resistance inevitably emerges during the treatment of cancer by targeted therapy. Adaptive resistance is a major form of drug resistance, wherein the rewiring of protein signalling networks in response to drug perturbation allows drug-targeted protein activity to recover. This can occur in the continuous presence of the drug and enables cells to survive/grow. Simultaneously, molecular heterogeneity enables the selection of drug-resistant cancer clones that can survive an initial drug insult, proliferate, and eventually cause disease relapse. Despite their importance, the link between heterogeneity and adaptive resistance, specifically how heterogeneity influences protein signalling dynamics to drive adaptive resistance, remains poorly understood. Here, we have explored the relationship between heterogeneity, protein signalling dynamics, and adaptive resistance through the development of a novel modelling technique coined Meta Dynamic Network (MDN) modelling. We use MDN modelling to characterise how heterogeneity influences the drug-response signalling dynamics of the proteins that regulate early cell cycle progression and demonstrate that heterogeneity can robustly facilitate adaptive resistance associated dynamics for key cell cycle regulators. We determined the influence of heterogeneity at the level of both reaction coefficients and protein abundance and show that reaction coefficients are a much stronger driver of adaptive resistance. Owing to the mechanistic nature of the underpinning ordinary differential equation framework, we then identified a full spectrum of subnetworks capable of driving adaptive resistance dynamics in the key early cell cycle regulators. Finally, we show that single-cell dynamic data supports the validity of our MDN modelling technique and a comparison between our predicted resistance mechanisms and known CDK4/6 and oestrogen receptor inhibitor resistance mechanisms suggests MDN modelling can be deployed to robustly predict network-level resistance mechanisms for novel drugs and additional protein signalling networks.
items.title_zh: 网络驱动的CDK4/6和雌激素受体抑制适应性抗药性系统分析
items.summary_zh: 在靶向治疗癌症的过程中，药物抗性不可避免地出现。适应性抗药性是主要的药物抗性形式，药物干扰引起的蛋白质信号网络重组使得药物靶标蛋白活性恢复。我们通过开发一种新颖的建模技术——元动态网络（MDN）建模，探讨了异质性、蛋白质信号动态与适应性抗药性之间的关系。研究表明，异质性显著影响调控早期细胞周期进程的蛋白质的药物反应信号动态，并且能够有效促进与关键细胞周期调节因子相关的适应性抗药性动态。我们还确定了异质性在反应系数和蛋白质丰度层面的影响。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，异质性显著影响细胞周期调节蛋白的药物反应信号动态，促进适应性抗药性的发展。
items.l2_summary:
在癌症靶向治疗中，药物抗性是一个不可避免的问题，其中适应性抗药性是主要的抗性形式。这种抗药性通常是由于药物干扰引起的蛋白质信号网络重组，导致药物靶标蛋白的活性得以恢复。为了解释适应性抗药性的机制，我们开发了一种新颖的建模技术——元动态网络（MDN）建模，旨在探讨异质性、蛋白质信号动态与适应性抗药性之间的关系。

研究结果表明，细胞的异质性显著影响调控早期细胞周期进程的蛋白质的药物反应信号动态。这种异质性不仅影响了药物的反应性，还有效促进了与关键细胞周期调节因子相关的适应性抗药性动态。此外，我们还发现异质性在反应系数和蛋白质丰度层面上具有重要影响。这些发现为理解癌症治疗中的适应性抗药性提供了新的视角，强调了在靶向治疗中考虑细胞异质性的重要性。

通过这种研究，我们能够更深入地理解适应性抗药性的形成机制，并为未来的癌症治疗策略提供理论基础，帮助开发更有效的治疗方案，以克服药物抗性带来的挑战。

items.title: Saudi specialty certificate in endodontics: program directors perceptions of candidate selection
items.abstract: IntroductionProgram Directors (PDs) evaluate a range of factors when selecting candidates. Understanding their perspectives may help applicants better prepare for the selection process. This study explored PDs' perspectives on selection criteria for the Saudi Specialty Certificate in Endodontics (SSE) program and examined whether these perspectives differed according to gender, experience, hospital setting, and geographic region.MethodsThis study aimed at an attempted census of all identifiable current and former SSE PDs registered with SCFHS. A previously validated survey with 30 questions covering seven domains: GPA, Exams, Research, Services and Electives, Interview, Recommendations, and Miscellaneous was distributed to the PDs via the Saudi Commission for Health Specialties (SCFHS) platform to ensure anonymity. Data collection spanned four months. Descriptive statistics, along with independent sample t-test and ANOVA, were used for analysis.Results32 PDs responded, yielding a response rate of 55.17%. Most PDs were current (53.1%), male (81.2%), from the central region (50%), affiliated with the Ministry of Health (34.4%), and had over three years of experience (43.8%). PDs prioritized the services and electives (mean 4.04 ± 0.87) and recommendations (mean 3.97 ± 0.60) domains. Key factors influencing these preferences included clinical competency and staff reputation (mean 4.37 ± 0.87), participation in endodontic electives (mean 4.28 ± 0.81), service residency experience (mean 4.28 ± 0.88), and professional attire (mean 4.28 ± 0.85), among others. Exams (mean 3.31 ± 1.02) and research (mean 3.40 ± 0.98) were less prioritized, mainly due to low emphasis on publication output (mean 2.96 ± 1.44). Statistical analysis revealed no significant differences across most subgroup comparisons. An exploratory difference was observed in the recommendation domain according to hospital setting (p = 0.034).ConclusionThe PDs' reported priorities indicate that services and electives have the highest descriptive mean, with candidates' reputation and performance during that period being the most significant factors. Although opinions differed across hospital settings, the findings should be interpreted cautiously and considered exploratory.

items.title: Nursing students’ experiences with using generative artificial intelligence: a descriptive qualitative study
items.abstract: BackgroundThe rapid development of generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) has brought new opportunities to nursing education, while raising numerous concerns. Existing research has primarily focused on nursing students’ acceptance, attitudes, and willingness to use GenAI, whereas studies exploring their experiences and perceptions remain relatively limited.ObjectiveThis study aimed to explore nursing students’ experiences with and perceptions of GenAI.MethodsA descriptive qualitative study was employed. Semi-structured interviews were conducted with full-time nursing students at Chongqing Medical University from March to April 2025 using purposive sampling, and the data were analyzed using conventional content analysis.ResultsA total of 25 nursing students were interviewed, from which 3 themes and 10 subthemes were extracted: 1) perceptions and experiences of using GenAI (improving learning efficiency, concerns about information accuracy, concerns about overreliance on GenAI, and concerns about future career development); 2) factors influencing the experience of using GenAI (individual factors, information factors, and social environmental factors); and 3) expectations for integrating GenAI into nursing education (optimizing tool design, offering related courses, and promoting innovation in teaching methods).ConclusionNursing students in this study generally held positive but cautious attitudes toward GenAI. Although GenAI has gradually become an important support tool for learning and research among some nursing students, concerns regarding information accuracy, overreliance, and ethical and privacy risks warrant continued attention. Nursing educators should strengthen AI literacy education and guide students in using GenAI critically and responsibly. Meanwhile, efforts should be made to develop GenAI tools tailored to the needs of nursing education, strengthen education on ethical and privacy protection, and actively explore effective ways to integrate GenAI into nursing education.

items.title: Telomere length and prevalent chronic lung disease in middle-aged and older adults: socioeconomic heterogeneity and early-life tobacco exposure in the health and retirement study
items.abstract: IntroductionTelomere shortening is a hallmark of aging and age-related diseases, yet evidence linking it to pulmonary diseases remains limited.MethodsWe included 4,994 participants aged ≥50 years from the 2008 HRS wave with available telomere measurement data. Pulmonary disease status was defined using the 2008 HRS self-reported physician-diagnosed chronic lung disease item, which includes conditions such as chronic bronchitis or emphysema and excludes asthma. Multivariable logistic regression models were used to examine the association between telomere length and the odds of prevalent chronic lung disease. Stratified analyses, restricted cubic spline (RCS) regression, and sensitivity analyses were conducted.ResultsEach interquartile range (IQR) increase in telomere length was associated with a 14.3% lower odds of prevalent pulmonary disease (adjusted OR = 0.857, 95% CI: 0.774–0.945, P = 0.002). Participants in the longest telomere quartile (Q4) exhibited 38.0% lower odds compared to those in the shortest quartile (Q1). However, after excluding participants exposed to parental smoking during childhood, the association was attenuated and was no longer statistically significant (OR = 0.901, 95% CI: 0.736–1.091, P = 0.297).DiscussionTelomere shortening may be biologically related to pulmonary disease-related processes via cellular senescence and chronic inflammation. Shorter telomere length was associated with higher odds of prevalent self-reported chronic lung disease in the full sample; however, this association became non-significant after excluding participants exposed to parental smoking during childhood, indicating that the full-sample association should not be interpreted as independent of early-life tobacco exposure. Longitudinal studies are needed to clarify temporality.

items.title: Correction: “Becoming the student of the patient”: a framework for embedding cultural humility in a medical curriculum
Safe and unsafe urinary catheter use in long-term care homes: a human factors-informed scoping review protocol
items.abstract: IntroductionTransurethral catheters are a type of urinary catheters that are commonly used in long-term care (LTC) settings to provide wound healing assistance, manage urinary retention and acute urinary obstruction. However, inappropriate and prolonged catheter use increases the risk of complications such as catheter-associated urinary tract infections (CAUTIs), blockages, leakage, trauma and discomfort, which negatively affects resident outcomes. In the LTC context, CAUTIs lead to increased morbidity, prolonged stay in hospitals and overall higher healthcare costs. Although clinical practice guidelines exist to support transurethral catheter management, evidence specific to LTC settings remains limited and has largely focused on clinical outcomes, with less attention given to the human factors and work system conditions that influence catheter-related care. Guided by the Systems Engineering Initiative for Patient Safety (SEIPS) framework, this scoping review aims to map and synthesize the existing evidence on transurethral catheter use in LTC homes, identify evidence-informed management practices, and examine the work system factors that influence safe and appropriate catheter use.MethodsThe Joanna Briggs Institute (JBI) methodology will be followed for the scoping review in adherence to the PRISMA-ScR guidelines. A preliminary search was conducted in PROSPERO, MEDLINE and Cochrane Databases of Systematic review to refine and review terms, followed by comprehensive and final searches across multiple databases, including PubMed, CINAHL, Embase, MEDLINE, Web of Science and SCOPUS. Study selection will be completed using the Covidence systematic review software and eligible studies will focus on urinary catheter use and management in LTC globally with no date restriction. Studies will be included if full texts are available in English or French. The extracted and synthesized data will then be characterized thematically to identify themes and knowledge gaps.DiscussionThis scoping review will provide an extensive literature synthesis while identifying gaps in practices to enhance catheter management in LTC settings. Guided by the SEIPS framework, this review will examine how interactions among people, tasks, technology, the physical environment, and organizational factors influence transurethral catheter management.Ethics and disseminationThis review acts as a knowledge synthesis tool based on existing literature and thus does not require any ethics approval. Summaries and findings can be used to guide future policies, guidelines, and healthcare reforms.

items.title: Case Report: Acquired hemophilia A presenting with recurrent arthritis-like joint swelling and musculoskeletal hematomas—a focused literature review
items.abstract: BackgroundAcquired hemophilia A (AHA) usually causes cutaneous, soft-tissue, or muscle bleeding; joint-dominant presentations are uncommon and may be mistaken for septic or inflammatory arthritis.Case presentationA man in his late 60s with no personal or family bleeding history developed recurrent arthritis-like joint swelling, extensive bruising, and suspected iliopsoas, upper-arm, and thigh hematomas after an elective operation. For approximately 4 months, fever, raised inflammatory markers, and periarticular imaging abnormalities led to repeated infection-directed treatment. At specialist assessment, the activated partial thromboplastin time was 77.6 s. A mixing study showed greater prolongation after incubation, factor VIII activity was below 0.8%, and the factor VIII inhibitor titer exceeded 120 Bethesda units, establishing AHA. Intravenous methylprednisolone followed by a prednisone taper and two rituximab infusions was followed by cessation of new bleeding and improvement in joint symptoms. At approximately 5 months after starting immunosuppression, the inhibitor was undetectable, factor VIII activity had recovered to 27%, and the activated partial thromboplastin time was within the reporting laboratory's reference range. At telephone follow-up approximately 13 months after treatment began, he reported clinical stability for about 6 months after stopping all medications, apart from occasional brief right-knee pain; contemporaneous coagulation results were unavailable. Repeated ceftriaxone exposure was considered a possible associated factor, but causality was not established because an activated partial thromboplastin time of 40 s was documented before the first recorded postoperative exposure and later antibiotic exposures were incompletely documented.ConclusionIn an older adult, recurrent hot or swollen joints accompanied by deep-muscle bleeding and an unexplained prolonged activated partial thromboplastin time should prompt immediate factor VIII activity and inhibitor testing. This case documents inhibitor clearance with partial factor VIII recovery and subsequent patient-reported stability off treatment; it does not prove drug causality or the comparative efficacy of rituximab.

items.title: Inflammation–fibrosis crosstalk in endometriosis: immune–stromal mechanisms linking lesion persistence to pain and infertility
items.abstract: Endometriosis is an estrogen-dependent chronic inflammatory disorder in which ectopic endometrial-like tissue undergoes repeated injury, incomplete resolution, and progressive remodeling. Fibrosis is therefore not merely a terminal scar but an active component of lesion biology. Cyclic bleeding activates platelets and innate immune cells, generates iron-dependent oxidative stress and hypoxia, and sustains transforming growth factor-β, sphingosine-1-phosphate, Wnt/β-catenin, PI3K/AKT–ERK, and Notch-related signals. These cues promote fibroblast activation, myofibroblast differentiation, extracellular-matrix deposition, and epithelial-, endothelial-, mesothelial-, or macrophage-to-mesenchymal plasticity. The resulting stiff matrix can further reinforce inflammatory, vascular, and neural programs, creating a self-maintaining inflammation–fibrosis circuit. Clinically, this circuit may stabilize ectopic lesions, promote adhesions, increase tissue tension and neurogenic inflammation, damage the ovarian cortex, and perturb the peritoneal and eutopic endometrial environments. These effects provide mechanistic links to persistent pain and infertility, although fibrosis is neither the sole determinant of symptoms nor a uniform feature across lesion phenotypes. This Mini Review integrates evidence from experimental models, human pathology, and single-cell studies; identifies uncertainties in cellular lineage, lesion chronology, and outcome attribution; and discusses therapeutic implications. Conventional hormonal and surgical treatment remains central, whereas antifibrotic, immunomodulatory, and complementary approaches require mechanism-based clinical validation. Progress will depend on standardized fibrosis phenotyping, longitudinal and spatial sampling, patient-derived multicellular models, and trials that align biological targets with pain, fertility, and recurrence outcomes.

items.title: Case Report: Necrotizing fasciitis caused by Vibrio vulnificus without recalled seafood or seawater exposure diagnosed by metagenomic next-generation sequencing
items.abstract: Vibrio vulnificus is a highly virulent marine Gram-negative pathogen that rapidly induces soft tissue necrosis and fatal septic shock, with infections generally linked to raw seafood ingestion or open wound contact with seawater. We report an atypical severe case of V. vulnificus septic shock in a 60-year-old male patient without recalled seafood or seawater exposure and without classic underlying high-risk diseases such as liver cirrhosis and diabetes mellitus. The patient presented with rapidly progressive swelling and subcutaneous ecchymosis of the right lower limb, which quickly deteriorated into refractory septic shock within 24 h. Conventional empiric broad-spectrum antibiotics failed to halt disease progression before pathogen identification. Metagenomic next-generation sequencing (mNGS) rapidly detected V. vulnificus sequences on the second admission day, and the diagnosis was further confirmed by blood culture. Multidisciplinary interventions including repeated radical surgical debridement, vacuum sealing drainage (VSD), targeted anti-infective therapy and comprehensive organ support finally achieved complete recovery. The patient recovered normal walking function during six-month outpatient follow-up. This rare occult infection case reminds clinicians to maintain high suspicion of V. vulnificus infection for rapidly advancing necrotizing fasciitis combined with septic shock, even when no aquatic exposure is recalled. Meanwhile, this work validates the critical value of mNGS for early pathogen identification in unexplained life-threatening sepsis.

items.title: Long-term upadacitinib treatment in a patient with atopic dermatitis, bullous pemphigoid, and alopecia areata: a case report and review of the literature
items.abstract: Atopic dermatitis (AD), bullous pemphigoid (BP), and alopecia areata (AA) are immune-mediated dermatologic diseases characterized by distinct clinical features but partially overlapping immunopathogenic mechanisms. Their coexistence in a single patient is uncommon and may pose significant diagnostic and therapeutic challenges. We report the case of a 33-year-old woman with long-standing moderate-to-severe AD who subsequently developed BP, confirmed by histopathology and direct immunofluorescence. Initial treatment with systemic corticosteroids and conventional immunosuppressants, including azathioprine followed by cyclosporine, resulted in only transient improvement and was limited by adverse effects. Dupilumab was therefore initiated, leading to marked improvement of BP while maintaining remission of AD. However, after approximately six months of therapy, the patient developed new-onset patchy AA. Dupilumab was discontinued, and treatment was switched to upadacitinib, a selective Janus kinase 1 (JAK1) inhibitor. Early clinical improvement was observed after six weeks, with progressive hair regrowth and stable BP activity. Complete remission of BP was achieved after twelve weeks and complete remission of AA after twenty-four weeks, while remission of AD was maintained. Disease control was sustained throughout a twenty-four -month follow-up, without significant adverse events. This case underscores the diagnostic and therapeutic complexity associated with the coexistence of multiple immune-mediated dermatologic diseases. The sequential emergence of AD, BP, and AA highlights the challenges posed by overlapping inflammatory pathways and the need for alternative therapeutic strategies when pathway-specific treatments prove insufficient or poorly tolerated. These observations support the concept that broader immunomodulatory approaches targeting shared signaling pathways may enable simultaneous control of multiple inflammatory conditions. In this context, inhibition of the JAK–STAT pathway may represent a promising integrated therapeutic strategy in selected patients with complex immune-mediated dermatologic comorbidities.

items.title: Non-invasive assessment of estimated glomerular filtration rate using lens autofluorescence in a population without chronic kidney disease
items.abstract: PurposeThe estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) is a vital indicator for monitoring renal health. Limitations caused by invasive serum-based measurement often delay the detection of early-stage renal decline. Advanced glycation end products (AGEs) contribute significantly to renal pathogenesis. This study specifically targets the “pre-clinical” window of renal decline. We investigate whether lens autofluorescence based AGE (LAF-AGE) measurement can serve as a non-invasive early warning indicator for eGFR in an asymptomatic, non chronic kidney disease (CKD) control population, facilitating the possibilities of detection of individuals at risk of future CKD before clinical manifestations.MethodsFrom an initial pool of 1,937 participants, we excluded those with eGFR < 60 mL/min or albuminuria or microalbuminuria (n = 1,725). Following the removal of biochemical outliers using the interquartile range (IQR) method, 1,287 participants were included in the final analysis. LAF-AGEs were measured using a scanning confocal biomicroscope. Age-adjusted AGE levels (AALs) were derived based on population percentiles. Multivariate linear regression was used to evaluate associations while adjusting for confounders, including sex, BMI, blood glucose, and lipids.ResultsLAF-AGEs showed a significant negative association with eGFR in the univariate model (β = −47.80, p < 0.001). This association remained significant after adjusting for confounders. Higher AALs were independently associated with lower eGFR (p = 0.002).ConclusionLAF-AGEs is a valid, practical and non-invasive parameter for eGFR evaluation.

items.title: Beyond the clicker: rethinking student response systems as pedagogical infrastructure for healthcare professions education
items.abstract: Large-group lectures (150 students and upwards) remain a central component of healthcare professions education despite longstanding concerns about passivity, limited interaction, and difficulties in providing formative feedback at scale. These concerns have acquired renewed relevance as educators face digitally connected student cohorts, ubiquitous smartphones, and growing concerns about digital distraction. Student response systems (SRS), initially introduced through dedicated “clickers” and now commonly accessed through students’ own digital devices, offer one approach to transforming the large lecture from a predominantly transmission-oriented format into an interactive learning environment. Meta-analytic evidence indicates positive effects of SRS on cognitive and non-cognitive learning outcomes, while research across psychology, nursing, medicine, dentistry, and other higher education settings suggests that their educational value depends less on the technology itself than on the pedagogical processes it enables. In this Perspective, we argue for a shift from viewing SRS primarily as engagement technology towards understanding it as pedagogical infrastructure for retrieval, formative assessment, peer discussion, feedback, self-monitoring, and metacognitive calibration in large lectures. Drawing on nearly two decades of research and educational experience with response technology, we propose an evolution from SRS 1.0, centred on response and participation, through SRS 2.0, centred on formative feedback and dialogue, towards SRS 3.0, where artificial intelligence may enable adaptive questioning, misconception detection, personalised feedback, and instructor decision support. This development creates new opportunities for healthcare professions education, but also requires renewed attention to pedagogy, digital competence, privacy, cognitive offloading, and the role of the educator.

items.title: Evaluation of the clinical efficacy of endoscopic endonasal dacryocystorhinostomy in treating chronic dacryocystitis
items.abstract: ObjectiveTo compare the short-term clinical efficacy and safety of endoscopic endonasal dacryocystorhinostomy (DCR) and traditional external DCR in patients with chronic dacryocystitis.MethodsA retrospective analysis was conducted on the clinical records of patients with chronic dacryocystitis treated at our hospital from November 2022 to November 2025. Patients were retrospectively categorized according to the surgical procedure received: the research group underwent endoscopic endonasal DCR, whereas the control group underwent traditional external DCR. Clinical data from all patients were collected and analyzed.ResultsNo statistically significant differences were observed in the recorded baseline characteristics between the two groups (P > 0.05). The clinical efficacy between the two groups showed no significant difference (P > 0.05), nor did the main symptom scores (P > 0.05). However, the research group demonstrated significantly lower intraoperative blood loss and shorter postoperative hospital stays compared to the control group (P < 0.05). The overall incidence of postoperative adverse events was also lower in the research group than in the control group (P < 0.05), and self-reported patient satisfaction was higher in the research group than in the control group (P < 0.05).ConclusionWithin the 2-month postoperative follow-up, unadjusted comparisons showed that endoscopic endonasal DCR was associated with lower intraoperative blood loss, shorter postoperative hospitalization, a lower overall incidence of postoperative adverse events, and higher self-reported patient satisfaction than traditional external DCR. No statistically significant between-group differences were detected in short-term anatomical or functional success. Larger prospective studies with adjustment for potential confounders and longer follow-up are required to confirm these findings.

items.title: Rethinking broad consent in the age of genomic AI: the Hungarian case
Risk factors for recurrent variceal bleeding after TIPS in cirrhotic patients with esophagogastric variceal hemorrhage: a single-center retrospective study
items.abstract: BackgroundTransjugular intrahepatic portosystemic shunt (TIPS) effectively reduces portal pressure but post-procedural rebleeding remains a major clinical challenge. Risk factors for rebleeding are not fully defined.MethodsThis single-center retrospective cohort study included 114 cirrhotic patients who underwent TIPS for EGVB (2019–2024). Patients were categorized into rebleeding (n = 35) and non-rebleeding (n = 79) groups based on 1-year post-TIPS rebleeding. Clinical, laboratory, procedural, prior endoscopic treatment history and follow-up data were analyzed. Univariate and multivariate Cox proportional hazards models were used to identify risk factors. Cumulative rebleeding incidence was compared between serum sodium groups (<135 vs. ≥135 mmol/L) using Kaplan–Meier analysis with log-rank test.ResultsThe 1-year rebleeding rate was 30.7% (35/114). Multivariate Cox regression identified lower serum sodium (HR = 0.85; 95% CI: 0.77–0.93; P < 0.001) and shunt dysfunction (HR = 4.60; 95% CI: 2.21–9.58; P < 0.001) as independent risk factors for rebleeding. Stent type was not independently associated after adjustment. The low sodium group (<135 mmol/L) showed a significantly higher cumulative rebleeding incidence than the high sodium group (log-rank P = 0.041). Conclusion: Serum sodium preoperatively and post-TIPS shunt dysfunction are independent risk factors for 1-year rebleeding. Optimizing serum sodium preoperatively and implementing regular surveillance for shunt dysfunction may help reduce rebleeding risk in these patients.

items.title: Hypercalcemia and acute kidney injury caused by occupational inhalation of vitamin D3: a case report
items.abstract: Vitamin D intoxication is a rare but potentially life-threatening condition that can lead to severe hypercalcemia and serious complications. Most reported cases are associated with long-term or high-dose oral vitamin D preparations, dietary supplement use, or inappropriate iatrogenic prescribing. In contrast, occupational inhalation exposure remains exceedingly uncommon. We report the case of a 25-year-old man who developed parathyroid hormone (PTH)-independent hypercalcemia and acute kidney injury (AKI) due to excessive exogenous vitamin D3 exposure in the workplace. Following prompt treatment, his clinical condition improved and he was discharged. This case underscores the importance of actively eliciting a history of occupational exposure in patients with PTH-independent hypercalcemia, particularly when there is no clear history of oral supplement use, to reduce missed diagnoses and facilitate prompt recognition and treatment.

items.title: Identification of candidate selenium-associated transcriptomic biomarkers in chronic obstructive pulmonary disease: an integrated bioinformatics and expression validation study
items.abstract: IntroductionChronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) is marked by long-lasting airflow obstruction accompanied by persistent inflammation and disturbed redox balance. Although oxidative stress is well established in COPD, it remains unclear whether PBMC transcriptional patterns that co-vary with a curated selenium-metabolism and selenoprotein signature can identify candidate COPD markers. We therefore evaluated such patterns as an exploratory transcriptomic prioritization strategy rather than as evidence of selenium-specific regulation.MethodsCOPD-related transcriptomic datasets were downloaded from the GEO database, and differentially expressed genes (DEGs) were determined using conventional differential expression analysis. Selenium metabolism and selenoprotein (SMASP) genes were collected from the MSigDB. WGCNA was then used to identify a module closely associated with COPD status and SMASP scores, and candidate genes were defined by intersecting module genes with DEGs. XGBoost and SVM-RFE, together with cross-validation, were applied to select biomarkers. A nomogram was subsequently generated to assess their diagnostic utility. Gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA) and RT-qPCR validation were finally conducted to examine the potential involvement of these biomarkers in COPD.ResultsWe detected 235 DEGs and 40 selenoprotein-related genes, from which 17 overlapping candidate genes were obtained. ERBB4 and ZKSCAN3 were ultimately retained as biomarkers and were significantly decreased in COPD samples. The nomogram based on these two genes showed favorable predictive ability. GSEA indicated that both biomarkers were associated with ribosome and olfactory transduction pathways. ERBB4 was also linked to neuroactive ligand-receptor interaction, whereas ZKSCAN3 was related to extracellular matrix (ECM)-receptor interaction. RT-qPCR in a small exploratory cohort (n = 5 per group) showed directionally consistent downregulation of ERBB4 and ZKSCAN3 in COPD samples, supporting the bioinformatics findings. This exploratory analysis was cross-sectional and does not establish causality, selenium deficiency, or clinical utility. The findings are hypothesis-generating and require prospective validation.ConclusionERBB4 and ZKSCAN3 were prioritized as exploratory candidate expression markers in the analyzed COPD datasets. Their diagnostic value, selenium specificity, and biological functions require confirmation in larger independent cohorts and functional studies.

items.title: Pathological mechanisms of long non-coding RNA FOXD2-AS1 promoting osteosarcoma mediated by the COI-1/OCN/Runx-2 signaling pathway
items.abstract: IntroductionOsteosarcoma (OS) is the most common primary malignant bone tumor in children and adolescents. Despite three decades of research efforts, no significant improvement in patient survival rates has been achieved, highlighting the urgent need for in-depth investigation into its pathogenesis to develop novel therapeutic strategies and more effective drugs. FOXD2-AS1, a long non-coding RNA, has been implicated in the prognosis and survival of various cancers, but its role in OS remains underexplored. This study therefore aimed to investigate the functional involvement of FOXD2-AS1 in OS progression and to evaluate a biocompatible delivery system for its in vitro and in vivo application.MethodsWe synthesized mPEG-PDPA hydrogel via free radical polymerization of 2-(diisopropylamino)ethyl methacrylate (PDA) and polyethylene glycol monomethyl ether acrylate (mPEG-AC), and employed this hydrogel as a delivery vehicle for FOXD2-AS1. The biocompatibility and safety of the empty hydrogel were first validated through both in vitro cell assays and in vivo animal experiments. To explore the mechanistic actions of FOXD2-AS1, we performed real-time quantitative PCR and Western blot analyses, and conducted transcriptome profiling to identify downstream pathways and associated genes.Results and DiscussionOur results demonstrated that the mPEG-PDPA hydrogel itself was non-toxic and reliable as a delivery vehicle. Functionally, FOXD2-AS1 promoted alkaline phosphatase (ALP) release and exacerbated the inflammatory response, thereby accelerating the development and deterioration of OS. Mechanistically, FOXD2-AS1 activated the F-box protein Coronatine Insensitive 1 homolog (COI-1)/OCN/Runx-2 signaling pathway, as confirmed by qPCR and Western blot. Transcriptome analysis further revealed that this process involved changes in cell migration, apoptosis, and cell cycle regulation, with CPS1-IT1, ANKRD10-IT1, TBC1D3P1-DHX40P1, and RGS5 identified as key associated genes. Collectively, our findings provide new insights into the pathological mechanisms of OS and offer valuable data support for future therapeutic strategy development.

items.title: Bone marrow cytology as an adjunct tool for post-mortem interval estimation
items.abstract: IntroductionEstimating the post-mortem interval (PMI) remains challenging, particularly when external indicators are unreliable. Sternal bone marrow may provide a relatively stable substrate for PMI assessment.MethodsThis observational autopsy-based study evaluated sternal bone marrow from 105 medico-legal autopsy cases with known PMI. Giemsa-stained aspirates were graded (1-5) for nuclear and cytoplasmic autolytic changes and grouped into five PMI intervals ( 27 h).ResultsA highly significant association was observed between PMI and cellular degradation (p < 0.001). Early intervals showed preserved morphology, intermediate intervals showed nuclear budding and vacuolation, and advanced intervals demonstrated nuclear fragmentation, debris, and structural loss.DiscussionSternal bone marrow cytology demonstrates a significant time-dependent association with PMI and may serve as a low-cost complementary tool during the early to intermediate post-mortem period. Further studies are required to establish its predictive accuracy and reproducibility.

items.title: Dynamic machine-learning model for early prediction of intraoperative hypotension using 5-minute perioperative time-series data: a multicenter retrospective study
items.abstract: BackgroundIntraoperative hypotension (IOH) is a common and potentially preventable complication strongly associated with postoperative acute kidney injury, myocardial injury, and mortality. Current approaches to IOH management remain largely reactive, and existing prediction tools have variable clinical utility. This study aimed to develop and externally validate a dynamic machine-learning model using routinely collected perioperative data to perform one-step-ahead prediction of intraoperative hypotension on a regularized 5-minute intraoperative grid.MethodsThis retrospective multicenter study included 702 adults undergoing non-cardiac surgery under general anesthesia for model development and internal validation and an independent external cohort of 248 patients. A dynamic prediction framework was constructed using routinely collected preoperative variables and intraoperative 5-minute time-series data. Individualized baseline features and temporal predictors were derived from rolling observation windows. Four machine-learning algorithms were compared using a fully nested grouped cross-validation framework with external validation. Model performance was assessed by discrimination, calibration, decision-curve analysis, and SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP)-based interpretability.ResultsAll four machine-learning models demonstrated good discrimination in the primary fully nested case-grouped internal validation, with AUROC values ranging from 0.842 to 0.857. Random forest achieved the highest AUROC (0.857, 95% CI 0.841–0.868), the highest AUPRC (0.413, 95% CI 0.367–0.452), and extra trees achieved the lowest Brier score (0.093, 95% CI 0.088–0.098). In the independent external validation cohort, random forest remained the best-performing model, yielding an AUROC of 0.894 (95% CI 0.875–0.907), an AUPRC of 0.540 (95% CI 0.457–0.596), and a Brier score of 0.092 (95% CI 0.083–0.102). SHAP analysis consistently identified MAP-derived features, including current MAP, recent hypotensive burden, recent MAP measurements, relative MAP reduction, and MAP variability, as the most influential predictors across all four models.ConclusionsA dynamic machine-learning model using routinely collected perioperative time-series data accurately predicted MAP <65 mmHg at the next scheduled 5-minute intraoperative time point in an independent external cohort. These findings support further evaluation of this short-horizon risk stratification model in prospective clinical workflow studies.

items.title: Season-adjusted longitudinal changes in serum 25-hydroxyvitamin D during pegylated interferon add-on to ongoing tenofovir alafenamide therapy in chronic hepatitis B: a real-world cohort study
items.abstract: ObjectivesTo characterize serum 25-hydroxyvitamin D [25(OH)D] trajectories during peginterferon alfa-2b (Peg-IFN) add-on to ongoing tenofovir alafenamide (TAF) therapy in chronic hepatitis B and explore associations with hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg).MethodsThis retrospective cohort identified 203 consecutive patients, of whom 190 contributed longitudinal data through week 48. The primary random-intercept mixed-effects model used categorical visit time and adjusted for seasonality, age, and sex. Continuous-time, random-slope, visit-timing, and HBsAg-censoring analyses assessed sensitivity.ResultsThe primary adjusted week-48 25(OH)D difference was −7.9 nmol/L (95% CI, −9.8 to −6.0) (P < 0.001); the secondary continuous-time estimate was −8.3 nmol/L over 48 weeks. Observed concentrations declined through week 36 and partially rebounded at week 48. The proportion below 47.7 nmol/L increased from 21.1% to 34.7%. The adjusted total serum calcium trend was −0.061 mmol/L (95% CI, −0.074 to −0.049). Triglycerides increased while cholesterol fractions decreased. At week 48, 104/190 patients (54.7%) had an HBsAg decline of at least 1 log10 and 50/190 (26.3%) had visit-specific HBsAg loss. The concurrent 48-week change correlation was weak (ρ = 0.150; FDR-adjusted P = 0.117), and the magnitude of 25(OH)D decline was not independently associated with either binary endpoint. Within patients, each 10 nmol/L increase in 25(OH)D was associated with a 0.068-log10 IU/mL increase in concurrent HBsAg (95% CI, 0.020 to 0.116; P = 0.006).ConclusionsSerum 25(OH)D showed a non-linear decline during 48 weeks of follow-up, and the week-48 difference remained evident after adjustment for seasonality. However, without a concurrent comparator, the observed change cannot be attributed specifically to Peg-IFN, TAF, or their combination. Exploratory analyses suggested only a weak concurrent relationship between 25(OH)D and HBsAg, without evidence of prediction or causality. The clinical relevance of the observed changes in 25(OH)D and total serum calcium warrants further prospective investigation.

items.title: Prefrontal cortex resting-state connectivity is moderated by hunger expectations induced by a placebo intervention in healthy female participants.
items.abstract: Placebo effects, in which a patient's symptoms and subjective well-being improve in response to an inactive treatment, medication, or intervention (a placebo), are well known in clinical research. Basic research in human cognition and neuroscience has shown that these effects are linked to prognostic expectations of effectiveness and to recruitment of prefrontal cortex regions, including the medial (mPFC), ventromedial (vmPFC), and dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (dlPFC). Here, we examined how the intrinsic functional connectivity of these three brain regions at rest, in the absence of any explicit task, was affected by internal beliefs such as placebo-induced hunger expectations. We conducted a seed-based resting-state functional connectivity analysis in 60 healthy female participants who underwent a placebo intervention targeting their hunger. In line with previously published results, the intervention induced hunger expectations and biased hunger sensations. Importantly, these effects were underpinned by attenuated functional connectivity between the mPFC and the angular gyrus within the default mode network the more participants expected the placebo to decrease their hunger. Hunger-increasing expectations attenuated connectivity between the vmPFC and the dm/dlPFC within the frontoparietal network and increased connectivity between the dlPFC and the thalamus. These results suggest that placebo-induced hunger expectations shift the way the prefrontal cortex connects to other brain regions associated with valuation, cognitive control, and interoception. This evidence sheds light on how the brain may translate incoming sensory information into biased sensations under placebo conditions and improves our understanding of the neural and psychological factors that influence a person's response to a placebo.
items.authors: Khalid, I.; Flament, B.; Rodrigues, B.; Morris, J.; Fossati, P.; Meissner, K.; Schmidt, l.
items.title_zh: 饥饿预期对健康女性前额叶皮层静息态连接的调节作用
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了安慰剂干预引发的饥饿预期如何影响健康女性参与者前额叶皮层三个区域（内侧前额叶皮层、腹内侧前额叶皮层和背外侧前额叶皮层）的静息态功能连接。我们对60名健康女性进行安慰剂干预，结果显示该干预引发了饥饿预期并影响了饥饿感。重要的是，随着参与者对安慰剂减轻饥饿的预期增强，内侧前额叶皮层与角回的功能连接减弱。饥饿预期增强还导致腹内侧前额叶皮层与背外侧前额叶皮层之间的连接减弱，同时背外侧前额叶皮层与丘脑之间的连接增强。这些结果表明，内在信念对大脑网络的功能连接有显著影响。

items.title: Defining redundancy in the stickers and spacers of the cell-cell junction protein Canoe's intrinsically disordered region
items.abstract: Cell-cell adherens junctions (AJs) and their dynamic cytoskeletal linkage power morphogenesis. AJs are enormous complexes with hundreds of proteins linked by multivalent interactions. Like other biomolecular condensates, intrinsically disordered regions (IDRs) in junctional proteins play important roles in AJ assembly and function, using spacer elements to span distances, and stickers to engage targets. To define molecular mechanisms, we need to define the functional units within IDRs. Drosophila Canoe, homolog of human Afadin, is our model. Canoe mediates morphogenesis and has an extensive IDR, with two conserved F-actin-binding stickers and two poorly conserved spacers. We combined biochemical, genetic and cell biological approaches to define the function of these IDR elements. While no single element is essential, deleting the full IDR essentially eliminates Canoe function. By scrambling the amino acid sequence of the spacers, we find that length and composition are more important than amino acid sequences, though sequences in the C-terminal spacer affect Canoe localization. Finally, we test redundancy of the F-actin-binding stickers. Deleting both reduces but does not eliminate viability, and sensitized assays reveal their redundant roles. These data reveal the robustness of IDRs.
items.authors: Jensen, C. C.; Wiltshire, R.; Clark, S. E.; Lamb, J.; Slep, K. C.; Peifer, M.
items.title_zh: 定义细胞间连接蛋白Canoe无序区的冗余性
items.summary_zh: 细胞间粘附连接（AJs）及其动态细胞骨架连接在形态发生中发挥重要作用。AJs是由数百种蛋白通过多价相互作用连接而成的巨大复合物。像其他生物分子凝聚物一样，连接蛋白中的无序区域（IDRs）在AJs的组装和功能中起着重要作用，利用间隔元件跨越距离，利用粘附元件与目标结合。我们以果蝇Canoe（人类Afadin的同源物）为模型，研究其广泛的IDR，其中包含两个保守的F-actin结合粘附元件和两个保守性差的间隔元件。通过结合生化、遗传和细胞生物学方法，我们定义了这些IDR元素的功能。虽然没有单一元素是必需的，但删除整个IDR会基本消除Canoe功能。通过打乱间隔元件的氨基酸序列，我们发现长度和组成比氨基酸序列更为重要，尽管C端间隔元件的序列会影响Canoe定位。最后，我们测试了F-actin结合粘附元件的冗余性，删除两个元件会降低但不消除生存能力，敏感性实验揭示了它们的冗余作用。这些数据揭示了IDRs的稳健性。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，Canoe的无序区域在细胞间连接中具有冗余性，尽管单一元素并非必需，但整体功能依赖于这些区域的长度和组成。
items.l2_summary:
细胞间粘附连接（AJs）及其动态细胞骨架连接在形态发生中扮演着重要角色。AJs是由数百种蛋白通过多价相互作用形成的巨大复合物，其中无序区域（IDRs）在其组装和功能中起着关键作用。研究以果蝇Canoe（人类Afadin的同源物）为模型，探讨其广泛的IDR，发现其中包含两个保守的F-actin结合粘附元件和两个保守性差的间隔元件。通过生化、遗传和细胞生物学方法，研究团队定义了这些IDR元素的功能。

研究结果表明，虽然没有单一的IDR元素是必需的，但删除整个IDR会显著削弱Canoe的功能。此外，通过对间隔元件氨基酸序列的干扰，发现其长度和组成比具体的氨基酸序列更为重要，尽管C端间隔元件的序列会影响Canoe的定位。进一步的实验测试了F-actin结合粘附元件的冗余性，结果显示，删除两个元件会降低生存能力，但并不会完全消除其功能，敏感性实验揭示了这两个元件之间的冗余作用。这些数据表明，IDRs在细胞间连接蛋白的功能中具有显著的稳健性，强调了在复杂的生物分子系统中，冗余性和无序区域的重要性。

items.title: Breaking the species barrier: recurrent genomic introgressions from very distant lineages in a ciliate
items.abstract: The process of speciation, through which two reproductively isolated species emerge from an ancestral population, is often gradual, including a period during which gene flow still occurs, and hence speciation remains reversible. However, if isolation persists, the progressive accumulation of genetic incompatibilities ultimately locks the speciation process, reaching the point where hybrid offspring are inviable or sterile. In plants and animals, the establishment of species barriers is quite rapid: beyond a net genetic divergence of 0.02 substitutions per synonymous site, interspecific introgressions become extremely rare. Here we report that in ciliates, species barriers can be broken despite huge genetic divergence. We show that the genome of Paramecium sonneborni contains hundreds of DNA segments that were acquired by recurrent horizontal transfers from multiple very distant lineages (synonymous divergence ~1 substitution/site). These segments approach the size of full-length chromosomes, which indicates that they were introgressed by inter-specific mating. These data show that in the ancestry of P. sonneborni, hybridization events with highly divergent species occurred repeatedly and led to viable and fertile offspring. We propose that this unexpected promiscuous sexual behavior is made possible by the fact that paramecia separate somatic and germline functions in two types of nuclei: the elimination of non-self DNA fragments during the development of the somatic genome allows individuals of a species to remain phenotypically the same, despite recurrent genetic flow from distant species into their germline.
items.authors: Benitiere, F.; Arnaiz, O.; Penel, S.; ZHANG, X.; Duharcourt, S.; Meyer, E.; Sperling, L.; Duret, L.
items.title_zh: 打破物种屏障：远缘类纤毛虫的基因组重组现象
items.summary_zh: 物种形成过程通常是渐进的，期间基因流动仍然存在，使得物种形成可逆。然而，若隔离持续，遗传不相容性的逐渐积累最终会锁定物种形成，导致杂交后代无法存活或不育。我们研究了类纤毛虫，发现尽管存在巨大的遗传分歧，物种屏障仍可被打破。具体而言，Paramecium sonneborni 的基因组中包含数百个通过多次水平转移获得的 DNA 片段，这些片段来自多个远缘谱系（同义分歧约为 1 次替换/位点）。这些片段接近完整染色体的大小，表明它们是通过异种交配引入的。这些数据表明，P. sonneborni 的祖先与高度分歧的物种之间发生了多次杂交事件，并产生了可育的后代。我们提出，这种意外的杂交行为可能得益于纤毛虫在体细胞和生殖细胞功能上的分离。

items.title: Gene flux shapes diversity and evolution of the ancient 17q21.31 inversion polymorphism
items.abstract: A hallmark of chromosomal inversions is that they suppress recombination between haplotypes, allowing inversion haplotypes to persist as single co-inherited units. To determine the extent to which inversions nevertheless permit genetic exchange, we investigated a common 979-kb inversion polymorphism at the human 17q21.31 locus. This locus exhibits deep divergence between the reference (H1) and inverted (H2) haplotypes, extensive segmental duplications (SDs) flanking the inversion, and association with neurodegenerative diseases, developmental disorders, and fertility-related phenotypes. Using single-cell sperm genome sequencing data, we directly measured recombination rates between H1 and H2 haplotypes and found near-complete suppression of single-crossover events between the haplotypes. The rare single crossovers that did occur were mediated by non-allelic homologous recombination between shared H1 and H2 SDs, generating novel duplication architectures. In contrast, two-switch events consistent with gene conversion or double crossovers, spanning 17-150 kb, occurred throughout the inversion at rates exceeding genome-wide estimates for events of comparable size. Consistent with recurring genetic exchange, we identified 99 distinct H1-H2 recombinant haplotypes segregating in All of Us genomes, including 26 with combinations of H1 and H2 SDs. These recombinant haplotypes facilitated dissection of the inversion's effects on fertility-related phenotypes; using a large parent-embryo dataset, we found that H2 additively increases female crossover rates across chromosomes and that KANSL1 duplications do not explain this effect. Finally, ancestral recombination graphs dated H1-H2 gene flux (the exchange of genetic material between alternative arrangements) to approximately 100-500 thousand years ago, revealing that H1 and H2 haplotypes have co-segregated for at least half a million years. Together, these results demonstrate that inversions can be permeable barriers to recombination, with ongoing gene flux influencing the diversity and evolution of inversion polymorphisms.
items.authors: Harringmeyer, O. S.; Biddanda, A.; McCoy, R. C.; Akey, J. M.
items.title_zh: 基因流动塑造古老17q21.31倒位多态性的多样性与演化
items.summary_zh: 染色体倒位的一个特征是抑制单倍型之间的重组，使倒位单倍型作为单一共遗传单位持续存在。我们研究了人类17q21.31位点上一个常见的979-kb倒位多态性，以确定倒位在多大程度上允许遗传交换。该位点在参考（H1）和倒位（H2）单倍型之间表现出深度分歧，且倒位两侧存在广泛的片段重复（SD），与神经退行性疾病、发育障碍和生育相关表型相关。通过单细胞精子基因组测序数据，我们直接测量了H1和H2单倍型之间的重组率，发现单交叉事件几乎完全被抑制。发生的稀有单交叉由共享的H1和H2 SD之间的非等位同源重组介导，生成新颖的重复结构。相反，符合基因转换或双交叉的两个切换事件在倒位中以超过全基因组估计的速率发生。我们在“All of Us”基因组中识别出99种不同的H1-H2重组单倍型，包括26种H1和H2 SD的组合，表明遗传交换的反复发生。

items.title: Reconstruction of the Prox gene family evolution in vertebrates reveals multiple lineage-specific gene losses
items.abstract: Prospero-related homeobox (Prox) genes encode a family of transcription factors that play essential roles in the development of several organs and systems, including the central nervous system, lymphatic endothelium, musculature, and liver. Despite their developmental importance, the evolutionary history of the vertebrate Prox gene family remains poorly understood. In this study we combined phylogenetic and synteny analysis to characterise the evolution of the Prox family in vertebrates. Our results reveal that two to three Prox subfamilies were already present in the last common ancestor of jawed vertebrates. We clarify the identity and evolutionary relationships of well-studied members of this family and identify multiple independent losses of Prox2 and Prox3 genes in specific vertebrate lineages. Furthermore, we uncover evidence for the existence of a fourth Prox gene in the ancestral vertebrate genome, which was subsequently lost. Overall, this study provides the first comprehensive analysis of the evolutionary history of the vertebrate Prox gene family and establishes a foundations for future studies on the functional roles of these genes.
items.authors: Panara, V.; Leyhr, J.; Koltowska, K.; Haitina, T.
items.title_zh: 脊椎动物Prox基因家族进化重建揭示多条谱系特异性基因丢失
items.summary_zh: Prospero相关同源盒（Prox）基因编码一类转录因子，在中枢神经系统、淋巴内皮、肌肉和肝脏等多个器官和系统的发育中发挥重要作用。尽管其发育重要性显著，脊椎动物Prox基因家族的进化历史仍不清楚。本研究结合系统发育和基因连锁分析，表征了脊椎动物Prox家族的进化。结果显示，最后一个有颌脊椎动物的共同祖先中已存在两到三个Prox亚家族。我们明确了该家族中研究较多成员的身份及其进化关系，并识别出特定脊椎动物谱系中Prox2和Prox3基因的多次独立丢失。此外，我们发现祖先脊椎动物基因组中存在第四个Prox基因，但随后丢失。总体而言，本研究提供了脊椎动物Prox基因家族进化历史的首次综合分析，为未来研究这些基因的功能角色奠定了基础。

items.title: Generative modeling reveals the connection between nuclear morphology and gene expression
items.abstract: How transcriptional programs shape nuclear morphology, and how morphological features in turn reflect and influence cell identity and function, remains poorly understood. Here, we introduce COSMIC, a bidirectional generative framework that enables quantitative decomposition of transcriptional variance reflected in nuclear morphology and morphological variance explained by gene expression. Pretrained on over 21 million segmented nuclei, COSMIC models cross-modal relationships by using a multimodal dataset acquired with IRIS, a technology that captures high-resolution images and transcriptomes from the same single cells. COSMIC learns relationships between gene expression and nuclear morphology, enabling the identification of genes whose expression covaries with nuclear morphological variation. In prostate cancer cells, COSMIC distinguishes chemotherapy-responsive and -resistant cell states through coordinated morphological and transcriptional changes, revealing morphology-associated genes linked to tumour state. Applied to spatial transcriptomics of zebrafish embryogenesis, COSMIC reveals how local cellular neighborhoods influence morphology-expression relationships. These results demonstrate that generative modeling powered by paired single-cell measurements can quantify the information shared between nuclear morphology and gene expression, opening new avenues for mechanistic discovery in both basic and translational cell biology.
items.authors: Wen, S.; Vinas, R.; Bues, J.; Lambert, C.; Grenningloh, N.; Ferrari, T.; Bugani, E.; Pezoldt, J.; Love, J.; Wan, Y.; Karthaus, W.; Deplancke, B.; Brbic, M.
items.title_zh: 生成建模揭示核形态与基因表达的关系
items.summary_zh: 转录程序如何塑造核形态，以及形态特征如何反映和影响细胞身份与功能，仍不甚明了。本文介绍了COSMIC，一个双向生成框架，能够定量分解反映在核形态中的转录变异和由基因表达解释的形态变异。COSMIC在超过2100万个分割核上进行预训练，利用IRIS技术获取同一单细胞的高分辨率图像和转录组数据，建模跨模态关系。COSMIC学习基因表达与核形态之间的关系，识别与核形态变异共变的基因。在前列腺癌细胞中，COSMIC通过协调的形态和转录变化区分化疗响应和耐药细胞状态，揭示与肿瘤状态相关的形态基因。应用于斑马鱼胚胎发育的空间转录组学，COSMIC揭示局部细胞邻域如何影响形态与表达关系。这些结果表明，基于配对单细胞测量的生成建模可以量化核形态与基因表达之间共享的信息，为机制研究开辟新途径。

items.title: Accurate and scalable demultiplexing of single-cell RNA sequencing using BEACON
items.abstract: Barcode-based multiplexing strategies can significantly increase sample throughput and decrease costs, while mitigating batch effects of single-cell RNA sequencing experiments. However, these approaches can be limited by inaccurate or inefficient demultiplexing, resulting in cell loss and reduced statistical power. Here, we present BEACON, a novel sample demultiplexing method that efficiently learns the background count distribution from data and removes it from individual cells, thereby improving classification accuracy. BEACON outperforms other state-of-the-art methods on multiple human data sets. We apply it to cancer cell line time course experiments in vitro, enabling the identification of genes associated with aggressive tumors in vivo. Finally, we adapt BEACON to multimodal protein-transcriptome profiling, enhancing protein signal recovery to identify a CD161-positive effector memory CD4 T-cell population with a Th17-like phenotype, which we prospectively validate. BEACON can therefore be applied to other droplet-based single-cell sequencing methodologies.
items.authors: Ji, B. W.; Lammers, M.; Houser, A.; Chan, N.; Rodriguez, J.; Chae, H.; Xiang, C.; Bui, J.; Li, H.; Ji, A.
items.title_zh: 基于BEACON的单细胞RNA测序高效去重方法
items.summary_zh: 条形码多重化策略能够显著提高样本通量并降低成本，同时减轻单细胞RNA测序实验的批次效应。然而，这些方法常因去重不准确或效率低下而导致细胞损失和统计能力下降。本文提出了BEACON，一种新颖的样本去重方法，能够高效学习数据的背景计数分布并将其从单个细胞中去除，从而提高分类准确性。BEACON在多个人体数据集上优于其他先进方法。我们将其应用于体外癌细胞系时间序列实验，识别与体内侵袭性肿瘤相关的基因。最后，我们将BEACON适配于多模态蛋白-转录组分析，增强蛋白信号恢复，识别出具有Th17样表型的CD161阳性效应记忆CD4 T细胞群体，并进行了前瞻性验证。因此，BEACON可应用于其他基于液滴的单细胞测序方法。

items.title: Quantitative imaging of schwannoma captures heterogeneity and accelerates preclinical testing, exposing distinct therapeutic signatures
items.abstract: Schwannomas are debilitating hallmarks of familial schwannomatoses and common sporadic tumors that form on spinal and cranial nerves. Drug-based therapies for schwannoma are desperately needed but their development has been extremely slow and disappointing, impeded particularly by the poorly understood and surprisingly complex and heterogeneous biology of schwannomas, and by the inefficient use of physiologically relevant in vivo preclinical models. We have addressed these gaps by developing a quantitative imaging-centered workflow that allows both a deep analysis of schwannoma development and accelerated preclinical testing in a widely used genetically engineered mouse model of neurofibromatosis type 2-related schwannomatosis (NF2-SWN). We deployed our workflow to study schwannoma development and to test three clinically relevant drugs head-to-head. Our results uncovered the very early onset of heterogeneity and macrophage recruitment to initiating schwannomas and unexpectedly revealed that although all three drugs inhibited proliferation within the developing schwannomas, they did so while triggering one of two distinct response signatures, highlighting the value of our pipeline for both rapid drug-testing and translational discovery.
items.authors: Wright, E. A.; Vitte, J.; Veiga, S. I.; Bushnell, S. E.; Movsessian, C. E.; Zhang, Y.; Curtis, J.; Corcoran, R. B.; Stott, S. L.; Giovannini, M.; Chiasson-MacKenzie, C.; McClatchey, A. I.

items.title: Hummingbird torpor recapitulates key molecular signatures of hibernation without large-scale transcriptomic remodelling
items.abstract: Torpor is a physiological strategy used by which some species conserve energy by lowering metabolic rates and body temperatures. While mammalian hibernation is well-studied, the molecular mechanisms governing the rapid entry into avian torpor remain poorly understood. This study represents the first multi-tissue whole-transcriptomic analysis of torpor entry in an avian system. By combining real-time thermal imaging and respirometry with transcriptomic profiling across seven tissues, we identified the key molecular pathways orchestrating this transition in Anna's hummingbirds (Calypte anna). Our results reveal that avian torpor entry is characterised by a subtle transcriptomic change (<5% of the genome differentially expressed across tissues) compared to mammalian hibernation (10%-60%). Most of these genes are differentially expressed before torpor entry is complete, rather than tracking body temperature linearly. This indicates that active transcriptional reprogramming precedes and potentially drives the transition. Thus, hummingbird torpor entry is not a passive shutdown, but a highly regulated, tissue-specific process. Vital organs, such as the heart and lungs, remain transcriptionally stable to maintain essential functions, while the liver and gut exhibit extensive metabolic rewiring. We found evidence of global transcriptional and translational suppression, and cell-cycle arrest: the three major contributors to cellular energy budgets. We hypothesise that avian torpor entry is orchestrated through an arrest of apoptosis, a metabolic switch from carbohydrate to lipid utilisation, coupled with alterations in alternative splicing and circadian rhythm regulation. Finally, the counterintuitive upregulation of genes involved in mitochondrial metabolism suggests a preparation for rapid arousal despite the depressed metabolic state.
items.authors: Kumar, H.; Blackwell, E. R.; Powers, D. R.; Shankar, A.
items.title_zh: 蜂鸟冬眠状态重现冬眠关键分子特征
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了蜂鸟（Calypte anna）进入冬眠状态的分子机制，首次对其多组织全转录组进行了分析。通过实时热成像和呼吸测量结合七种组织的转录组分析，我们识别出调控这一转变的关键分子通路。结果显示，蜂鸟进入冬眠状态时的转录组变化较小（<5%基因在不同组织中差异表达），而哺乳动物冬眠则为10%-60%。大多数差异表达基因在冬眠状态完全形成前就已变化，表明主动的转录重编程可能驱动这一转变。蜂鸟的冬眠状态并非被动关闭，而是高度调控的组织特异性过程。心脏和肺等重要器官保持转录稳定以维持基本功能，而肝脏和肠道则表现出广泛的代谢重组。我们发现全球转录和翻译抑制的证据，以及细胞周期的变化。

items.title: Medial septum glutamatergic neurons support speed coding and grid cell spatial stability in the medial entorhinal cortex
items.abstract: Successful navigation requires the integration of self-motion signals with spatial representations, yet the circuits that provide velocity information necessary for stable grid cell firing remain incompletely understood. Here, we identify medial septal (MS) glutamatergic neurons as a critical component of this pathway. Using cell-type-specific optogenetic silencing combined with in vivo electrophysiology in freely moving mice, we show that MS glutamatergic neurons support the fidelity of firing rate-based speed coding in the medial entorhinal cortex (MEC). Silencing this population reduced grid cell spatial periodicity and stability and produced distortions of grid firing fields. Silencing also reduced theta phase-locking strength in strongly theta-modulated MEC neurons. Model simulations of a hybrid oscillatory interference-continuous attractor network with reductions in speed-signal fidelity disrupted grid periodicity and reproduced features of the spatial distortions observed in vivo. Together, these findings identify a septo-entorhinal circuit that coordinates self-motion information with the spatial and temporal organization of MEC activity to maintain a stable neural representation of space.
items.authors: Robinson, J. C.; Carmichael, J. E.; Brandon, M.; Hasselmo, M.
items.title_zh: 内侧隔膜谷氨酸能神经元支持内侧嗅皮层的速度编码与网格细胞空间稳定性
items.summary_zh: 成功的导航需要将自我运动信号与空间表征相结合，但提供稳定网格细胞放电所需速度信息的电路尚不完全清楚。本研究确定内侧隔膜（MS）谷氨酸能神经元是这一通路的关键组成部分。通过细胞类型特异性的光遗传学抑制结合在自由活动小鼠中的体内电生理学，我们发现MS谷氨酸能神经元支持内侧嗅皮层（MEC）中基于放电频率的速度编码的准确性。抑制该神经元群体降低了网格细胞的空间周期性和稳定性，并导致网格放电场的扭曲。同时，抑制还减少了在强θ波调制的MEC神经元中的θ相位锁定强度。混合振荡干扰-连续吸引子网络的模型模拟显示，速度信号准确性的降低破坏了网格周期性，并再现了在体内观察到的空间扭曲特征。这些发现共同揭示了一个协调自我运动信息与MEC活动的空间和时间组织的隔膜-嗅皮层电路，以维持空间的稳定神经表征。

items.title: Longitudinal White Matter Microstructure and Transition to Psychosis in Individuals at Clinical High Risk
items.abstract: Altered white matter microstructure, commonly indexed by fractional anisotropy (FA), has been reported in individuals at clinical high-risk of psychosis (CHR-P) across multiple white matter tracts. However, the relationship between these alterations and later transition to psychosis remains unclear. To address this gap, we investigated whether baseline and longitudinally updated FA measurements were associated with risk of transition to psychosis in a large cohort of individuals at CHR-P. We analysed diffusion tensor imaging data from N = 205 participants at CHR-P, 23 of whom developed psychosis within 3 years of follow-up. Data were collected at baseline, 6 months, and 12 months. Associations between global and tract-specific FA and transition risk were examined using Cox proportional hazards models of baseline data and longitudinally updated data. Point estimates were directionally consistent, with hazard ratios .05). The directionally consistent estimates are compatible with small, distributed effects across multiple white matter pathways being associated with transition to psychosis, although this requires replication. Longitudinally updated FA measurements did not yield stronger associations than were available from baseline imaging data alone. Studies at an even larger scale are needed to establish whether these associations are robust and clinically meaningful.

S.; Cho, K. I. K.; Weiser, M.; Mizrahi, R.; Sachs, G.; Kirschner, M.; Taquet, M.; PSYSCAN Consortium,  ; Kahn, R.; Oliver, D.; McGuire, P.

items.title: Adaptive spatiotemporal filtering of social electrosensory signals by cerebellar feedback
items.abstract: Sensory feedback can suppress predictable input, yet most research on this mechanism used simplified stimuli that do not capture the spatial and temporal structure of natural signals. We examined how cerebellum-like feedback, in brown ghost knifefish, shapes the encoding of realistic social electrosensory signals. These naturalistic signals replicated the spatial structure of social signals, spanned the range of typical AM beat frequencies, and incorporated movement-related contrast envelopes. Single-unit recordings were obtained from electrosensory lateral line lobe pyramidal cells while a conspecific-like signal was delivered. Responses were compared before and after pharmacological blockade of descending cerebellar feedback. As expected, feedback strongly attenuated responses to spatially-realistic low-frequency beats but did not alter beat-cycle coding at higher frequencies. However, feedback reduced the neural representation of movement-related contrast envelopes across all beat frequencies. Using information-theoretic tools, we showed that feedback strength adapts dynamically to the stimulus contrast over the past few hundred ms. Furthermore, we examined how the spatial coding by the pyramidal cell population is influenced by feedback. We show that feedback enhances localization cues. This improvement arose because feedback reduces weak background responses while not affecting the strongest responses, thereby increasing spatial contrast. These findings show that the same descending pathway jointly filters temporal and spatial features of the full range of natural signals, adapting to recent input statistics. This process exemplifies a general mechanism by which a predictive feedback can improve the efficiency of natural sensory representations.
items.authors: Miller, D. R.; Shinn, E. K.; Harrison, B.; Marsat, G.

items.title: Resolving the treachery of images: Neural signatures during natural interactions with real objects are as reliable as while viewing images
items.abstract: Is a real object the same as its image? Vision and its neural basis have been studied almost entirely with images. However, real objects are fundamentally different, because we can act on them. But since we see and interact with real objects differently each time, it is widely believed that brain activity will be highly variable. An alternative view is that real objects should evoke reliable neural signatures since brain activity might be optimized for natural behavior. To investigate these possibilities, we performed wireless neural recordings from the high-level visual (IT) and motor regions (PMv/PFC) of freely moving monkeys, performing a natural task where they ate food items offered by humans, and a controlled task where they viewed the corresponding images on a screen. Neural decoders trained on images accurately identified the corresponding real objects. Even though neural responses were more variable during real object interactions, the variability of object-relevant information was strikingly similar, suggesting that the additional variability is present along irrelevant dimensions. Finally, key events in the natural task elicited reliable neural signatures. We conclude that brain activity is efficiently organized during natural behavior, ensuring that real objects are encoded as efficiently as images.
items.authors: Simon, S.; Munda, S.; Cherian, T.; Saha, S.; Jacob, G.; Das, J.; Bhadra, D.; Arun, S.

items.title: Coupling Stickland fermentation with reverse β-oxidation represents a new mode of medium-chain carboxylate production
items.abstract: Biotechnologies for producing medium-chain carboxylic acids (MCCAs) by chain elongating bacteria (CEB) promise to shift the oleochemical industry away from existing land use practices, vulnerable supply chains, and significant environmental costs. Realizing this potential requires a broader understanding of CEB physiology, which is currently based on lactate and ethanol utilization, despite these bacteria thriving in protein-rich digestive tracts and organic waste bioreactors. Through comparative genomic analysis of known MCCA producers and physiological examination of the recently isolated species Peptonella octanoica as a model system, we show that amino acid utilization is a broadly distributed yet largely overlooked trait of many CEB. Among several amino acid-fermenting lineages, a conserved metabolic architecture couples Stickland fermentation with reverse {beta}-oxidation (R{beta}O), enabling MCCA production when acetate or electron-accepting amino acids are limiting. We show how this coupling manages thermodynamic constraints on lactate and amino acid oxidation by driving longer-chain product formation as hydrogen partial pressure increases. We further reveal that amino acid-fermenting CEB are abundant not only in gut microbiomes but also engineered bioreactors, where their novel physiology provides a mechanistic basis for high titer n-octanoate production from proteinaceous organic wastes. Beyond biomanufacturing, these findings broaden our understanding of CEB across anaerobic microbiomes in which amino acid fermentation and chain elongation are intersecting ecological strategies.
items.authors: Lindner, B. G.; Nallasamy, D. K.; Roberts, L.; Gois, I. M.; Lawson, C. E.

items.title: Single-stranded telomeric repeats segregate into spatial compartments within ALT-associated PML bodies
items.abstract: Alternative lengthening of telomeres (ALT)-associated PML bodies (APBs) concentrate single-stranded (ss) telomeric DNA and RNA species critical for recombination-based telomere maintenance. However, how these species are organized inside APBs has remained invisible at microscopic resolution. Here, we map the nanoscale topology of APB components using 3D MINFLUX super-resolution microscopy combined with multiplexed exchange DNA-PAINT labeling at [~]3 nm localization precision. We discover that ssC-rich and ssG-rich telomeric repeats occupy distinct spatial compartments within a partially open, ~70 nm-thick PML protein shell: ssC-rich repeats concentrate at the inner shell surface, while ssG-rich repeats distribute broadly throughout the interior alongside TRF1-marked double-stranded telomeric chromatin. The ssG-rich signal is predominantly DNA and frequently colocalizes with POT1 assemblies. Additional TRF1 clusters outside the shell indicate multi-telomere association. Together, the spatial segregation of single-stranded telomeric species within APBs imposes structural constraints on different mechanisms of ALT-mediated telomere elongation and defines features that distinguish them.
items.authors: Koeleman, E. S.; Kaplan, C.; do Rego Barros Fernandes Lima, M. A.; Braun, D. M.; Knotz, C.; Rippe, K.

items.title: Conserved Obg-type GTPases Sustain Protein Synthesis across Domains of Life
items.abstract: Translation is regulated both temporally and spatially to ensure that proteins are synthesized at the correct time and delivered to the proper subcellular location. Temporary slowing or halting of ribosomal movement along an mRNA, a physiological pausing, allows cells to coordinate protein production with internal cues and external signals. However, how cells distinguish such constructive pauses from harmful pathological stalls remains a fundamental unresolved question in molecular biology.
