items.title: In silico evaluation of novel isosteres against PTPN1 and estrogen receptor alpha: molecular docking, ADMET profiling, and quantum chemical analysis
items.abstract: A series of novel cyclic alkene template (CAT) isosteres (CAT-0 to CAT-7) were designed and evaluated through an integrated in silico workflow combining molecular docking, density functional theory (DFT) based electronic structure analysis, ADMET prediction, CYP450 profiling, and preliminary synthetic feasibility assessment. Two biologically relevant protein targets, protein tyrosine phosphatase 1B (PTPN1) and estrogen receptor alpha (ERα/ESR1), were investigated to explore the potential biological activity profiles of the designed compounds. Docking studies were performed using the 2HNP and 3ERT crystal structures for PTPN1 and ERα, respectively. Validation of the docking protocols through reproduction of the corresponding co-crystallized ligand poses yielded RMSD values below 2 Å, supporting the reliability of the docking procedures. CAT-3, CAT-4, and CAT-7 were identified as the most promising candidates based on their predicted binding affinities across the two targets. Electronic structure analysis suggested that variations in electrostatic potential distribution and frontier orbital characteristics may contribute to differences in binding behavior within the series, supporting the isosteric design strategy. ADMET and toxicity predictions indicated generally favorable drug-like properties, with most compounds exhibiting acceptable gastrointestinal absorption and low predicted CYP450 inhibitory activity, suggesting a limited risk of CYP-mediated drug–drug interactions. However, variability in blood–brain barrier permeability and model-dependent toxicity endpoints highlights the inherent uncertainty of in silico ADMET predictions and warrants cautious interpretation of absolute values. Among the designed compounds, CAT-3 emerged as the most balanced lead candidate, combining favorable docking performance, acceptable predicted pharmacokinetic properties, and improved synthetic accessibility relative to CAT-4 and CAT-7, which, despite strong predicted affinities, present greater synthetic constraints. Its structural relationship to trodusquemine further supports its relevance as a promising scaffold. Overall, CAT-3 represents the most favorable compromise between predicted biological activity and practical feasibility within the series. Nevertheless, given the limitations of empirical scoring functions, rigid receptor approximations, and predictive ADMET models, these findings should be regarded as hypothesis-generating. Further validation through molecular dynamics simulations, MM-GBSA free energy calculations, and experimental assays will be required to confirm the predicted biological relevance of the CAT series.
items.authors: Lilian Rouille

items.title: Perovskite Photovoltaics in 2025: The certified frontier held while verification stayed scarce
items.abstract: This review assembles the complete 12-month publication record retrospectively, rather than through sequential monthly monitoring. The corpus holds 7931 publications meeting the topical scope criteria, of which 450 were examined in close detail across date-resolved monthly cohorts, alongside 1089 publications dated only to the calendar year. Within this literature, only 66 investigations reported an independently certified power conversion efficiency (PCE), which peaked at 33.15% for the year. Certified values moved from 30.26% in the first month recording a verified metric to 30.1% in the last, a net displacement of-0.16. Buried contact modification with carbazole self-assembled monolayers (SAMs), low-dimensional capping heterostructures, and additive-directed crystallization drove the performance records in both monolithic tandem and single-junction architectures. Mechanistic consensus breaks down over whether these surface modifiers permanently eliminate deep electronic traps or merely impose transient electrostatic potential shifts. Several groups attribute suppressed non-radiative recombination and stabilized open-circuit voltage (Voc) to chemical defect healing, while competing investigations demonstrate that asymmetric interfacial dipoles create electrostatic crosstalk, transport barriers, and unshielded internal fields that accelerate halide segregation. Carrying these interfacial treatments to scalable modules incurs a severe area penalty, with sharp efficiency deficits as aperture dimensions expand toward the maximum reported area of 764 cm2. In blade and slot-die deposition, the molecular attributes that minimize interface recombination in spin-coated cells directly impair meniscus translation, because hydrophobic self-assembled monolayer (SAM) terminal groups form precursor micellar aggregates that induce solvent dewetting, pinhole formation, and lateral nucleation gradients across wide substrates. Operational stability data remain deficient across the publication record. Merely 15 studies documented operational lifetimes, the longest reaching 3200 h, and only 24 articles followed standardized International Summit on Organic Photovoltaic Stability (ISOS) procedures. Most stability assessments evaluated unencapsulated storage in inert atmospheres, or omitted continuous maximum power point tracking (MPPT) under elevated operating temperatures, which leaves lifetime projections uncalibrated against operational degradation modes. Abstract-level reporting frequencies confirm the same verification gap: statements of independent certification occurred in just 5.8% of evaluated abstracts across the year, varying between 3.4% and 7.6% across monthly cohorts. Champion efficiency claims therefore rest predominantly on unverified, small-area laboratory cells that remain susceptible to spectral mismatch and calibration artifacts. Read across device architectures, the high open-circuit voltages obtained through contact engineering are frequently purchased with accelerated chemical and electronic degradation. Phosphonic acid anchor groups corrode reactive nickel oxide hole-transport layers under operating bias, and low-dimensional perovskite capping overlayers introduce anisotropic out-of-plane transport barriers that accumulate photogenerated carriers, lowering the kinetic activation barrier for electricfield-driven halide migration and phase demixing. In narrow-bandgap tin-lead absorbers, evidence settling whether stannous oxidation stems from autonomous chemical redox reactions or from downstream lattice microstrain remains thin, since chemical reducing agents delay degradation without resolving the underlying mechanical distortion. Establishing whether passivating molecules permanently eliminate deep recombination centers, or merely raise temporary barriers that disguise latent operational instabilities, requires synchronized operando spectroscopic and impedance measurements under simultaneous electrical bias and thermal stress.
items.authors: Havid Aqoma

items.title: A transcriptional reporting system for sensing interactions of small molecules with proteins
items.abstract: Characterizing binding interactions of small molecules with proteins is important in many areas of chemistry and biology. We show here that a transcriptional activation sequence from Escherichia Coli (E. Coli) can be exploited to create a binding sensor for small molecule/protein interactions. The system requires two key components: small molecules connected to a DNA bearing a transcriptional activation sequence (TAS) and proteins of interest (POIs) expressed as fusions with the transcriptional activation domain (TAD) from the phage shock protein F (PspF). If the DNA bound small molecule binds to the POI, the induced proximity of the TAD to the TAS initiates transcription, with the number of copies of RNA produced proportional to the binding affinity. Although numerous direct binding measurement techniques are known, very few of these amplify binding signals, or convert the binding signal to a different molecular form which is then easy to handle and quantify. We demonstrate several use cases where the technique will prove valuable, such as in characterizing binders, identifying molecular glues, or as a reporter in DNA encoded library (DEL) selections.
items.authors: Koder Dagher, Minqi Pan, Basilius Sauter, Saule Zhanybekova, Pinwen Cai, Lukas Schneider

items.title: Accelerating the Discovery of Marine Natural Products with Antimicrobial activity via Bioactivity-Driven Molecular Networking
items.abstract: The growing threat of antimicrobial resistance underscores an urgent need to investigate underexplored natural sources to provide new chemical scaffolds for drug development. Marine environments, particularly those along the South African coastline, represent reservoirs of novel chemical diversity with the potential to provide new classes of antibiotics. This study reports the development of an efficient biodiscovery pipeline for the assembly and systematic screening of marine natural products extract libraries to identify novel antimicrobial leads. The workflow integrates microbial genomics and biological screening with non-targeted high resolution tandem mass spectrometry and molecular networking. Chemical extracts of 174 sponges and tunicates collected from the South African coast were evaluated for antibacterial, cytotoxic, and in vitro enzyme inhibitory activity. Guided by molecular networkbased feature prioritization, eleven known secondary metabolites spanning four major 2 structural classes (bifunctional sphingolipids, variabilin furanosesterterpenes, topsentin bisindole and pyrrolo iminoquinone -alkaloids) were isolated. The bioactivity of the isolated compounds was consistent with their corresponding crude extracts. Computational mass spectrometry analysis of extracts with antimicrobial activity revealed additional enriched metabolite families warranting further investigation. Finally, we profiled the taxonomic diversity of sponge associated bacterial communities to assess their utility in facilitating dereplication and prioritization of species of interest for further study.
items.authors: Jarmo-Charles J Kalinski, Tarryn Swart, Idris Njanje, Gabriella Solomons, Dele Abdissa Keneni, Shirley Parker-Nance

items.title: Finding the Right TEMPO: Multi-Objective Virtual Screening and Experimental Validation of TEMPO Derivatives for Aqueous Redox Flow Battery Catholytes
items.abstract: We formulate the discovery of aqueous redox flow battery catholytes as a multi-objective optimization problem and introduce a virtual screening framework that simultaneously considers redox potential, chemical stability, and synthetic accessibility. Applied to a library of 182 TEMPO derivatives, the workflow identified a diverse set of high-ranking candidates, including the previously unexplored methyl carbamate-TEMPO (MC-TEMPO) and diethylamino-TEMPO (DEA-TEMPO). Furthermore, the screening revealed a moderate correlation between redox potential and predicted degradation resistance, indicating an intrinsic trade-off between these properties. For established TEMPO derivatives, the framework reproduced relative performance trends reported within independently studied series. Across the broader library, the highest-ranked candidates reflected a non-intuitive balance of electrochemical performance, stability, and synthetic accessibility rather than optimization of redox potential alone. MC-TEMPO and DEA-TEMPO were subsequently synthesized and experimentally characterized, providing a prospective test of the computational predictions. Cyclic voltammetry validated the redox potential predictions, with measured values closely matching the calculated values. During 130 h potentiostatic holds under sustained oxidizing conditions, MC-TEMPO showed no measurable electrochemical or molecular degradation, whereas DEA-TEMPO underwent a substituent-specific degradation pathway not captured by the initial screening model. Together, these results show that multi-objective catholyte discovery can prioritize molecules that would be overlooked by redox-potential optimization alone and provides a framework for the computationally guided design of organic redox flow battery catholytes.
items.authors: Daniel Willimetz, Žak Ruben Šinkovec, Jan Hamaekers, Alexei Lapkin, Abhishek Khetan

items.title: TKitOC PRO v8+: An Interactive Cloud-Based Platform Integrating Target Discovery and Chemoinformatics Workflows
items.abstract: The transition from biological target identification to structure-based molecular analysis commonly requires researchers to combine multiple software environments, file formats, and external web services. This fragmentation can increase preprocessing effort and create practical barriers for computational biology education and early-stage in silico research. Here, we present TKitOC PRO v8+, an interactive cloud-based platform designed to integrate sequence analysis, molecular diagnostics, structural data preparation, and chemoinformatics workflows within a unified graphical interface deployed through Google Colab. The platform unifies the in silico workflow by distributing functionalities across 13 modular tabs organized into two core pipelines. The Target Discovery and Molecular Diagnostics pipeline provides nucleotide and protein sequence processing, open reading frame analysis across six frames, codonpreference back-translation, automated primer design through Primer3, in silico primer specificity assessment using NCBI BLASTn, and protein functional annotation via InterPro coupled with an immediate local motif-based Fast-Track algorithm. The Structure and Chemoinformatics pipeline integrates molecular descriptor calculation through RDKit, structural visualization with py3Dmol, ligand extraction and format preparation, and automated assembly of receptor–ligand complexes via DockPrime from externally generated docking outputs. As a proof-of-concept case study, we applied the platform to the KPC-2 carbapenemase—a critical antimicrobial resistance determinant from the ESKAPE group—using the crystallographic structure PDB 2OV5. The workflow started from the deposited protein sequence, verified taxonomic identity via BLASTn identified the Class Aβ-lactamase target, generated a corresponding nucleotide representation through back-translation, assessed sequence correspondence through BLASTn, generated candidate primer pairs targeting the blaKPC gene, and connected the resulting target characterization with functional annotation and structural analysis. The resulting workflow demonstrates how TKitOC PRO v8+ can reduce manual transitions between heterogeneous computational tools and provide an accessible environment for bioinformatics and chemoinformatics training and preliminary research workflows.
items.authors: Angel Eduardo Nava-Saldivar, Jonnathan Guadalupe Santillán-Benítez

items.title: In-column Synthesis and Atomic-resolution Electron Microscopic Analysis of Metastable Reactive Nitrides
items.abstract: Metastable and air-sensitive compounds are challenging to synthesize and characterize because their formation often requires harsh conditions and their structures can rapidly evolve upon exposure to the environment. Here, we demonstrate that a high-vacuum environment inside a transmission electron microscope (TEM) column can serve simultaneously as a reaction platform and an atomic-scale analytical tool for generating and interrogating such materials. Electron-beam irradiation on sodium azide (NaN3) produces crystalline sodium nitride (Na3N) at room temperature, despite the conventional decomposition of NaN3 into sodium and nitrogen. The formation of Na3N is supported by high-resolution TEM, electron diffraction, and energy dispersive X-ray spectroscopy, which reveal correlated structural and compositional changes through irradiation. The resulting Na3N subsequently undergoes oxidation through an amorphous intermediate to form polycrystalline Na2O. The high-vacuum environment sufficiently suppresses this reaction to resolve its otherwise unachievable microscopic mechanisms. Extending this approach to potassium azide (KN3), we observe a transient crystalline phase that is most consistently indexed as K3N, a nitride known to be thermally unstable even under room temperature. Its transient appearance and decay indicate a dynamic balance between electron-beam-induced formation and degradation. These results establish in-column electron-beam chemistry as a route to metastable nitride formation while enabling multimodal characterization of highly reactive products. More broadly, this strategy offers a means of exploring nonequilibrium metastable compounds that are difficult to access using conventional synthesis and characterization workflows.
items.authors: Masaya Sakakibara, Koji Harano, Ryusei Kudo, Jun Kawano, Tomoya Yamazaki, Yuki Kimura

items.title: Solid-state Electron Transfer Mechanism Study in Mechanochemistry through Time-Resolved Multimodal Monitoring
items.abstract: Mechanochemical reactions can access unusual and useful reactivity, but the electron-transfer steps that govern many of these mechanochemical transformations have remained difficult for time-resolved monitoring. Here we establish a time-resolved strategy for resolving mechanochemical electron transfer by integrating in-situ powder X-ray diffraction with ex-situ quantitative electron paramagnetic resonance, solid-state nuclear magnetic resonance, and magnetometry. Using the formation of a sodium anion complex (sodide) as a model reaction, we show that a mechanically driven disproportionation proceeds through a stepwise pathway involving an electride intermediate. This finding provides direct mechanistic insight into how electrons move through reactive solids under mechanochemical condition. More broadly, it establishes a general experimental blueprint for identifying electronically distinct transient intermediates in mechanochemical redox chemistry.
items.authors: Huanxin Zhang, Nathan Davison, Tomislav Stolar, Floriana Tuna, Conrad A. P. Goodwin, Franziska Emmerling

items.title: Microstate-Aware Excited-State Descriptors Improve Scaffold-Robust Prediction of Drug Phototoxicity
items.abstract: Drug phototoxicity depends on electronically excited states whose energies and intensities can change with protonation, tautomerism, and conformation, yet most predictive models represent a single parent structure. We evaluated a molecular-state-aware workflow on a curated 450-compound in vitro photoirritation (PIV) benchmark expanded to 1,088 microstates. Across 10 repeated 5-fold scaffold-held-out cross-validations, mean ROC-AUC increased from 0.745 for structure alone to 0.792 after adding parent xTB+sTDA descriptors, 0.807 with microstate summaries, and 0.808 with conformer aggregation; PR-AUC increased from 0.669 to 0.727. Compound-paired bootstrap analysis gave a full-model ROC-AUC gain of +0.0569 (95% CI 0.0234-0.0908) and PR-AUC gain of +0.0533 (0.0133-0.0933). Higher-level Q-Chem calculations preserved screening excited-state ordering (S1 Pearson r = 0.946; T1 r = 0.931), and an additional preselected state panel completed 22/24 TDA jobs with all four parent-alternate microstate pairs available. These pairs showed substantial state-dependent changes, including a 240.4 to 259.0 nm bright-state shift for trinexapac-ethyl. Clinical PIH endpoint transfer was modest (n = 155; ROC-AUC 0.609), consistent with endpoint and chemical-space shift. The results support molecular-state-aware excited-state featurization as a mechanistically grounded strategy for computational photosafety.
items.authors: Aris Tsai

items.title: Health risk assessment of carcinogenic and non-carcinogenic heavy metal exposure from commercial instant noodles in Bangladesh: a deterministic and probabilistic evaluation for adults and children
items.abstract: The contribution of the instant noodle cake itself to dietary heavy metal exposure in Bangladesh has not been quantified. Nine metals (Pb, Cd, Cr, Fe, Mn, Zn, Cu, Ni and Co) were determined by flame atomic absorption spectrometry in eight leading brands (102 packets) from Dhaka, Rajshahi and Khulna, seasoning sachet excluded. The hazard index (HI) and total cancer risk (TCR) were estimated for adults and children at national-average (0.36 g day -1 ) and high-consumption (25.6 g day -1 ) ingestion rates, with uncertainty propagated by bootstrap Monte Carlo simulation. Mean concentrations ranged from 17.7 mg kg -1 (Fe) to 0.030 mg kg -1 (Cd), and all brands complied with the Codex and Bangladeshi limits for Pb, Cd and Ni. No THQ exceeded 1; HI was 0.003 (adults) and 0.010 (children) at average intake and 0.19 and 0.71 at high intake, with Co contributing half of the HI. TCR was tolerable (10 -6 to 10 -4 ) at average intake but reached 9.8 × 10 -5 for high consuming adults and 3.7 × 10 -4 for high-consuming children, exceeding 10 -4 in 34% and 83% of simulations; Ni and Cr accounted for 95% of the cancer risk. Regulatory compliance therefore does not ensure negligible risk for frequent child consumers, and the risk-driving metals are those without a maximum level. Comparison with studies of noodles analyzed with their sachets indicates that the sachet, not the cake, is the main Pb source. Risk-based surveillance of Cr, Ni and Co, harmonization of the national standard with Codex, and control of sachet ingredients are recommended.
items.authors: Debneela Paul, Sagar Bhowmik, Sheikh Mohiuddin Samrat, Sayed M. A. Salam

items.title: Enantioselective Strain-Release Formal (3 + 3) Cycloaddition of 1-Azabicyclo[1.1.0]butanes to Chiral 1,4-Diazabicyclo[3.1.1]heptanes via Relay Dy/Ir Catalysis
items.abstract: *Email: nowmiracle@zjnu.edu.cn; dengwp827@zjnu.edu.cn ABSTRACT: Pyrazines and piperazines are privileged 1,4-diaza motifs, yet neither combines conformational rigidity with a stereochemically defined three-dimensional shape. Here we report the first catalytic enantioselective formal (3 + 3) cycloaddition of 1-azabicyclo[1.1.0]butanes (ABBs), providing direct access to enantioenriched 1,4diazabicyclo[3.1.1]heptanes—rigid, C(sp3)-rich scaffolds that serve as chiral three-dimensional complements to these classical motifs. Relay Dy/Ir catalysis merges Dy(OTf)3-promoted ABB strain release with iridium-catalyzed asymmetric allylic amination of allylamine-derived N,C,C synthons, extending ABB chemistry beyond conventional strain-release functionalization and previously reported racemic cycloadditions. The method furnishes 50 examples in up to 93% yield and 99% ee, with broad functional-group tolerance and compatibility with drug- and natural-product-derived substrates. Control experiments, 1H NMR studies, and DFT calculations support a staged mechanism involving carbonyl-assisted N,O-bidentate activation of the ABB by Dy(OTf)3. Preparative-scale synthesis, orthogonal product diversification, and access to pyrazineand piperazine-related drug analogues demonstrate the synthetic versatility and scaffold-hopping potential of this platform.
items.authors: Jun-Cheng Jin, Jian Zhang, Qi-Guo Zheng, Hanliang Zheng, Wei-Ping Deng

items.title: Polyanion-Based Compounds for Rechargeable Magnesium Batteries
items.abstract: Rechargeable magnesium metal batteries represent a compelling post-lithium energy storage technology owing to the abundance of terrestrial magnesium reserves, their current cost-effectiveness and intrinsically higher safety relative to lithium systems, coupled with their capacity to deliver high volumetric energy density. However, this promise and beyond remains constrained by the stringent requirement that rapid and reversible Mg 2+ transport can be achieved in concert with electrochemical and thermodynamic stability across both electrodes and electrolytes. Within this context, polyanion compounds, such as phosphates, silicates, and borates, have emerged as a pedagogically rich and technologically versatile class of materials. Polyanion-based compounds offer high redox voltages, exceptional thermal and chemical robustness, and a plethora of crystallographic chemistries that permit rational tuning of Mg 2+ migration pathways. This Review surveys polyanion-based positive electrodes and solid electrolytes for rechargeable magnesium batteries, with emphasis on computational prediction, mechanistic elucidation, synthetic methodology, advanced structural and spectroscopic characterisation, and the prospects for all- solid-state magnesium batteries capable of operating under high‑temperature conditions.
items.authors: Titus Masese, Godwill Mbiti Kanyolo

items.title: Acoustic-assisted HDX-MS for Intact Virion Analysis
items.abstract: Hydrogen-deuterium exchange mass spectrometry (HDX-MS) enables solution-phase characterization of protein interactions and conformational dynamics, but analysis of intact enveloped virions remains challenging because limited proteolytic accessibility restricts peptide recovery. Here, we developed an acoustic-assisted HDX-MS workflow integrating chemical denaturation with bath sonication during quenching and applied it to dengue virus serotype 2 (DENV2) strain D2Y98P. The workflow achieved sequence coverages of 96.0 ± 0.7%, 89.8 ± 0.8% and 87.1 ± 1.0% for the capsid (C), envelope (E) and membrane (M) proteins, respectively. Model peptide measurements showed comparable back-exchange between sonication and incubation at matched durations, although longer treatment increased deuterium loss. Improved E protein coverage enabled characterization of changes in deuterium uptake associated with binding of the neutralizing antibody 2D22. Protected regions overlapped spatially with the cryo-EM-defined quaternary interface, while additional protection occurred in regions remote from direct antibody contact. These findings are consistent with antibody-associated conformational stabilization extending beyond the binding interface. Acoustic-assisted HDX-MS therefore improves structural protein coverage and complements cryo-EM by revealing peptide-level changes in antibodyassociated protein dynamics in the intact virion context.
items.authors: Li Ching Pang, Ying Deng, Vinayak Gupta, Wen Zheng Lo, Shuangshuang Zhu, Muen Shan

items.title: Molecular Dynamics Studies of Model Ionizable Lipids in an mRNA Vaccine
items.abstract: Effective COVID-19 mRNA vaccines encapsulate nucleoside-modified messenger ribonucleic acid (mRNA), which encodes the prefusion-stabilized SARS-CoV-2 spike protein, inside lipid nanoparticles. Endosomal acidification motivates the study of ionizable lipid protonation. Here, we isolate how protonation changes hydration, solvent preference, and structural organization of ALC-0315 in simplified model environments. Through molecular dynamics simulations, we identify clear protonation-dependent differences in lipid orientation, hydration, and collective organization across three model systems. At a water/hexane interface, the protonated amine headgroup shows a stronger preference for the aqueous phase, reflecting enhanced interactions with water molecules. In 20-lipid assemblies, the protonated assembly remains more hydrated and aqueous-associated over the simulated trajectory, whereas the neutral assembly migrates toward and spreads along the water/hexane interface. In pure ALC-0315 bilayer simulations, protonation strengthens amine hydration and alters bilayer-scale structural organization, with the observed morphology depending on the pressure-coupling protocol. Collectively, these findings demonstrate how protonation of ionizable amine headgroups can remodel ALC-0315 assemblies through strengthened lipid–water interactions. These simplified systems provide molecular-level insight into protonation-dependent ALC-0315 behavior, while not directly modeling the full multicomponent LNP, the endosomal membrane, or mRNA release.
items.authors: Mohsen Farshad, Jayendran C. Rasaiah

items.title: Thermodynamics and Accurate Solubilities of Lithium and Sodium Salts in Imidazolium-Based Ionic Liquids
items.abstract: Determining the solubility of metal salts in ionic liquids is challenging using visual methods or Differential Scanning Calorimetry (DSC). The slow crystallization kinetics of the metal salts impede accurate Solid-Liquid Equilibrium (SLE) measurements, resulting in significant discrepancies in the limited available literature. We propose Isothermal Titration Calorimetry (ITC) as an alternative technique to measure the solubility of metal salts in ionic liquids at different temperatures. Some new solubility data of lithium and sodium salts in imidazolium ionic liquid were determined. We show how the ITC experiments not only provide accurate solubility data at the studied temperatures but also reveal key thermodynamic properties of dissolution, including the enthalpy of dissolution; the mixing enthalpy and the partial molar excess enthalpy of both components at saturation.
items.authors: Guillaume Depraetère, Nithavong Cam, Agílio Pádua, Margarida Costa Gomes

items.title: Overriding Intrinsic Regioselectivity in Propargylic Substitution via Cu/Pd Synergistic Catalysis for Enantioselective Dienylation
items.abstract: Propargylic substitution is a fundamental strategy in asymmetric catalysis for constructing enantioenriched unsaturated molecules, yet the dienylation pathway via nucleophilic attack at the central carbon of propargyl/allenyl-metal intermediates has remained elusive. Here we report that Cu/Pd synergistic catalysis enables the first catalytic asymmetric dienylation with broad carbon nucleophiles, delivering enantioenriched 1,3‑dienes with exceptional levels of regioselectivity ( 20:1), enantioselectivity (up to 99% ee), and E/Z selectivity ( 20:1). Mechanistic and DFT studies establish distinct roles for the two metals: palladium governs regiocontrol, while the chiral copper complex is responsible for enantioselectivity, enabling complementary dienylation with high regio- and enantioselectivity. Stronger palladium–terminal-carbon interactions make terminal attack energetically costly and direct the regioselective reaction to the central carbon of the π-propargyl-Pd complex, thereby overriding the inherent preference for propargylation and allenylation. The synthetic utility is demonstrated by diverse transformations of the enantioenriched diene products, thereby enabling the rapid assembly of complex molecular architectures. Beyond providing a general strategy for reprogramming the innate regioselectivity of π‑propargyl chemistry, this work highlights the potential of bimetallic synergistic catalysis as a practical platform for tackling long‑standing selectivity challenges in asymmetric synthesis.
items.authors: Yuxuan Shi, Yue Shi, Yun Zhang, Yongzhi Chen, Haowen Tang, Mengfu Dai

items.title: Capturing the Effect of Exact Exchange in Thio-Michael Additions with a Machine-Learned Functional at Meta-GGA Cost
items.abstract: Semilocal density-functional approximations fail to describe the formation of anionic enolates in thio-Michael additions, the bond-forming step of covalent-inhibitor warheads; range-separated hybrids, which reintroduce long-range exact exchange, are required. Across the published CCSD(T)validated reaction pathways of eight warheads, we show that Skala—a deep-learned semilocal functional containing no exact exchange—matches the range-separated hybrid reference for the activation barriers, enolate geometries and relaxed reactant structures, outperforming the global hybrid B3LYP at meta-GGA cost. The one signature it does not reproduce is the orbital one: its Koopmans ionization potential stays at the semilocal scale, because the ionization-potential theorem constrains the exchange potential, not the energy. Skala thus captures the effect of exact exchange in the total energy, from training data alone.
items.authors: Connor Williamson, Ross Amory, David M. Rogers, Katherine Inzani, Jonathan D. Hirst

items.title: A Flexible Framework for Course-Based Undergraduate Research Experiences
items.abstract: Course-based undergraduate research experiences (CUREs) broaden access to the high-impact practice of undergraduate research. Unfortunately, many faculty lack a clear roadmap for developing a CURE. To address this barrier, we present a series of modular activities, the CURE "Flexi-Framework", which guides faculty through the process of creating a CURE based on their own research. Within the framework, students progress through four phases of scientific research: (I) Obtaining, Evaluating, and Organizing Information; (II) Asking Questions and Planning Investigations; (III) Investigation, Data Analysis, and Iteration; and (IV) Justification and Communication through a written report and/or oral presentation. Each phase consists of assessable, workshop-style activities that can be adapted to different research topics while maintaining the CURE-defining elements of collaboration, discovery and relevance, and iteration. Over the past decade, the Flexi-Framework has been used to implement multiple upper-division CUREs across three institutions and several subdisciplines of chemistry. Assessment using the Classroom Undergraduate Research Experience Survey and the Laboratory Course Assessment Survey demonstrates student-reported gains and course design elements consistent with national CURE benchmarks. The CURE Flexi-Framework thus provides a validated, adaptable pathway for integrating research into coursework, lowering the barrier to adopting CUREs across institutional and disciplinary contexts.
items.authors: Kathryn L. Haas, Jennifer Fishovitz, Michael J. Drummond, William C. Pfalzgraff, LeeAnn M. Sager-Smith

items.title: BULK VERSUS SURFACE CHARGE RECOMBINATION KINETICS IN POLYMER HETEROJUNCTION NANOPARTICLE PHOTOCATALYST DISPERSIONS
items.abstract: Organic donor-acceptor heterojunction nanoparticles have emerged as promising photocatalysts for solar hydrogen production, combining efficient light harvesting, donor-acceptor charge separation, and the generation of long-lived charge carriers. However, the identity of the charge populations responsible for photocatalytic turnover remains unresolved. Here, we study photogenerated polarons in aqueous oligo(ethylene glycol)-functionalized IDTBT:IDTBR-based heterojunction nanoparticles using transient absorption spectroscopy (TAS) and photoinduced absorption spectroscopy (PIAS) to probe, respectively, the transient polarons generated under pulsed excitation and long-lived polarons that accumulate under continuous illumination. By directly correlating spectroscopic signatures with photocatalytic hydrogen evolution, we show that the steady-state PIAS response tracks photocatalytic activity, establishing long-lived accumulated charges as the reactive population governing photocatalytic turnover. Excitation-fluence studies further demonstrate that the contrasting TAS and PIAS responses originate from distinct trapped-charge populations, with decay times at matched charge densities being five orders of magnitude faster for TAS compared to PIAS. We attribute the exceptionally long lifetimes measured in PIAS to the synergistic effects of donor-acceptor charge separation, progressive trap filling under continuous illumination, and dielectric stabilisation provided by the aqueous glycol-functionalized environment, which together suppress charge recombination and enable long-lived charge accumulation under operating conditions. These findings identify operando PIAS as a powerful approach for probing catalytically relevant charge populations and provide mechanistic design principles for engineering organic semiconductor photocatalysts with enhanced solar fuel performance.
items.authors: Soranyel Gonzalez-Carrero, Jan Kosco, Chen Zhang, Michael Sachs, Teng Fei, Iain McCulloch

items.title: Testing for the presence of Endocrine Disrupting Chemicals in Locally Available Perfumes in Pakistan Through GC-MS Analysis and Implications for Public Health Policy
items.abstract: Introduction Many conventional perfumes contain Endocrine Disrupting Chemicals (EDCs) like phthalates, synthetic musk, and parabens – often hidden under the ingredient label ‘fragrance’ or ‘parfum.’ Daily exposure to EDCs, through inhalation and skin contact, is very harmful, resulting in multiple health issues in infants, children, and adolescents undergoing critical developmental stages. In Pakistan, consumers remain considerably unaware, making this a serious problem. Perfumes are typically produced by unauthorised local manufacturers who do not follow standard protocols. Local brands are not bound by any explicit ingredient labelling laws. Currently, little to no research is done in this area. Methods In the months of March to April 2026, four local perfumes were arbitrarily purchased from the Pakistani consumer market in Lahore. The four perfumes were de-identified them and randomly coded them from 1 to 4. The perfumes were sent to the Industrial Analytical Centre in Karachi and analysed qualitatively and quantitatively using Gas Chromatography-Mass Spectrometry for EDCs. Results Analysis showed that four perfumes contained Citral, three contained hydroxycitronellal, two contained Benzyl Salicylate, and two contained Benzyl Benzoate: all of which are established, potent EDCs and restricted according to the IFRA Standards (51st Amendment). 3 perfumes also had notes of synthetic musk, a strong EDC that is prohibited under the IFRA Standards. One perfume did not mention its ingredient list at the back, a practice that is detrimental to consumer awareness and should not be happening in the first place. Conclusion/Discussion These results, supporting the initial claim, raise a dire need for the government to monitor perfume products in the market. Strict public policy is required to target the lack of awareness by mandating that the packaging clearly indicates the levels of chemicals present. Any perfume containing excessive amounts of chemicals should be restricted for manufacturing and sale.
items.authors: Mehrbano Hussain, Muhammad Hammad Khan

items.title: Excited-State Photophysics Improves Scaffold-Robust Phototoxicity Prediction and Reveals Compound-Specific State Effects
items.abstract: Phototoxicity is controlled by light absorption and access to reactive excited states, but predictive models usually encode only a single ground-state structure. Here, a physically staged representation was evaluated on 450 compounds (192 positive, 258 negative) with 10 repeated five-fold scaffold-grouped cross-validations. Structure alone gave ROC-AUC 0.745 ± 0.018 and PR-AUC 0.668 ± 0.027. Adding parent-state xTB/sTDA photophysics increased these metrics to 0.792 ± 0.012 and 0.716 ± 0.020; microstate aggregation reached 0.807 ± 0.012 and 0.726 ± 0.017, while conformer expansion plateaued at 0.808 ± 0.010 and 0.729 ± 0.017. In 10,000 paired compound bootstraps, the largest robust ranking increment was the structure-to-parent-photophysics step (ΔROC-AUC +0.0457, 95% CI +0.0274 to +0.0643). Microstates produced a smaller rank-based increment but reduced Brier error by 0.0080 (95% CI 0.0024–0.0134). Higher-level Q-Chem calculations preserved S1/T1 ordering (r = 0.946/0.931). Matched-state calculations showed large photophysical changes for avobenzone and 2-ethylanthraquinone but weak changes for pradofloxacin and ketoprofen. The results identify excited-state information as the dominant reproducible addition beyond structure and show that molecular-state effects are chemically meaningful but heterogeneous rather than universally accuracy-enhancing.
items.authors: Aris Tsai

items.title: Impact of Structural Water on Ionic Conductivity in Hydridoborates Solid Electrolytes
items.abstract: Sodium closo-hydridoborates have emerged as promising solid-state electrolytes for Na-ion batteries because of their high ionic conductivity and electrochemical stability. However, their sensitivity to water makes them challenging to scale-up. In this work, we systematically investigate the impact of controlled hydration on the structure, ion transport, and interfacial stability of an anion-mixed hydridoborate, Na4(B10H10)0.5(B12H12)0.5. By exposing the hydridoborate to varying degrees of relative humidity (RH) of 30-70%, we find that hydration at 30% enables retention of its moderate Na-ion conductivity (∼0.7 mS/cm) while higher hydration levels lead to the separation of the two anions ([B10H10] 2− and [B12H12] 2−), resulting in significant disruption in the Na ion conduction pathways. X-ray diffraction (XRD) and solid-state nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) measurements indicate that hydration leads to the formation of distinct crystalline phases and alters the local ion coordination environments. The hydrated phase at 30% RH reversibly returns the original structure, restoring its ionic conductivity and compatibility with Na metal anodes. These findings provide insights into the role of structural water in Na-ion transport and a practical strategy for the use of moisturesensitive closo-hydridoborates solid state electrolytes.
items.authors: Hyeongjun Koh, Venkata Surya Chaitanya Kolluru, J. David Bazak, Yiteng Zheng, Tiffany L. Kinnibrugh, Bruce E. Koel

items.title: Parahydrogen-induced 15N polarization of nitrate ion
items.abstract: Parahydrogen-induced polarization (PHIP) represents a cost-effective hyperpolarization technique providing dramatic increase of the NMR spectroscopy sensitivity. In particular, hyperpolarized metabolites are employed in various in vivo applications, including cancer diagnostics and grading. In this proof-of-concept study, we present an extension of the PHIP methodology to a key nitrogenous metabolite, the nitrate anion. We report an approach for the production of hyperpolarized nitrate solutions utilizing PHIP by means of the side-arm hydrogenation of propargyl nitrate ester. Through the sequential optimization of hydrogenation, polarization transfer, and hydrolysis procedures, we obtained hyperpolarized nitrate anion with 15 N polarization levels estimated as 2%.
items.authors: Nazim R. Mustafin, Dudari B. Burueva, Sergey V. Sviyazov, Nikita V. Chukanov, Alexander A. Guda, Oleg G. Salnikov

items.title: A PN adamantanoid ligand for reticular materials
items.abstract: Three dimensional linkers are rare in MOF chemistry, as are linkers featuring inorganic elements. Here we report the synthesis and characterisation of a novel phosphorus-nitrogen (PN) cage-based tetra-benzoic acid (P4BA4) and its use for the synthesis of crystalline framework materials PNMOF-1 and PNHOF-1. These results expand the toolkit of 3-dimensional inorganic linkers beyond the current state of the art defined by carboranes and silsequioxanes.
items.authors: Pinelopi A. Tsami, Ethan Trenaman, Anjali Nambidiyattil, Mohsen Shayan, Saurabh S. Chitnis
items.title_zh: 一种用于网状材料的PN金刚烷配体
items.summary_zh: 在金属有机框架（MOF）化学中，三维连接体和含有无机元素的连接体都较为稀缺。本文报道了一种新型磷氮（PN）笼基四苯甲酸（P4BA4）的合成与表征，并利用其合成了晶体框架材料PNMOF-1和PNHOF-1。这些结果扩展了三维无机连接体的工具箱，超越了目前由碳硼烷和硅氧烷定义的最先进水平。

items.title: Revisiting Artifact Suppression in Electrospray Ionization Deconvolution
items.abstract: Charge state assignment is a critical step in many workflows for intact protein analysis by mass spectrometry. Computational deconvolution algorithms are increasingly used to automate data analysis, but conventional approaches can present artifacts. Here, we explore several approaches to remove artifacts by limiting the charge state assignments for each data point. One approach removes satellite charge states surrounding local maxima. Another removes harmonics at double a more probable charge assignment. The last two limit either the total number of allowed charge state assignments or the minimum relative charge state assignment probability for a given data point. These new features are as effective as the prior SoftMax artifact removal in UniDec, but they enable easier tuning by the user. Although the new set of features introduces additional complexity and an expanded number of parameters, these tools enable users to more precisely reduce artifacts in deconvolution results.
items.authors: Michael T. Marty

items.title: Role of Interfacial Silica in the Local Structure, Strain, and Propane Dehydrogenation Activity of Dispersed Ga3+ Sites
items.abstract: Understanding the structure of the active sites in supported Ga-based propane dehydrogenation (PDH) catalysts is essential, as the Ga–O coordination environment and the nature of neighboring atoms (e.g., Al or Si from SiO2 or Al2O3 supports) strongly influence the catalytic properties. Here, we prepared Ga3+ sites dispersed on Al2O3 and SiOx-Al2O3 supports using atomic layer deposition, tailoring the thickness of the grown SiOx layer and the acidity at the Ga-SiOx-Al2O3 interface. Comparing the propene selectivity and Ga-normalized propene formation rates of the prepared materials reveals that, for the Al2O3 and SiOx-Al2O3 supports, catalytic activity decreases as Si content increases, which correlates with a decrease in the relative abundance of weakly Lewis acidic tetracoordinate Ga3+ sites in the local coordination environment with Al3+ atoms ([4]Ga(Al) and [4]Ga(Al/Si) sites), driving the PDH activity of those catalysts. In comparison, a reference catalyst with Ga3+ sites dispersed on SiO2 is more active and features the highest abundance of strongly Lewis acidic tetracoordinate Ga3+ sites in the local coordination environment of Si4+ atoms ([4]Ga(Si) sites), which drive its PDH activity. Solid-state 71Ga nuclear magnetic resonance studies at ultra-high field (28.2 T) highlight that the distorted coordination geometry of [4]Ga(Si) sites is characteristic of the silica support, and notably less frequent for dispersed [4]Ga(Al) and [4]Ga(Al/Si) sites on alumina and SiOx-Al2O3.
items.authors: Melis Yarar, Zixuan Chen, Yury G. Kolyagin, Olivier Lafon, Alexander V. Yakimov, Christophe Copéret
items.title_zh: 界面硅酸盐在分散Ga3+位点局部结构与丙烷脱氢活性中的作用
items.summary_zh: 理解支持Ga基丙烷脱氢（PDH）催化剂中活性位点的结构至关重要，因为Ga-O配位环境及邻近原子的性质（如来自SiO2或Al2O3支持的Al或Si）对催化性能有显著影响。本研究通过原子层沉积法制备了分散在Al2O3和SiOx-Al2O3支持上的Ga3+位点，调节了生长的SiOx层厚度及Ga-SiOx-Al2O3界面的酸性。比较所制备材料的丙烯选择性和Ga标准化的丙烯生成速率发现，对于Al2O3和SiOx-Al2O3支持，催化活性随着Si含量的增加而降低，这与局部配位环境中弱路易斯酸性四配位Ga3+位点的相对丰度减少相关。相比之下，分散在SiO2上的Ga3+位点的参考催化剂活性更高，且在Si4+原子的局部配位环境中具有最高丰度的强路易斯酸性四配位Ga3+位点。固态71Ga核磁共振研究表明，[4]Ga(Si)位点的扭曲配位几何形状是硅酸盐支持的特征。

items.title: Per-axis failure of the minimum-image convention in GCMC screening of MOFs for hydrogen storage
items.abstract: Grand canonical Monte Carlo (GCMC) simulations underpin machine-learning-accelerated screening of metal–organic frameworks (MOFs) for hydrogen storage, yet published workflows differ widely in simulation rigour. Minimum-image violation in GCMC screening of MOFs biases uptake but preserves rankings, and the error is predictable before any simulation is run. Here, the cost of the single-unit-cell shortcut (one crystallographic cell regardless of the interaction cutoff, violating the minimum-image convention) is quantified across a screening library for the first time. Uptakes of 85 CoRE MOF 2019 frameworks were computed with a converged per-framework supercell protocol and repeated in a single cell. Deliverable capacity rankings are found to be remarkably stable (Spearman ρ = 0.996, bootstrap CI [0.989, 0.998]; top ten recovered exactly, no capacity forfeited), while absolute uptakes fall by up to 30%. The total replication factor m predicts the error poorly: frameworks needing only 4 × 1 × 1 replication lose as much uptake as 36× cases. The error tracks the worst single axis nmax, exposing rod secondary-building-unit frameworks (MOF-74 among them) as the class at risk; intermediate-supercell ladders confirm this directly, the same volume increase recovering 2.4% or 16.4% of the deficit according to which axis receives it. Stated without reference to the cutoff, a single cell is safe for ranking whenever every perpendicular width exceeds one cutoff radius, while absolute capacities require two. Recomputing only the frameworks with nmax ≥ 3, one in three of the set, brings the largest remaining error down to 1.3% while still saving 18% of the campaign
items.authors: Bienvenido P. Montoya, Adam H. Turner

items.title: In situ monitoring of solvent dependent CsPbBr3 nanorod growth from lead halide precursors
items.abstract: CsPbBr 3 nanocrystals are promising semiconductors for numerous optoelectronic applications due to their high quantum yield and impressive tunability. Most recently, one-dimensional perovskite nanorods and nanowires have attracted attention for their advanced luminescence properties such as light polarization and lasing. Such applications require precise morphological and surface chemistry control, both of which are difficult to obtain using conventional synthesis pathways. A novel approach is to use preformed lead halide clusters as nucleation sites, decoupling nucleation and growth to lower dispersity. In this work, we utilize preformed PbBr 2 clusters in 1-octadecene as precursors for anisotropic growth of CsPbBr 3 nanorods. Using in situ UV-Vis absorbance and photoluminescence spectroscopies, we monitored the different morphologies and phases formed during the growth of CsPbBr 3 . We investigate the impact of the solvent on precursor chemistry, final nanorod structure, as well as the growth pathway to reach those structures. Our results show that for growth occurring in toluene, the lead halide precursors are isolated octahedra favoring a classical diffusion mechanism and nanorods with less defined width. When the reaction occurs in 1-octadecene, the precursors form preassembled monolayers, promoting oriented assembly and giving rise to distinct, coexisting, two and three monolayer thick nanorods. Sequential crystallization of Cs 4 PbBr 6 was observed in toluene because of the increasing ligand concentration during nanorod growth. Cs 4 PbBr 6 crystals could then be converted into two monolayer thick nanorods through the addition of a small volume of ethanol. These results shed light on the importance of solvent choice on lead precursor chemistry to obtain homogeneous size-controlled nanorods.
items.authors: Adrien Donatini, Maia Simpson-Russell, Marek Majewski

items.title: Comparative Study of Y2O3, ZnO, and CeO2 Additions to Magnesium Aluminosilicate Glasses: Composition–Structure–Property Relationships
items.abstract: The development of high-modulus glasses is essential for advanced lightweight applications, requiring a fundamental understanding of how different oxide components dictate elastic performance. To maximize stiffness, oxides must be strategically introduced to enhance both network connectivity and volumetric packing density; hence, Y 2 O 3 , ZnO, and CeO 2 are investigated here due to their high single-bond dissociation energies and strong cationic field strengths. Magnesium aluminosilicate glasses (MAS) modified with Y 2 O 3 , ZnO, and CeO 2 were systematically investigated to establish composition–structure–property relationships. A constrained ternary mixture design (Y 2 O 3 –ZnO–CeO 2 = 14 wt.%) was used to span the compositional space efficiently. The measured Young’s modulus ranged from 97.5 to 113.8 GPa, while the specific modulus varied between 36.6 and 41.7 ×10 6 N·m/kg. The highest values were obtained for compositions adding Y 2 O 3 alone or Y 2 O 3 –ZnO. Raman spectroscopy revealed systematic changes in the Si–O stretching band, including shifts in band position and variations in band width depending on composition. These changes indicate structural reorganization of the glass network. A moderate correlation between Raman peak position and Young’s modulus confirms that structural connectivity effects contribute to stiffness, although additional factors such as packing density and cation field strength are also relevant. The results demonstrate that Y 2 O 3 is the most effective oxide for increasing stiffness, ZnO exhibits composition-dependent behaviour, and CeO 2 reduces the specific modulus. The combined analysis provides an experimental and structural basis to designing high-modulus glass systems.
items.authors: Muawia Dafir, Morten M. Smedskjaer, Lars R. Jensen, Holger Cebulla, Martin Kilo

items.title: Scalable Multiplexed Electrochemical Aptasensor Enabled by Chitosan for Heavy Metal Ion Detection: Advancing Electrode Functionalization and Reusability
items.abstract: The rapid and reliable detection of heavy metal ions in water remains a critical challenge for environmental monitoring and public health protection. While recent advances in aptamer-based electrochemical sensors for heavy metal detection emphasize miniaturization and improved electrode modification techniques to achieve higher sensitivity, striking a balance among the sensor's analytical performance, ease of fabrication, and scalability remains a major challenge, often resulting in trade-offs between sensitivity and scalability. Herein, we have developed a sensitive, multi-analyte aptamer-based electrochemical sensor by modifying micro structured electrodes with chitosan, which adheres to their inherent functional groups, thereby simplifying sensor preparation. The target-specific aptamers are immobilized via glutaraldehyde-mediated crosslinking chemistry. Using a differential pulse voltammetry measurement technique the sensitivities of the sensor for specific heavy metals was found to be 21.7, 15.18, and 9.25 ΔI per decade change in concentration per unit area for Pb(II), As(III), and Cd(II), respectively. The limit of detection for the developed sensor is observed to be 1.03 ng/L for Pb(II), 0.45 ng/L for As(III), and 3.03 ng/L for Cd(II) in water. Further, the sensor's reusability has been analysed using a chelation mechanism in combination with potential stripping voltammetry. The sensor was effectively regenerated and reused across four consecutive cycles, thereby reducing the cost per test.
items.authors: Swati Mohanty, Tarun Narayan, Richard Murray, Alan O’Riordan, Shiv Govind Singh
items.title_zh: 基于壳聚糖的可扩展多重电化学适配体传感器用于重金属离子检测
items.summary_zh: 水中重金属离子的快速可靠检测是环境监测和公共健康保护的关键挑战。本文开发了一种敏感的多分析物适配体电化学传感器，通过壳聚糖修饰微结构电极，简化了传感器的制备过程。目标特异性适配体通过戊二醛介导的交联化学固定。采用差分脉冲伏安法测量，传感器对特定重金属的灵敏度分别为Pb(II) 21.7、As(III) 15.18和Cd(II) 9.25 ΔI/十倍浓度变化/单位面积。该传感器的检测限为Pb(II) 1.03 ng/L、As(III) 0.45 ng/L和Cd(II) 3.03 ng/L。此外，传感器的可重复使用性通过配位机制结合电位剥离伏安法进行了分析。

items.title: A Simple Model to Predict Complex Coacervation: Forces as Drivers of Phase Change and Structuration
items.abstract: Biomolecular condensate formation or coacervation has come to the fore as an extremely attractive research area over the past few years, as these condensates have been conjectured to be the most primitive sort of protocells. One of the most studied coacervation process is the complex coacervation between polyelectrolytes and oppositely charged small molecules. Among these structures, a very well tested system is the poly-L-Lysine/Adenosine Tri Phosphate (pLL/ATP) coacervate. To understand the condensation process, one needs to unravel the forces which dictate the behaviour of pLL dispersed in water at various temperatures and for various monomer charge fractions which are positively charged. Unlike most simulations which have been performed for biologically relevant proteins, here we have used an included solvent Monte Carlo approach on 10-bead flexible strands as the model pLL molecules, where each bead stands for 3 lysine monomers. Initially we have established the 10-bead model for pLL molecules. We have shown that at high pH, when the positive charges are largely neutralized due to deprotonation of the amine groups in the lysine monomers, the strands show a clear tendency to form bundles of rigid and vertically elongated pLL molecules driven by intermolecular attractions caused by hydrophobic repulsion from the aqueous medium. On switching off the hydrophobic interaction, we see no bundle formation and the screened coulomb repulsions dominate pushing the strands away from each other, underscoring the essential role of hydrophobic interaction in pLL structuration. We see a similar tendency to move away from each other by keeping the charges fixed at high reduced temperatures as well. These results agree nicely with experimental observations of the different phases of pLL, in particular the formation of fibrils at high pH and room temperature. Once we established the pLL model, we introduced negatively charged single ATP beads. Based on the screened coulomb attractions between the polymers and the molecules, we could predict the crossover point where the repulsive regime gets converted into an overall attractive one leading to nucleation and growth, resulting into coacervation. We could, therefore, correlate the ATP/pLL ratio to the forces dictating the phase separation process – for the first time to the best of our knowledge. Additionally, we could find the radial charge and ATP and pLL bead density distributions which allows us to understand the internal structures of the condensates.
items.authors: Swapnasopan Datta, Biplab Bawali
items.title_zh: 预测复杂共沉淀的简单模型：力作为相变和结构化的驱动因素
items.summary_zh: 生物分子凝聚体的形成或共沉淀近年来成为一个极具吸引力的研究领域，这些凝聚体被推测为最原始的原始细胞之一。复杂共沉淀中，聚电解质与带相反电荷的小分子之间的相互作用是研究较多的过程。我们研究了聚-L-赖氨酸/腺苷三磷酸（pLL/ATP）共沉淀体系。为理解凝聚过程，我们探讨了不同温度和正电荷单体比例下pLL在水中行为的驱动力。采用了包含溶剂的蒙特卡洛方法，模型为10珠柔性链，每珠代表3个赖氨酸单体。结果表明，在高pH条件下，赖氨酸单体的氨基去质子化使正电荷大部分中和，链条倾向于形成刚性且垂直延伸的束状结构，主要由水相介质引起的疏水排斥力驱动。

items.title: TLQ Method: A Tandem Mixing–Linear Deduction–Quantile Weighted Median Framework for Robust Metabolite Screening and a General Diagnostic Indicator for Measurement Reliability
items.abstract: Untargeted metabolomics is constrained by inter-individual variability, difficulty in detecting low-abundance metabolites, and matrix effects. Post-acquisition corrections are limited when biological variation is large, signals approach detection limits, or matrix effects are strong. We propose the TLQ method, consisting of Tandem Mixing, Linear Deduction, and Quantile Quality-Weighted Median. Tandem Mixing compresses between-group matrix differences and enhances low-abundance signals via equal-volume mixing of paired samples. Linear Deduction removes background and back-calculates the treatment signal, yielding a deduced fold change closer to the true treatment-to-control ratio. The third module performs robust screening using a quality-weighted median with Bootstrap confidence intervals. A candidates-of-interest mechanism improves coverage without compromising accuracy. The modules can be deployed flexibly (paired mode, P_R mode, or standalone third module). We also propose a general group-level diagnostic indicator (GDI) framework. GDI compares pooled and individual estimates and normalizes their discrepancy against a stochastic expectation, making systematic distortion quantifiable. GDI is platform-independent and serves as an independent reliability annotation layer in the TLQ method..
items.authors: Teng Teng, Yuchun Lu, Tonglei Qiao, Wei Feng, Chun-E Liu, Feng Liu

items.title: Reading the charge state of hydrogenated nanodiamonds: the 1330 cm-1 Fano feature as an interfacial probe
items.abstract: Hydrogenated nanodiamonds combine unusual electrokinetic charging with electronic properties that are highly sensitive to their surrounding environment, yet the relationship between molecular adsorption, interfacial charge and carrier state remains poorly understood. Here, a homologous series of anionic and cationic surfactants with C3–C16 alkyl chains is used as a controlled molecular perturbation of oxidized and hydrogenated detonation (DND) and high-pressure high-temperature (HPHT) nanodiamonds. By combining ζ-potential measurements, FTIR spectroscopy and electrical transport, we examine how surfactant polarity and chain length affect these chemically and structurally distinct interfaces. Particular attention is given to the ~1330 cm-1 Fano-type infrared feature of HPHT H-ND, which we establish here as a spectroscopic probe of changes in its interfacial electronic state. The comparison reveals a marked contrast between the comparatively electrostatically hard H-DND interface and the electronically responsive HPHT H-ND surface, where molecular interactions can substantially modify the charge-transfer state. More broadly, the results show that molecular adsorption, electrokinetic charge and electronic carrier response need not evolve in parallel, supporting the Fano-type feature as a sensitive readout of molecularly regulated hydrogenated nanodiamond interfaces.
items.authors: Neha Sharma, Ondrej Szabo, Katerina Kolarova, Stepan Stehlik

items.title: From Metal-Organic Precursors to Coalesced Thin Films: A Predictive, End-to-End Atomistic Framework for MOCVD Multilayer TMD Growth
items.abstract: Metal-organic chemical vapor deposition (MOCVD) enables scalable synthesis of layered two-dimensional semiconductors such as transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDs), yet the atomistic mechanisms linking precursor chemistry to multilayer nucleation and film evolution remain elusive, limiting synthesis control. Here, we establish a predictive mechanistic framework for multilayer TMD growth using MoS 2 as a representative system. Combining density functional theory, ReaxFF molecular dynamics, machine learning, and experimental validation, we reveal how metal antisites occupying chalcogen vacancies intrinsically form through surface interactions and serve as transient nucleation centers under experimentally relevant conditions. These defects stabilize epitaxial registry through covalent bonding and ultimately diffuse into the epilayer to form van der Waals interfaces. During this process, H 2 S vapor pressure influences metal-organic precursor decomposition by lowering the complete Mo(CO) 6 decomposition temperature, thereby promoting nucleation-center formation. This framework shifts layered-material synthesis from empirical trial-and-error toward predictive control, providing a computational route for growth of next-generation two-dimensional materials.
items.authors: Matin Salimi Irdmusa, Luca Donati, Fazil Safarov, Yu-Chuan Lin, Yun Kyung Shin, Surahit Chewle
items.title_zh: 从金属有机前驱体到聚合薄膜：MOCVD多层TMD生长的预测性原子框架
items.summary_zh: 金属有机化学气相沉积（MOCVD）能够可扩展地合成层状二维半导体，如过渡金属二硫化物（TMDs），但前驱体化学与多层成核及薄膜演化之间的原子机制仍不明确，限制了合成控制。本文以MoS₂为代表系统，建立了多层TMD生长的预测性机制框架。结合密度泛函理论、ReaxFF分子动力学、机器学习和实验验证，我们揭示了金属反位点如何通过表面相互作用在实验相关条件下形成，并作为瞬态成核中心。这些缺陷通过共价键稳定外延对齐，并最终扩散到外延层形成范德瓦尔斯界面。H₂S蒸气压通过降低Mo(CO)₆的完全分解温度，影响金属有机前驱体的分解，从而促进成核中心的形成。该框架将层状材料合成从经验试错转向预测控制，为下一代二维材料的生长提供了计算途径。

items.title: Deciphering Ionic Conductivity Differences in Linear Carbonate Electrolytes: Conformational Shrinkage and Solvation Structure in Dimethyl vs Diethyl Carbonate
items.abstract: Dimethyl carbonate (DMC)-based electrolytes consistently show higher ionic conductivity than diethyl carbonate (DEC)-based ones despite their comparable viscosities and dielectric constants. Here, classical MD simulations with LiPF 6 as the salt are used to elucidate the molecular origins of this difference. LiPF 6 -DMC electrolytes contain a larger population of solvent-separated ion pairs (SSIPs), whereas LiPF 6 -DEC electrolytes exhibit a higher population of ion aggregates (AGGs). Among various species, SSIPs make the dominant contribution to ionic conductivity, accounting for the higher conductivity of DMC-based electrolytes. Both solvents exist predominantly in two conformations, cis-cis (CC) and cis-trans (CT), defined by the torsional angle about the C-O bond; the former is largely non-polar, while the latter has a substantial dipole moment of nearly 4 D. In both electrolytes, the CT fraction increases with salt concentration, consistent with the stronger ion-dipole interactions of the CT conformer with ions and the fractions are comparable for DMC and DEC. Nevertheless, DMC retains a larger fraction of lithium ions as SSIPs. Although CT-DMC and CT-DEC have nearly identical polarities, more CT-DMC molecules coordinate Li + than CT-DEC molecules do. This difference arises from their distinct conformational sizes: CT-DMC has a volume approximately 8% smaller than that of CC-DMC, whereas the corresponding decrease for DEC is only about 2%. The smaller relative size of CT-DMC permits more of it to coordinate Li + to yield effective electrostatic shielding. This, in turn, leads to a larger SSIP population and higher ionic conductivity of LiPF 6 -DMC relative to LiPF 6 -DEC.
items.authors: Mansi Jain, Sundaram Balasubramanian
items.title_zh: 解析线性碳酸盐电解质中离子导电性差异
items.summary_zh: 尽管二甲基碳酸酯（DMC）和二乙基碳酸酯（DEC）在粘度和介电常数上相似，但基于DMC的电解质的离子导电性始终高于基于DEC的电解质。本文采用经典分子动力学模拟，使用LiPF6作为盐，阐明了这种差异的分子起源。LiPF6-DMC电解质中存在更多的溶剂分离离子对（SSIPs），而LiPF6-DEC电解质则表现出更高的离子聚集体（AGGs）数量。SSIPs对离子导电性贡献最大，解释了DMC电解质更高的导电性。两种溶剂主要以顺式-顺式（CC）和顺式-反式（CT）两种构象存在，前者几乎是非极性的，而后者具有接近4 D的显著偶极矩。随着盐浓度的增加，CT构象的比例在两种电解质中均有所增加，但DMC中保留的锂离子作为SSIPs的比例更大。尽管CT-DMC和CT-DEC的极性几乎相同，但更多的CT-DMC分子与Li+配位，这一差异源于它们不同的构象体积：CT-DMC的体积约小8%。

items.title: Charge-Encoded Anion Sublattices Drive Ordering and Phase Selection in Layered Chalcogenides
items.abstract: Predicting the sites where anions order in a crystal, and when that ordering drives structural rearrangement, remains a challenge in mixed-anion chemistry. Here we show that both are linked to the distribution of charge on the anion sublattice of ACuMIVQ3 chalcogenides. Bader analysis of four competing polymorphs reveals that the sequencing of polyhedra controls the range of charge across anion sites (Δq) and programs each structure with a distinct charge-encoded anion sublattice. Thirteen new mixedchalcogen compounds were prepared, and the anion site occupancies were determined through single crystal X-ray diffraction. While sulfoselenides tend to adopt structures with small Δq, where they form near-ideal solid solutions, greater anion disparity in the selenotellurides and sulfotellurides leads to enhanced ordering, which drives formation of alternate structures with higher Δq. These structures provide terraced charge landscapes with more strongly differentiated sites, suggesting that structure selection depends on how well the anion sublattice matches the chemical disparity of the anion mixture. This trend culminates in KCuZrTeSeS, where S, Se, and Te order across three distinct sites in the Pnma structure, a phase not adopted by any single-anion end member, and the first demonstration of site-selective ordering of all three chalcogens in a single material. An enrichment factor connecting site occupancy with Bader charge further shows that the most electronegative chalcogen in a given mixture preferentially occupies the highest-charge site. Together, the results establish charge-encoded anion sublattices as a framework for predicting anion ordering and phase selection in extended solids.
items.authors: Ayat Tassanov, Huiju Lee, Keela K. Zambre, Pedro R. Trinidad-Pérez, Yi Xia, James M Hodges

items.title: Geminal Metalloid Substituents Enable Stereoselective Geometric Isomerization of Highly Substituted Alkenes via Energy-Transfer Catalysis
items.abstract: Controlling alkene geometry with high stereochemical precision remains a fundamental challenge in synthetic chemistry, particularly for highly substituted systems. Here we report a stereoselective photoisomerization of gem-diborylalkenes in which visible light enables efficient E→Z interconversion of geminal metalloids-substituted carbon–carbon double bonds through a triplet energy-transfer (EnT) mechanism, overcoming the long-standing limitation of stereoselective photoisomerization of highly (tetra)substituted alkenes. A broad range of tri- and tetra-substituted alkenes are converted to the thermodynamically less stable Z-isomer with up to 99:1 selectivity. Mechanistic studies and density functional theory (DFT) calculations reveal that stereocontrol arises from both interplay between excited-state deconjugation due to steric bulkiness and substratephotocatalyst interactions. Sequential functionalizations of both geometrically defined diborylalkene isomers are also demonstrated, enabling the stereodivergent construction of complex stereodefined alkenes. Beyond facilitating stereoselective geometric isomerization of tri- and tetrasubstituted alkenes, this work establishes (gem)-dimetalloid alkenes as light-programmable scaffolds and introduces a general strategy for boron-mediated photochemical control of alkene stereochemistry with implications for molecular and materials design.
items.authors: Nadim Eghbarieh, Nicole Hanania, Brandon E. Haines, Ahmad Masarwa
items.title_zh: 双金属取代烯烃的立体选择性几何异构化研究
items.summary_zh: 控制高立体化学精度的烯烃几何形状仍然是合成化学中的一项基本挑战，尤其是对于高度取代的体系。本文报道了一种双硼烯的立体选择性光异构化，其中可见光通过三重态能量转移机制实现了双金属取代的碳-碳双键的高效E→Z互变，克服了高度（四）取代烯烃的立体选择性光异构化的长期限制。多种三取代和四取代烯烃被转化为热力学上不太稳定的Z-异构体，选择性高达99:1。机理研究和密度泛函理论（DFT）计算表明，立体控制源于由于立体庞大而导致的激发态去共轭与底物-光催化剂相互作用之间的相互作用。此外，本文还展示了几何定义的双硼烯异构体的顺序功能化，促进了复杂立体定义烯烃的立体分歧构建。此研究不仅促进了三取代和四取代烯烃的立体选择性几何异构化，还确立了（双）金属取代烯烃作为光编程支架的应用，提出了一种用于硼介导的烯烃立体化学光控制的通用策略。

items.title: Heterogeneous Catalysts as Electrochemical Cells: Completing the Circuit using Proton Buffers in Nonaqueous Media
items.abstract: Thermochemical redox reactions with heterogeneous catalysts often proceed by an "electrochemical" mechanism that features coupled redox half-reactions. Studies supporting this mechanism have typically been performed with water as the solvent; however, many organic oxidation reactions feature non-aqueous solvent. Here, we analyze the aerobic oxidation of hydroquinone with iron-containing nitrogen-doped carbon (Fe-N-C) catalysts in acetonitrile. Addition of proton buffers significantly accelerates the reaction, and mechanistic data indicate the buffers support proton transfer between the two redox half-reactions, proton-coupled oxidation of the hydroquinone and O2 reduction, which take place at different active sites on the catalyst surface. Kinetic studies of the thermochemical aerobic oxidation reaction are complemented by electrochemical studies, including linear-sweep voltametric analysis of both independent half-reactions. Collectively, the data provide a selfconsistent mechanistic picture that highlights the importance of proton management in supporting thermal heterogeneous catalytic redox reactions in non-aqueous solvent.
items.authors: Patrick Q. Kelly, Woonjin Jang, Ian J. Garvey, James B. Gerken, Shannon S. Stahl

items.title: GCCDDCs Enable Tumor-Selective Lysosomal Degradation and Payload Delivery via GC-C-Mediated Trafficking
items.abstract: Degrader–drug conjugates (DDCs) represent an emerging class of therapeutic agents that integrate the mechanism of targeted protein degradation with enhanced drug delivery, offering a promising strategy for precision cancer therapy. We herein report the rational design of GC-C–targeted degrader–drug conjugates (GCCDDCs), a bifunctional modality that promotes selective PD-L1 degradation while concurrently delivering a cytotoxic payload to GC-C–expressing cancer cells. Utilizing the GC-C agonist linaclotide as a targeting moiety, we first engineered GC-C–mediated lysosome-targeting chimeras (GCCTACs), which effectively induced degradation of both extracellular and membranebound proteins in a selective manner. By conjugating a PD-L1-targeting degrader to the microtubule-disrupting agent MMAE, the resulting GCCDDCs exhibit potent antitumor efficacy through coordinated immune checkpoint degradation and direct cytotoxicity. The development of GCCDDCs expands the pharmacological toolbox for targeted protein degraders (TPDs) and X–drug conjugates (XDCs), thereby offering broad utility in chemical
items.authors: Yi Zhou, Tengfei Liu, Huaihuai Shi, Xiaozhuo Tan, Hui Pan, Wenyan Dong

items.title: An Ab Initio-Kinetic Framework for Predicting Electrochemical Passivation of Materials
items.abstract: Recent years have seen a strong push towards data-driven discovery of materials in many areas, from structural alloys to energy devices to quantum materials. However, many applications involve prolonged exposure to aqueous and/or acidic electrochemical conditions that can promote material degradation. Despite the critical role of stability in determining material performance, there is a lack of models that are capable of predicting a material’s corrosion-passivation behavior without relying on empirical parameters or fitting. In this work, we address this gap by developing an ab initio kinetic model (AKM), which integrates an existing empirical passivation growth theory, the Point Defect Model (PDM), into a non-empirical first principles-based framework. We redefine the five primary inputs of the PDM, previously ad hoc or experimentally-fitted, into ab initio -calculable parameters, entirely removing their empirical dependence. We then apply AKM to predict the passivation growth of six common metal-film systems. In comparison to experiments reported in the literature, we obtain a strong qualitative trend and reproduce the correct orders of magnitude, without any a priori experimental inputs. We further investigate passive-film formation in the Cu-CuO x system through a detailed computational case study, establishing guidelines for selecting appropriate surface terminations, oxygen vacancy configurations, and point defect concentrations. Sensitivity analyses further reveal that, within the PDM framework, the electrical driving force has a greater influence on passive-film growth than the chemical driving force. This work represents a vital step towards the development of high-throughput predictive modeling of materials’ electrochemical stability in applications where materials are exposed to aqueous media.
items.authors: Rachel Gorelik, Arunima K. Singh
items.title_zh: 基于第一性原理的材料电化学钝化预测框架
items.summary_zh: 近年来，材料的数据驱动发现受到广泛关注，尤其是在结构合金、能源设备和量子材料等领域。然而，许多应用面临长时间暴露于水性和/或酸性电化学环境下，可能导致材料降解。尽管稳定性在材料性能中至关重要，但缺乏能够预测材料腐蚀-钝化行为的模型，而不依赖于经验参数或拟合。本文开发了一种基于第一性原理的动力学模型（AKM），将现有的经验钝化生长理论——点缺陷模型（PDM）整合到非经验的框架中。我们将PDM的五个主要输入重新定义为可通过第一性原理计算的参数，完全消除了经验依赖性。通过AKM，我们预测了六种常见金属薄膜系统的钝化生长，与文献中的实验结果相比，获得了强烈的定性趋势，并重现了正确的数量级，而无需任何先验实验输入。我们进一步通过详细的计算案例研究了Cu-CuO x系统中的钝化膜形成，为选择合适的表面终止提供了指导。

items.title: Optimizing mechanical properties and ionic conductivity of hybrid hydrogel electrolytes for flexible zinc-ion batteries
items.abstract: Wearable electronics require energy storage systems that combine mechanical flexibility, safety, and electrochemical performance, making aqueous zinc-ion batteries using hydrogel polymer electrolytes (HPEs) a promising approach. However, achieving hydrogels with both high mechanical toughness and ionic conductivity remains a major challenge. Herein, a zwitterionic poly(sulfobetaine methylacrylate)-tetraethylene glycol dimethacrylate (PSBMA-EG) hydrogel was combined with a silica network to form an organic/inorganic hybrid electrolyte. The results demonstrated the successful synthesis and cross-linking of the organic and inorganic networks using 3-(trimethoxysilyl)propyl methacrylate (TMSPMA) as a coupling agent. The acrylate-to-silica ratio (Ac:Si), as the composition-dependency, was varied to investigate its effect on the morphology, swelling behaviour, and glass transition temperature of the obtained hydrogels. Typically, increasing the Ac:Si ratio resulted in more homogeneous and porous structures with higher water uptake. The mechanical and electrochemical properties were evaluated using uniaxial compression and electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS), respectively. The HPE with the optimized combination of properties was obtained at an Ac:Si ratio of 2:1, exhibiting a toughness of 152.41 ± 30.12 kJ m –3 and an ionic conductivity of 118.01 ± 28.04 mS cm –1 .
items.authors: Iben Edelbo Lauritzen, Jonas Klarskov Nielsen, Patrick Ullits Pilgaard, Phillip Dyran, Hanne Colding Bundgaard, Mikkel Vinkler Kristensen
items.title_zh: 优化混合水凝胶电解质的机械性能与离子导电性以用于柔性锌离子电池
items.summary_zh: 可穿戴电子设备需要具备机械灵活性、安全性和电化学性能的能量存储系统，水性锌离子电池采用水凝胶聚合物电解质（HPEs）是一种有前景的方法。然而，实现高机械韧性和离子导电性的水凝胶仍然是一个主要挑战。本研究中，采用两性离子聚（磺基甜菜碱甲基丙烯酸酯）-四乙烯醇二甲基丙烯酸酯（PSBMA-EG）水凝胶与硅氧烷网络结合，形成有机/无机混合电解质。结果表明，使用3-(三甲氧基硅基)丙基甲基丙烯酸酯（TMSPMA）作为偶联剂成功合成并交联了有机和无机网络。通过改变丙烯酸酯与硅的比例（Ac:Si），研究其对水凝胶形态、膨胀行为和玻璃转变温度的影响。通常，增加Ac:Si比例会导致更均匀和多孔的结构，水吸收量更高。通过单轴压缩和电化学阻抗谱（EIS）评估了机械和电化学性能。优化的HPE在Ac:Si比例为2:1时获得，表现出152.41 ± 30.12 kJ m –3的韧性和118.01 ± 28.04 mS cm –1的离子导电性。

items.title: Three-dimensional fluorescence lifetime imaging of a molecular rotor at complex interfaces of grease
items.abstract: Fluorescence lifetime imaging microscopy (FLIM) maps local physicochemical properties on a confocal laser-scanning microscope. Soft materials are a promising target for FLIM, given their demand for multi-scale microanalysis; of particular interest are the interfacial properties of complex fluids, which remain underexplored. Here, we demonstrate three-dimensional FLIM mapping at complex interfaces of grease as a model system. In grease, tens-of-nanometer-scale thickener fibers form a three-dimensional network in the base oil, and the extent to which fiber–oil interactions alter the local oil properties is an open question. Our bulk measurements confirm that the fluorescence lifetime of a molecular-rotor dye dissolved in the oil is coupled to the local viscosity. Three-dimensional FLIM reveals that the lifetime of the molecular rotor significantly increases at the fiber–oil interfaces. Phasor analysis and pixel-level fitting show that the interfacial state arrests the rotation of the molecular rotor, so the interface is solid-like rather than viscous. Its physicochemical origin may offer a new handle for designing grease materials. Beyond the ~200 nm resolution of our images, the lifetime-domain separation of the two states resolves their coexistence within a single diffraction-limited voxel. Three-dimensional high-resolution FLIM will broaden the mapping of interfacial properties in soft complex materials.
items.authors: Hideyo Tsurusawa, Ryo Shibata, Masaki Watanabe, Minami Soma, Takashi Nogi
items.title_zh: 三维荧光寿命成像研究润滑脂复杂界面分子转子的特性
items.summary_zh: 荧光寿命成像显微镜（FLIM）能够在共聚焦激光扫描显微镜上绘制局部物理化学特性。软材料是FLIM的一个重要研究对象，尤其是复杂流体的界面特性尚未得到充分探索。本文以润滑脂为模型系统，展示了三维FLIM在其复杂界面上的应用。在润滑脂中，纳米级增稠纤维在基础油中形成三维网络，纤维与油的相互作用如何影响局部油的性质仍是一个未解之谜。我们的实验结果表明，溶解在油中的分子转子染料的荧光寿命与局部粘度相关。三维FLIM显示，分子转子在纤维-油界面处的寿命显著增加，表明界面状态抑制了分子转子的旋转，表现出固态特性而非粘性。这一物理化学特性可能为润滑脂材料的设计提供新思路。

items.title: Chemical tuning of framework libration as a design principle for Na-oxide superionic conductors
items.abstract: Most design principles for superionic conductors (SICs) are derived from known SICs and evaluated on static structures, which can miss transport enabled by finite-temperature framework motion. Both limitations are particularly severe for Na-oxides, a low-cost, stable chemistry with only a few known SIC frameworks. Here we establish a Na-oxide design principle that links local Na-site geometry to framework dynamics using chemical substitution and compositional modification strategies. Using molecular dynamics simulations with a Na-oxide-specialized machine-learning interatomic potential, we screen all 8,504 Na-oxides in the Materials Project and identify six superionic frameworks, four of them previously unreported. The highest extrapolated room-temperature conductivity reaches 29 mS cm -1 . We identify a finite-temperature Na-site size window of 1.2–1.5 Å that favors Na hopping and show that the framework motion required to access this window depends on the initial geometry: larger-amplitude libration opens initially small sites, whereas smaller-amplitude libration preserves initially larger sites. Thus, stronger framework motion is not universally favorable for ion transport. Furthermore, we show that libration is governed by polyhedral connectivity and can be tuned through Na content and cation substitution within a fixed framework.
