The surface is proposed to host specific anchoring sites depending on the exposed crystalline facets as well as the specific edges between (110) and (100) facets, which are home to distinctive Al coordination environments. Additionally, while alkali metals are essential promoters in heterogeneous catalysis, the way they bind to oxide supports and organise at their surfaces remains poorly understood. In particular, Cs/γ-Al2O3 systems are of practical importance in CO2 conversion processes, where the loading and dispersion of Cs strongly influence activity, yet the nature of the surface Cs species and how their spatial arrangement governs this promoting effect remain poorly understood. Thus, these two interconnected challenges give the opportunity to use specifically designed system to be addressed together. Here, we generate atomically dispersed Cs sites on the surface of well-defined γ-Al2O3 supports with specific crystalline facet organization, according to tailored nanocrystal morphologies. Taking advantage of the high-contrast of Cs (Z=55), we quantify its spatial distribution and specific location by atomic-resolution HAADF-STEM imaging over hundreds of atoms on various support morphologies. Furthermore, we use 133Cs ssNMR and DFT calculations to elucidate the Cs speciation associated with specific anchoring sites. Our work reveals the formation of Cs chains along the (110)/(100) edges of needle-shaped crystals, whereas rhomboids, terminated exclusively by (111) facets, show no such feature. 133Cs NMR and DFT rationalize this behaviour, identifying Cs pairs as the stable configuration at (110)/(100) edges. These results established the specificity of edge anchoring sites, together with bringing details on how Cs binds to surface of relevant oxide support, opening doors to a better understanding of its promotional effect in various catalytic processes, where the spatial distribution of alkali metals is thought to be a crucial factor.
items.authors: Charles Sidhoum, Weicheng Cao, Jung-Hua Lin, Nico Richter, Christophe Copéret

items.authors: Toru KISHIMOTO

items.title: Development of a Multivalent Macrocyclic Peptide that Protects Against SARS-CoV-2 Infection Following Intranasal Administration
items.abstract: The risk of zoonotic spillover of coronaviruses poses a constant threat to humanity, as recently exemplified by SARS‑CoV-2. During the pandemic, the rapid emergence of immune escape mutations led to a loss of efficacy of both therapeutic and humoral anti‑spike antibodies, emphasizing the need for therapeutics that engage binding sites within the spike protein that are both conserved among related viruses and not under selective pressure from immune surveillance. Here, we report the development of a first-in-class fusion inhibitor cyclic peptide that targets such a site. Guided by a deep mutational scan of our earlier mRNA display hit we arrived at an analogue with 5 mutations that retains broad activity within the subgenus sarbecovirus, including against SARS-CoV-1, but shows up to 50-fold improved potency and approximately 25-fold improved solubility. Multimerization further improved IC50 by one order of magnitude to give a tetrameric construct (H4v1Az)4 that inhibits Omicron BA.2.86 replication with an IC50 of approximately 10 nM in cellular assays, including human airway epithelial cell primary cultures. Moreover, (H4v1Az)4 demonstrated significant antiviral efficacy in vivo in a Syrian golden hamster model following combined pre- and post-exposure prophylactic intranasal administration. This multimeric peptide represents a promising broadly active candidate suitable both for treatment of SARS-CoV-2 infection and for preparedness against future emerging sarbecoviruses.
items.authors: Antonius J.P. Hopstaken, Aneta Zegar, Oliver J. Debski-Antoniak, Preeti Hooda, Aleksandra Milewska, Melissa van Dortmondt

items.title: Zwitterion Doping to an Organic Ionic Plastic Crystal Electrolyte: A Strategy to Improve Ionic Conductivity without Compromising Melting Point
items.abstract: Li+-containing organic ionic plastic crystals (OIPCs) show great promise as solid electrolytes for solid-state batteries. However, their ongoing issue is a decrease in the melting point with an increase in the Li+ concentration, requiring a new strategy to improve ion-transport properties without compromising the operating temperature range of the electrolytes as a solid. Herein, we address this by incorporating a small portion of zwitterions into an OIPC matrix, N,Ndiethylpyrrolidinium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide ([C2epyr][FSI]). The effect of zwitterion incorporation on physicochemical properties depends on the type of zwitterion. If its structure is similar to the host OIPC, it improves ionic conductivity without narrowing down the temperature range as a plastic crystal, which is supported by minimal destruction to the host crystalline lattice without obvious formation of new crystalline phases. The cycle test of solid-state Li | LiFePO4−[C2epyr][FSI] cells with various concentrations of the pyrrolidinium-based zwitterion in the cathode layer showed the most stable discharge capacity of 150 mAh/g at 0.1C, 50 °C for the cell with 8.70 mol% of the zwitterion, without any sign of capacity decay. Impedance analysis unveiled the positive effect of the zwitterion addition at this concentration regime, which stabilizes cathode-electrolyte interphase and charge transfer at the LFP interface.
items.authors: Hiroyuki Ueda, Hiroki Sugisawa, Frederick Nti, Toshifumi Takahashi, Emi Nakatsuka, Hiroyuki Aikyo

items.title: Restored operation lifetime of Au@ZnO NW gas sensors for H₂S detection due to reversible sulfurization with NO₂ and O₃
items.abstract: The nanomaterial system of gold functionalized zinc oxide nanowires (Au@ZnO NWs) shows extraordinary sensing ability towards trace amounts of hydrogen sulfide (H 2 S), meeting the requirements for early medical diagnostics via exhaled human breath. An interplay of morphological and chemical sensitization of ZnO NWs with Au nanoparticles (Au NPs) enables the selective detection of H 2 S concentrations at the ppt (parts-per-trillion) concentration level at room temperature. Exceptional sensitivity and selectivity are achieved through dissociative chemisorption of H 2 S on both the Au NP surface, and the ZnO NW [10-10] side-factette. Unfortunately, this interaction leads to the sulfurization of the sensor, deteriorates the gas sensitive surface of the nanomaterial system and significantly shortens the lifetime of Au@ZnO NW gas sensors. In this work, we investigate and successfully demonstrate a complete reversal of the sensor’s deterioration, which is achieved by flushing the affected nanomaterial with potent oxidants, namely NO 2 and ozone (O 3 ). Gas sensing performance is assessed in current-over-time measurement ( I - t ) of Au@ZnO chemically sensitive field effect transistors (ChemFETs). Here, functionalized nanowires form the gas-sensitive open gate. We present the initial deterioration of sensors caused by sulfur poisoning of the nanomaterial system, followed by a recovery treatment with either NO 2 , or O 3 . We systematically compare the morphological and chemical effects of each treatment and evaluate the viability of each method by using SEM micrographs, energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (EDX) data and detailed X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) analysis. Results indicate that the NO 2 treatment can lead to a complete decomposition of the gassensitive open gate upon prolonged exposure. In contrast, O 3 found to provide a damage-free treatment that completely restores the sensors' sensing properties after less than 30 min of continuous exposure. ( I - t )-measurements verify a sufficient recovery of the initial sensor sensitivity and signal properties after O 3 treatment, which directly extends the operational lifetime of an Au@ZnO NW gas sensors for H 2 S detection.
items.authors: Angelika Kaiser, Tanja Mauritz, Joachim Bansmann, Ulrich Herr, Klaus Thonke

items.title: Anharmonic Vibrational Structure and Bound States of the He-CO2 van der Waals Complex
items.abstract: We present a new flexible-monomer two-body ab initio potential energy surface for the He–CO2 van der Waals complex, extending our studies of the Ne–CO2, Ar–CO2, and Kr–CO2 complexes to the least polarizable and most weakly bound member of the series. The shallow, anisotropic interaction makes the intermolecular motion strongly anharmonic and delocalized, such that local-mode excitation energies cannot necessarily be identified with physically bound vibrational levels. Curvilinear vibrational self-consistent field (VSCF) and vibrational configuration interaction (VCI) calculations are therefore used primarily to characterize intramolecular anharmonicity and mode coupling, while the floppy intermolecular states are treated quantitatively using coupled-channel BOUND calculations on vibrationally averaged effective potentials. The bound-state calculations yield a dissociation energy of D0 = 16.106 cm−1 and four excited J = 0 levels between 7.699 and 15.001 cm−1 relative to the ground state. In contrast, the VCI-derived local-mode stretching fundamental and the reported overtone and combination features lie above the dissociation threshold and should not be interpreted as ordinary bound levels. The intramolecular spectrum remains largely monomer-like: the VCI ν3 band origin is in close agreement with experiment, the characteristic CO2 Fermi-resonance structure is retained, and the intramolecular bending degeneracy is predicted to be lifted by only ∼0.03 cm−1 . Both the direct and bound state treatments predict the experimentally observed positive sign of the complexation induced ν3 shift, although its magnitude remains sensitive to the vibrational treatment. These results ultimately show that the low-energy spectrum of He–CO2 is governed by large-amplitude motion near dissociation, thereby outlining the limits of local-mode descriptions for weakly bound complexes.
items.authors: Larry Rodriguez, Michael Natalizio, John Oliver Lobo, Angel Vasquez, Olaseni Sode
items.title_zh: 氦-二氧化碳范德华复合物的非谐振动结构与束缚态
items.summary_zh: 我们提出了一种新的灵活单体双体从头算势能面，用于氦-二氧化碳（He-CO2）范德华复合物，扩展了对氖-二氧化碳、氩-二氧化碳和氪-二氧化碳复合物的研究。由于相互作用较浅且各向异性，分子间运动表现出强烈的非谐性和去局域化，局部模式激发能量不一定与物理束缚振动能级相对应。因此，采用曲线振动自洽场（VSCF）和振动配置相互作用（VCI）计算主要用于表征分子内的非谐性和模式耦合，而松弛的分子间态则通过耦合通道束缚态计算在振动平均有效势能上进行定量处理。束缚态计算得出的解离能为D0 = 16.106 cm−1，且相对于基态存在四个激发的J = 0能级，能量范围在7.699至15.001 cm−1之间。与此相比，VCI推导的局部模式拉伸基频及报告的泛音和组合特征位于解离阈值之上，不应被解释为普通的束缚能级。分子内光谱仍然主要呈现单体特征：VCI ν3带的起始频率与实验结果高度一致，保留了特征性的二氧化碳费米共振结构。

items.title: Persistent Alkyne-Bridged Bis-Trityl Diradicaloids with an Open-Shell Ground State
items.abstract: Organic singlet diradicaloids are of interest for spintronics, singlet fission, and quantum information science because of their electronic and magnetic properties. However, the synthesis of persistent diradicaloids with high diradical character remains a challenge. Herein, we report the synthesis of three novel alkyne-bridged diradicaloids based on a tetrathiaarylmethyl (trityl) radical. Electron Paramagnetic Resonance spectroscopy and magnetic susceptibility measurements were used to determine the spin-spin exchange interaction J in all three compounds, revealing narrow singlet-triplet gaps of -1 kcal/mol, -0.4 kcal/mol, and -0.05 kcal/mol for 1 •• , 2 •• , and 3 •• , respectively. DFT calculations support the singlet open-shell nature of the ground state in all three diradicaloids and yield a diradical character y 0 of 0.47, 0.53, and 0.76 for 1 •• , 2 •• , and 3 •• , respectively. Furthermore, low-energy absorption bands at 780 nm for 1 •• and 2 •• and at 500 nm for 3 •• show the transition between the open-shell ground state and a closed-shell cumulenic state. In addition, the reactivity of all three compounds towards oxygen is rationalized based on the spin-spin interaction. Lastly, since the molecules share similar geometries, J is found to be in inverse correlation to y 0 .This study thereby provides extensive insight into the structural relations between polyynic and cumulenic states, and the stability of tritylbased diradicaloids.
items.authors: Lars Westhofen, Andrea Pellegrini, Stefan Grimme, Olav Schiemann
items.title_zh: 持久的炔桥双三苯基自由基化合物及其开壳层基态
items.summary_zh: 有机单态双自由基化合物因其电子和磁性特性在自旋电子学、单态裂变和量子信息科学中备受关注。然而，合成具有高双自由基特性的持久自由基化合物仍然是一个挑战。本研究合成了三种基于四硫芳基甲基（trityl）自由基的新型炔桥双自由基化合物。通过电子顺磁共振谱和磁化率测量确定了三种化合物中的自旋-自旋交换相互作用J，结果显示1 ••、2 ••和3 ••的单态-三态能隙分别为-1 kcal/mol、-0.4 kcal/mol和-0.05 kcal/mol。DFT计算支持三种双自由基化合物的开壳层基态特性，得到了1 ••、2 ••和3 ••的双自由基特征y 0分别为0.47、0.53和0.76。此外，1 ••和2 ••在780 nm处以及3 ••在500 nm处的低能吸收带显示了开壳层基态与闭壳层累烯态之间的跃迁。最后，由于分子具有相似的几何结构，发现J与y 0呈反相关。这项研究为聚炔和闭壳层化合物之间的结构关系提供了深入的见解。

items.title: Rotamer-Dependent Amino Acid Descriptors as Protein and Peptide Representation for Reactivity and Property Prediction
items.abstract: We present RotADeL, a Rotamer-dependent Amino acid Descriptors Library designed to facilitate the use of chemically interpretable representations in machine learning models for peptide and protein reactivity. RotADeL contains precomputed steric and electronic descriptors for the rotamer ensembles of the canonical amino acids, accounting for their different protonation states. These descriptors can be queried either from a known protein structure, by selecting the closest library rotamer, or directly from an amino acid sequence, by averaging over the rotamer ensemble according to backbone and side-chain conformational probabilities. The latter approach avoids the need for computationally demanding protein geometry generation. We evaluated the resulting features in two case studies: first, the comparison of RotADeL descriptors to commonly used peptide representations for antimicrobial activity and toxicity classification; secondly, the application of RotADeL descriptors to predict the enantioselectivity of cyclisation reactions catalysed by GluER-T36A. Together, these results show that RotADeL provides a transferable and interpretable amino acid representation for machine learning predictions of peptide property and enzyme reactivity.
items.authors: Lauriane Jacot-Descombes, Kjell Jorner
items.title_zh: 依赖旋转构象的氨基酸描述符用于蛋白质和肽的反应性预测
items.summary_zh: 我们提出了RotADeL，一个依赖旋转构象的氨基酸描述符库，旨在促进在机器学习模型中使用化学可解释的表示法来预测肽和蛋白质的反应性。RotADeL包含了对标准氨基酸旋转构象集合的预计算立体和电子描述符，考虑了其不同的质子化状态。这些描述符可以通过已知的蛋白质结构查询，选择最接近的库旋转构象，或直接从氨基酸序列中查询，根据主链和侧链构象概率对旋转构象集合进行平均。后者方法避免了计算上要求高的蛋白质几何生成。我们在两个案例研究中评估了这些特征：首先，将RotADeL描述符与常用的肽表示法进行比较，以分类抗菌活性和毒性；其次，应用RotADeL描述符预测GluER-T36A催化的环化反应的对映选择性。这些结果表明，RotADeL为肽特性和酶反应性的机器学习预测提供了可转移且可解释的氨基酸表示。

items.title: A Critical Review of Theoretical Approaches to Compute Ionic Conductivity in Solid-State Electrolytes: The Case Study of Li3YCl6 and Li3YBr6
items.abstract: The development of next-generation batteries strongly depends on the design of electrolytes that ensure efficient ionic transport. In this context, computational in silico approaches have become increasingly important. Among them, molecular dynamics simulations are particularly powerful for investigating constitutive elements of batteries and providing a deeper understanding of structure-property relationships in solid-state electrolytes. Yet, for these systems, obtaining accurate ionic conductivity and activation energy is not straightforward as finding a force field to accurately describe the system and a robust workflow is challenging. In this work, a classical force field (CFF), based on the SoftBV bond-valence approach, and a machine learning potential (MLP) trained on density functional theory (DFT) energies and forces using the MACE neural network architecture, were optimized and compared to investigate the two solid electrolytes, Li3YCl6 (LYC) and Li3YBr6 (LYB). Our study proposes an integrated workflow (structure generation, property analysis with relevant statistical sampling) using standard methodologies based on the Einstein equations and a new method called STACIE[Toraman et al., J. Chem. Inf. Model., 65, 19, 2025, DOI:10.1021/acs.jcim.5c01475] (STable AutoCorrelation Integral Estimator) deriving these properties through the analysis of power spectral densities for transport property evaluation. Based on the evaluation and analysis of the contribution of the crosscorrelations between mobile ions, we provide clear rules to validate the use of Nernst-Einstein’s approximation to estimate the ionic conductivity. Results show trends in agreement with the literature. Notably the correct order of the conductivity activation energies Ea(LYC) Ea(LYB), observed experimentally, is maintained. Overall, while CFF can provide an adequate representation when guided by experimental data, the strength of the MACE potential lies in its predictive capability. Using configurations generated by DFT calculations, the MLP generates trajectories with accurate crystallographic features from which realistic transport properties are extracted. Compared to their CFF counterparts, MLP results also show better mechanical stability at higher temperature for LYB, a softer system based on the analysis of solid-phase mechanical properties.
items.authors: Amély Rondeau, Namrata Jaykhedkar, Theodorus De Bruin, Manuel Corral Valero, Toon Verstraelen, Carlos Nieto-Draghi
items.title_zh: 固态电解质中离子导电性的理论计算方法评析：以Li3YCl6和Li3YBr6为例
items.summary_zh: 下一代电池的发展依赖于高效离子传输的电解质设计。在此背景下，计算方法变得愈发重要。分子动力学模拟在研究电池的组成元素及固态电解质的结构-性质关系方面尤为有效。然而，准确获取离子导电性和活化能并不简单，因为找到合适的力场和稳健的工作流程具有挑战性。本研究优化并比较了基于SoftBV键价方法的经典力场（CFF）和使用MACE神经网络架构训练的基于密度泛函理论（DFT）能量和力的机器学习势（MLP），以研究固态电解质Li3YCl6（LYC）和Li3YBr6（LYB）。我们提出了一种集成工作流程，结合标准方法和新方法STACIE，通过功率谱密度分析推导相关性质。

items.title: Directional Electric Fields at Designed MOF Sites: Implications for Electrostatic Preorganization and Catalysis
items.abstract: Enzymes achieve their enormous catalytic power in part through electrostatic preorganization: non-covalent interactions arrange an electric field that is preorganized to stabilize the change in dipole moment between a reaction's ground and transition states. Thus, the catalytic relevance of an electric field depends not only on its magnitude but also on its orientation. Here we use the enforced rigidity of a metal–organic framework (MOF), PCN-521, to demonstrate this orientation dependence directly. We introduce an aldehyde carbonyl vibrational Stark probe in situ, first as a protected ketal, then deprotect it to reveal a carbonyl at the same node-capping site as a previously reported nitrile probe, extending field measurements to a field reporter of greater relevance to enzymatic catalysis. Electric field- vibrational frequency calibrated probes using the vibrational Stark effect report a trifluoroacetate field donor that projects nearly its full destabilizing field onto the collinear nitrile (sp, C≡N) but only a fraction onto the off-axis aldehyde (sp2, C=O) — a geometric effect. Because the framework's non-covalent contacts, unlike an enzyme active site's, cannot reorganize, this controlled, single-site comparison isolates alignment from magnitude. While electric fields are often invoked to explain observations near electrodes or droplet interfaces, these results show the importance of alignment which is often neglected.
items.authors: Srijit Mukherjee, Jacopo Andreo, Zhe Ji, Francesca Peccati, Stefan Wuttke, Steven G. Boxer
items.title_zh: 设计金属有机框架中定向电场的影响及其催化应用
items.summary_zh: 酶的巨大催化能力部分源于静电预组织：非共价相互作用排列电场，以预先组织的方式稳定反应基态与过渡态之间的偶极矩变化。电场的催化相关性不仅依赖于其强度，还依赖于其方向。本文利用金属有机框架（MOF）PCN-521的强制刚性直接展示了这种方向依赖性。我们在原位引入了一种醛基羰基振动斯塔克探针，首先以保护的酮形式存在，随后去保护以揭示与先前报道的腈探针相同节点封端位点的羰基，扩展了电场测量至与酶催化更相关的场探针。使用振动斯塔克效应的电场-振动频率标定探针报告了一个三氟乙酸根电场供体，其几乎将全部不稳定电场投射到共线腈（sp, C≡N）上，而仅将一部分投射到偏轴的醛（sp2, C=O）上，显示出几何效应。由于框架的非共价接触无法重组，这种受控的单位点比较将对齐与强度分离开来。

items.title: An ‘empty’ [Fe16] cage and its transformation into [Fe17] and [Fe30]
items.abstract: Polymetallic clusters of FeIII constructed without organic bridging ligands are an emerging class of molecules with structures akin to iron oxide minerals, possessing large spin ground states and/or displaying spin frustration effects. All previous examples, [Fe8], [Fe17], [Fe30] and [Fe34], have been isolated from pyridine or analogous heterocyclic amine solvents. Here, we report the isolation of an [Fe16] cluster from dmf. The complex is ‘isostructural’ with the previously reported [Fe17] molecular metal oxide, but with the central, tetrahedral FeIII ion absent. Antiferromagnetic exchange interactions between the tetrahedral and octahedral FeIII ions in [Fe16] lead to a spin ground state of S = 20, the highest yet for this family of materials, consistent with the S = 35/2 found for [Fe17] containing an additional (antiferromagnetically coupled) s = 5/2 ion. Dissolution of [Fe16] in pyridine regenerates [Fe17] or the larger [Fe30], depending on reaction conditions, demonstrating for the first time that these species can be interconverted.
items.authors: Annabel J. MacGregor, Lucinda R. B. Wilson, Gary S. Nichol, Marc Ubach I Cervera, David Gracia, Zhonghao Chang
items.title_zh: 一种“空”的[Fe16]笼及其转化为[Fe17]和[Fe30]
items.summary_zh: 无机桥接配体构建的FeIII多金属簇是一类新兴分子，其结构类似于铁氧化物矿物，具有较大的自旋基态和/或表现出自旋挫折效应。之前的例子[Fe8]、[Fe17]、[Fe30]和[Fe34]均从吡啶或类似的杂环胺溶剂中分离得到。本文报道了从DMF中分离出[Fe16]簇。该复合物与之前报道的[Fe17]分子金属氧化物“同构”，但缺少中心的四面体FeIII离子。[Fe16]中四面体和八面体FeIII离子之间的反铁磁交换相互作用导致自旋基态为S = 20，为该类材料中最高值，与含有额外（反铁磁耦合）s = 5/2离子的[Fe17]的S = 35/2一致。在吡啶中溶解[Fe16]可再生[Fe17]或更大的[Fe30]，这首次证明了这些物种可以相互转化。

items.title: Catalytic-Defect Passivation on Amyloid-β Fibrils Using Atomically Precise Gold Nanoclusters
items.abstract: Most pharmacological strategies targeting amyloid-β (Aβ) in Alzheimer’s disease have focused on reducing Aβ production, preventing aggregation, or removing deposited amyloid from the brain. Within the Aβ aggregation pathway, secondary nucleation is a critical amplification step in which pre-existing fibrils catalyze the formation of new aggregates on their surfaces. Some of these aggregates detach and grow into additional fibrils, sustaining an autocatalytic cycle that makes secondary nucleation an attractive target for pharmacological intervention. Biophysical studies indicate that rare defects formed during fibril growth act as hotspots for secondary nucleation, and that fibrils with fewer such defects show markedly lower secondarynucleation activity. Therefore, these findings raise the possibility that defect passivation could reduce the catalytic activity of Aβ fibrils without requiring their removal. This topical review proposes atomically precise, ligand-protected gold nanoclusters (AuNCs) as a tunable platform for selectively targeting and blocking these catalytic defects. Taking advantage of their welldefined metal cores and customizable ligand layers, we outline how AuNCs can be engineered for selective recognition of fibril surfaces and catalytic inhibition. We introduce an inversedesign strategy that integrates molecular modeling with machine learning-guided screening to identify optimal AuNC candidates before validating them through aggregation kinetics and neuronal assays. Defect-selective passivation would offer a distinct anti-amyloid approach by suppressing the critical autocatalytic amplification step of Aβ aggregation rather than removing deposited amyloid.
items.authors: Bruno A. Cisterna, María Francisca Matus
items.title_zh: 利用原子精确金纳米簇钝化淀粉样β纤维的催化缺陷
items.summary_zh: 针对阿尔茨海默病的药物策略主要集中在减少淀粉样β（Aβ）产生、阻止聚集或清除大脑中沉积的淀粉样物质。在Aβ聚集过程中，二次成核是一个关键的放大步骤，已有的纤维在其表面催化新聚集体的形成。生物物理研究表明，纤维生长过程中形成的稀有缺陷是二次成核的热点，而缺陷较少的纤维显示出明显较低的二次成核活性。因此，缺陷钝化可能在不移除纤维的情况下降低Aβ纤维的催化活性。本文提出利用原子精确、配体保护的金纳米簇（AuNCs）作为选择性靶向和阻断这些催化缺陷的可调平台，阐述了如何利用AuNCs的金属核心和可定制的配体层进行纤维表面的选择性识别和催化抑制。我们引入了一种逆向设计策略，将分子建模与机器学习指导的筛选相结合。

items.title: Variable Rate Hydroxylamine Derivatization to Determine of Formaldehyde’s Role and Kinetics in CO2 Reduction to Methanol on Cobalt Phthalocyanine
items.abstract: Heterogenized cobalt phthalocyanine (CoPc) catalyzes electrochemical CO2 reduction (CO2R) to methanol. While it is clear that CO is a reaction intermediate, the role of formaldehyde, a sometimes-observed trace product, is less well-understood. Here, we gain insight into the methanol formation mechanism by selectively trapping formaldehyde. Using a simple preparation of CoPc heterogenized on multiwalled carbon nanotubes as the electrocatalyst, we employed three hydroxylamines which react with formaldehyde in the electrolyte to form stable, unreactive oximes at different rates: pentafluorobenzylhydroxylamine [PFBHA] (slowest), ethylhydroxylamine [EHA], and hydroxylamine [HA] (fastest). PFBHA has only a small effect on the methanol/formaldehyde selectivity, while EHA and HA (and higher concentrations of EHA) both reduce methanol molar selectivity by 25%, with a corresponding carbon-balanced increase in formaldehyde selectivity. Unbound formaldehyde thus is a relatively (compared to CO) short-lived intermediate responsible for only a quarter of the observed methanol. Extended CO2R in PFBHA-containing electrolyte scrubs the solution of CH2O without impacting MeOH selectivity, and we saw no noticeable difference in the rate of MeOH selectivity decline compared to control. This suggests that CH­2O is not a poison. 2D reaction-diffusion-convection simulations performed in a simplified geometry are consistent with the observed trends in methanol/formaldehyde selectivity, although derivatization rate constants larger than our experimental estimates need to be employed. We predict that hydroxylamine derivatization could be used for mechanistic analysis in other electrocatalytic networks with aldehyde intermediates.
items.authors: Aidan Shiu, Calton J. Kong, Akshaykumar N. Desai, Helen J. Zeng, Joel W. Ager
items.title_zh: 变速羟胺衍生化法研究甲醛在CO2还原为甲醇中的作用与动力学
items.summary_zh: 异质化钴酞菁（CoPc）催化电化学CO2还原（CO2R）为甲醇。虽然CO是反应中间体，但甲醛作为一种偶尔观察到的微量产物的作用尚不明确。我们通过选择性捕获甲醛来深入了解甲醇形成机制。使用简单制备的负载在多壁碳纳米管上的CoPc作为电催化剂，采用三种羟胺与电解质中的甲醛反应，形成稳定的、非反应性的肟，反应速率不同：五氟苯基羟胺（PFBHA，反应最慢）、乙基羟胺（EHA）和羟胺（HA，反应最快）。PFBHA对甲醇/甲醛选择性影响较小，而EHA和HA（以及更高浓度的EHA）均使甲醇的摩尔选择性降低25%，同时甲醛选择性相应增加。因此，游离甲醛是相对短暂的中间体，仅占观察到的甲醇的四分之一。在含PFBHA的电解质中进行的延长CO2R实验清除溶液中的CH2O，而不影响甲醇选择性，且与对照组相比，甲醇选择性下降速率无明显差异。这表明CH2O并不是毒物。

items.title: AI-Generated Peptide Vectors: Advancing Fluorescent Detection of Bacteria
items.abstract: Molecular probes derived from antimicrobial peptides are powerful tools for diagnosing bacterial infectious diseases and guiding antibiotic therapy. However, existing probes rely on a limited repertoire of natural antimicrobial peptides, leaving the vast sequence space of linear peptides largely unexplored. Here, we used explainable artificial intelligence to design AIGP-3, a de novo peptide vector for fluorescent probes. Conjugated to Nile Red, NR-AIGP-3 exhibits high selectivity for Gram-positive bacteria, combining the environmental sensitivity of the fluorophore with the strong membrane binding of the vector and favorable MIC values for live-cell imaging. NR-AIGP-3 outperforms a ubiquicidin-derived probe in both flow cytometry and confocal microscopy, demonstrating its high potential for developing molecular probes for the diagnosis of bacterial infections.
items.authors: Anthony Augé, Evgeniia Milova, Alexey Orlov, Hugo Debelvalet, Sergio Ortiz, Dmytro Dziuba
items.title_zh: AI生成肽载体：提升细菌荧光检测技术
items.summary_zh: 来源于抗菌肽的分子探针是诊断细菌感染性疾病和指导抗生素治疗的有效工具。然而，现有探针依赖于有限的天然抗菌肽，导致线性肽的广泛序列空间尚未被充分探索。本研究利用可解释的人工智能设计了AIGP-3，一种新型荧光探针肽载体。与尼罗红结合的NR-AIGP-3对革兰氏阳性细菌表现出高选择性，结合了荧光染料的环境敏感性、载体的强膜结合能力以及适合活细胞成像的MIC值。NR-AIGP-3在流式细胞术和共聚焦显微镜中均优于源自普遍素的探针，展示了其在细菌感染诊断分子探针开发中的巨大潜力。

items.title: τ8: an Angle-Based Geometry Index for 8-Coordinate Complexes
items.abstract: An angle-based geometry index for the direct comparison of 8-coordinate molecular complexes is presented herein. The method was designed as a readily accessible tool to evaluate experimental coordination complexes via the degree of distortion between the three most common interconvertible 8-vertex polyhedra for molecular compounds: square antiprism, biaugmented triangular prism, and dodecahedron. Analogous to the well-established geometric analysis methods for 4- and 5-coordinate compounds (τ4 and τ5, respectively), τ8 assesses the geometry of an 8-coordinate compound based on the angles around the metal center formed through ligand coordination contrasting with other methods utilizing the angles between polyhedral faces. This is an alternative and complementary approach to evaluating the central metal geometries of 8-coordinate compounds, designed to bolster the growing field of high-coordinate metal complex chemistry and provide a readily implemented framework for comparative analysis.
items.authors: Appie Peterson, S. Olivia Gunther, David K. Shuh, Gaël Ung, Rebecca J. Abergel
items.title_zh: τ8：一种用于8配位复合物的基于角度的几何指数
items.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种基于角度的几何指数，用于直接比较8配位分子复合物。该方法旨在作为一种易于获取的工具，通过评估分子化合物中三种最常见的可互变8顶点多面体（方反棱柱、双增补三角棱柱和十二面体）之间的畸变程度来评估实验配位复合物的几何结构。与已建立的4配位和5配位化合物的几何分析方法（分别为τ4和τ5）类似，τ8基于配体配位形成的金属中心周围的角度来评估8配位化合物的几何形状，而不是使用多面体面之间的角度。这是一种评估8配位化合物中心金属几何形状的替代和补充方法，旨在促进高配位金属复合物化学领域的发展，并提供一个易于实施的比较分析框架。

items.title: Aromatic ring overlap affects excited-state properties of stacked nucleobases
items.abstract: Photochemistry of nucleic acids has gained considerable attention because of their ability to undergo efficient charge transfer (CT) after absorption of UV light and its importance for DNA damage and repair. Recent computational and experimental studies demonstrated that CT rates and yields of DNA and RNA oligomers are strongly dependent on their secondary structure and relative arrangements of the chromophores. However, molecular and electronic origins of these differences still remain largely obscure. Here, we explored how stacking interactions and aromatic ring overlap affect the energetics of different locally excited (LE) and charge transfer (CT) states, as well as electronic couplings between them. For this purpose, we developed a novel approach and metric to quantify the stacking overlap between neighbouring aromatic rings. Based on quantum chemical calculations performed for a stacked adenine-guanine dimer, we show how the minima of different electronically excited states correlate with the degree of aromatic ring overlap and our stacking score metric. In particular, we demonstrate that electronic coupling values between the LE and CT states are maximised, whenever the aromatic subunits of stacked nucleobases are in perfect horizontal overlap. These correlations are preserved for more realistic nucleic acid fragments, such as different conformers of the AG RNA dinucleotide. Since the magnitude of electronic coupling has a strong effect on electron transfer rate, our results rationalize varying CT rates and yields observed across different DNA and RNA secondary structures, adopting different relative arrangements of the chromophores. Finally, our stacking score approach can be applied to the interpretation of excited-state and ground state properties of any chemical systems containing stacked aromatic rings.
items.authors: Mikołaj Gurba, Rafał Szabla
items.title_zh: 芳香环重叠对堆叠核苷酸激发态性质的影响
items.summary_zh: 核酸的光化学因其在紫外光照射后能够高效进行电荷转移（CT）而受到广泛关注，这对DNA的损伤与修复至关重要。近期的计算和实验研究表明，DNA和RNA寡聚体的CT速率和产率与其二级结构及色素相对排列密切相关。然而，这些差异的分子和电子起源仍不清楚。本文探讨了堆叠相互作用和芳香环重叠如何影响不同局部激发（LE）和电荷转移（CT）态的能量及其间的电子耦合。我们开发了一种新方法来量化相邻芳香环之间的堆叠重叠。通过对堆叠腺嘌呤-鸟嘌呤二聚体的量子化学计算，发现不同激发态的能量最小值与芳香环重叠程度及我们的堆叠评分指标相关，特别是当堆叠核苷酸的芳香亚单位完全水平重叠时，LE和CT态之间的电子耦合值达到最大。这些关联在更现实的核酸片段中也得以保持。

items.title: Aggregation-Induced Emission Probes for Migrasome Imaging and Visualization
items.abstract: Migrasomes are highly dynamic, migration-associated membrane organelles involved in intercellular communication, cargo transfer, mitochondrial quality control, and cellular homeostasis. Their continuous formation, growth, maturation, and detachment impose unique demands on fluorescence imaging, particularly for stable and long-term visualization in living systems. Conventional imaging approaches, including protein-based markers and lipophilic membrane dyes, often suffer from genetic manipulation requirements, cellular internalization, membrane redistribution, photobleaching, or insufficient retention. Aggregation-induced emission luminogens (AIEgens) provide a promising platform to address these limitations because their fluorescence can be activated by restricted molecular motion and their structures can be readily engineered for membrane interaction and functional sensing. In this review, we discuss the molecular design principles of AIEgens for migrasome imaging, with particular emphasis on membrane targeting, durable membrane retention, probe–lipid interactions, photophysical performance, and environmental responsiveness. Representative probes, including TTCPy, OT2SQ, and CDPP-2PF6, illustrate the evolution from phospholipid-targeted structural imaging to mechanosensitive sensing and long-term, lipid-dependent visualization. We further highlight emerging opportunities to improve migrasome selectivity, extend imaging in complex biological systems, and integrate functional readouts of membrane mechanics, lipid remodeling, and cargo dynamics. Together, these advances suggest that rational molecular engineering, rather than AIE activity alone, is central to the development of next-generation probes for selective, longitudinal, and functional migrasome imaging.
items.authors: Ziyue Ye, Zheng Zhao, Zijie Qiu, Parvej Alam, Ben Zhong Tang
items.title_zh: 聚集诱导发射探针用于迁移体成像与可视化
items.summary_zh: 迁移体是高度动态的与迁移相关的膜细胞器，参与细胞间通信、货物转移、线粒体质量控制和细胞稳态。其持续的形成、增长、成熟和脱离对荧光成像提出了独特的要求，尤其是在活体系统中进行稳定和长期可视化。传统成像方法，如基于蛋白质的标记物和亲脂膜染料，常常面临基因操作需求、细胞内化、膜重分布、光漂白或保留不足等问题。聚集诱导发射发光材料（AIEgens）为解决这些限制提供了有前景的平台，因为其荧光可通过限制分子运动激活，且其结构可方便地设计用于膜相互作用和功能传感。本文讨论了AIEgens在迁移体成像中的分子设计原则，重点强调膜靶向、持久膜保留、探针-脂质相互作用、光物理性能和环境响应性。代表性探针TTCPy、OT2SQ和CDPP-2PF6展示了从磷脂靶向结构成像到机械敏感传感和长期脂质依赖可视化的演变。

items.title: Comparative Evaluation of Nickel-Plated Steel Wool and Nickel Strip Electrodes for Hydrogen Production from Non-Potable Water Sources
items.abstract: Traditional water electrolysis imposes a significant freshwater demand. This study evaluates alternative non-potable feedstocks to reduce this dependency. We present a comparative performance analysis of user-fabricated, three-dimensional (3D) porous nickel-plated steel wool scaffolds versus conventional flat nickel control strips. Testing was conducted across tap water, rainwater, and greywater utilizing a near-neutral sodium bicarbonate (NaHCO3) electrolyte. Operational performance was quantified via volumetric hydrogen (H2) yield, Faradaic efficiency, and cost-normalized output (mL/$). The porous electrode significantly outperformed the flat strip, increasing Faradaic efficiency by 7% in tap water and 5% in rainwater. Furthermore, the 3D scaffold achieved up to an 8.7× greater hydrogen yield per dollar. These results demonstrate the bench-scale feasibility of low-cost, structured electrodes for reducing freshwater dependence in water electrolysis.
items.authors: Kyle Liou
items.title_zh: 镍镀钢丝绒与镍条电极在非饮用水源制氢的比较评估
items.summary_zh: 传统水电解对淡水需求较大。本研究评估了替代非饮用水源以减少这种依赖。我们对用户自制的三维（3D）多孔镍镀钢丝绒支架与传统平面镍控制条进行了性能比较分析。测试在自来水、雨水和灰水中进行，使用近中性的碳酸氢钠（NaHCO3）电解质。通过体积氢气（H2）产量、法拉第效率和成本归一化输出（mL/$）量化操作性能。结果显示，多孔电极在自来水中法拉第效率提高了7%，在雨水中提高了5%。此外，3D支架每美元的氢气产量高达8.7倍。这些结果表明，低成本结构电极在水电解中减少淡水依赖的可行性。

items.title: Deciphering Chemical Cues of Pinus halepensis Infestation by the Pine Processionary Moth: Phytochemical Analysis and Computational Insights into Essential Oil Component Interactions with Insect Odorant Binding Protein
items.abstract: Background The pine processionary moth, Thaumetopoea pityocampa, is a major defoliator of pine forests in the Mediterranean, notably affecting coniferous forests in Algeria. Insect odorant binding proteins (OBPs) play a crucial role in detecting pheromones and identifying host plants and oviposition sites. This study aimed to analyze the essential oils from both infested and healthy needles of Pinus halepensis and to investigate the role of GOBP2 in detecting plant volatiles through computational methods. Material and Methods Essential oils from infested and healthy Pinus halepensis needles were analyzed using gas chromatography-mass spectrometry (GC-MS). The interaction between these volatiles and GOBP2 was explored through molecular docking using SwissDock, and the stability of the top-scoring docked complexes was evaluated with molecular dynamics simulations via the iMODS server. Results The analysis indicated an increase in monoterpenes and a decrease in sesquiterpenes and diterpenes in infested trees. Among the 44 volatiles with increased production, 16 compounds, including Methyl 7,13,15-abietatrienoate, Abietadiene, Palustral γ-Eudesmol, β-Copaene, Phenethyl 2-furoate, trans-Cadina-1(6),4-diene, α-Eudesmol, Phenyl ethyl 3-methyl-butanoate, Phenethyl 2-methylbutanoate, Lavandulyl acetate, β-Elemene, Linalool acetate, Cyclosativene, cis-Linalool oxide, and Linalool, showed favorable interactions with the hydrophobic cavity of BmorGOBP2. Molecular dynamics simulations revealed that the complexes with Abietadiene and trans-Cadina-1(6),4-diene exhibited the highest stability. Conclusion The findings of this study provide valuable insights that could inform the development of pest management strategies targeting Thaumetopoea pityocampa.
items.authors: Safia Abla, Wafa Tachoua, Mustapha Mohamed Abou, Farid Chebrouk, Wafa TACHOUA
items.title_zh: 解析松树毛虫对阿勒颇松的化学信号：植物化学分析与计算洞察
items.summary_zh: 背景：松树毛虫（Thaumetopoea pityocampa）是地中海地区松林的重要 defoliator，尤其影响阿尔及利亚的针叶林。昆虫气味结合蛋白（OBPs）在检测信息素和识别宿主植物及产卵地点中起关键作用。本研究分析了受害和健康的阿勒颇松针叶中的精油，并通过计算方法研究GOBP2在检测植物挥发物中的作用。方法：使用气相色谱-质谱联用技术（GC-MS）分析了受害和健康阿勒颇松针叶的精油。通过SwissDock进行分子对接，探讨这些挥发物与GOBP2的相互作用，并通过iMODS服务器评估高评分对接复合物的稳定性。结果：分析显示，受害树木中单萜含量增加，而倍半萜和二萜含量减少。在44种挥发物中，16种化合物（如Methyl 7,13,15-abietatrienoate、Abietadiene等）表现出增加的生成。

items.title: Molecular Design and Interface Engineering of Self-Assembled Monolayers for Inverted Perovskite Solar Cells: A Data-Driven Review of Efficiency, Stability and Scalability
items.abstract: Self-assembled monolayers (SAMs) have become indispensable hole-transport layers in inverted perovskite solar cells which enables power conversion efficiencies (PCEs) above 27% in single-junction devices and above 32% in tandems where the tandem devices benefit disproportionately from SAM engineering with certified efficiencies exceeding 31%. In the review eight hypotheses have been proposed including the prediction that bisphosphonic acid SAMs will outperform monophosphonic acid SAMs in thermal stability, glycol ether side chains will improve both PCE and stability and machine learning can identify new SAMs with 27% PCE and 90% retention at 1000 h , the studied researches shows that carbazole-based SAMs with phosphonic acid anchoring groups dominate the field with Me-4PACz and MeO-2PACz . Co-SAM strategies that have hydrogen-bonding additives consistently improve PCE by (1–3)% absolute over single-component SAMs and that bisphosphonic acid anchoring groups are emerging as a way to improve thermal and damp heat stability. Operational stability under maximum power point tracking now exceeds 1000 h for optimized SAM systems though ISOS protocol adoption remains inconsistent.
items.authors: Soumyabir Guha
items.title_zh: 自组装单层膜在倒置钙钛矿太阳能电池中的分子设计与界面工程
items.summary_zh: 自组装单层膜（SAMs）已成为倒置钙钛矿太阳能电池中不可或缺的载流子传输层，使单结器件的功率转换效率（PCE）超过27%，而串联器件的效率超过32%。本文提出了八个假设，包括双磷酸酸SAM在热稳定性上优于单磷酸酸SAM，醇醚侧链能提高PCE和稳定性，以及机器学习能够识别出PCE达到27%且在1000小时内保持90%效率的新SAM。研究表明，基于咔唑的SAMs（如Me-4PACz和MeO-2PACz）在该领域占主导地位。具有氢键添加剂的共SAM策略在PCE上相较于单组分SAMs一致提高1-3%的绝对值，而双磷酸酸锚定基团则成为改善热稳定性和潮湿热稳定性的新途径。优化的SAM系统在最大功率点跟踪下的操作稳定性现已超过1000小时，尽管ISOS协议的采用仍不一致。

items.title: Response to Comment “Rethinking the Evidence for a Liquid–Liquid Transition in Water: What Decompression Experiments Reveal” [J. Chem. Phys. 164, 024506 (2026)]
items.abstract: Ultrafast decompression experiments on deeply supercooled water have been interpreted as showing long-lived coexistence of high- and low-density liquid. We reassess this interpretation by separating the timescales of pressure release, structural relaxation, crystallization, and heat exchange. The experimental trajectories are adiabatic, and under these conditions the two fitted WAXS components cannot represent equilibrium HDL and LDL persisting along a common thermodynamic path. We show instead that the spectra are consistent with a responsive liquid fraction evolving during decompression together with a structurally lagged, HDA-like fraction produced by heterogeneous heating. This framework also rationalizes the fluence dependence and clarifies the distinct information contained in the SAXS response. The analysis identifies which observables can provide decisive evidence for a first-order liquid–liquid transition and constrain the location of its critical point.
items.authors: Valeria Molinero, Rajat Kumar, Ingrid de Almeida Ribeiro, Debdas Dhabal

items.title: Topologically-constrained toehold-mediated strand displacement
items.abstract: Toehold-mediated strand displacement (TMSD) is regarded as the simplest mechanism through which synthetic nucleicacid nanosystems can be dynamically actuated and is central to applications in biosensing, molecular computing, data storage and retrieval, and synthetic biology. In these implementations, TMSD often occurs in topologically-confined configurations, with the toehold domain being linked to other elements that restrict its conformational freedom. However, the effect of topological confinement on the biophysics of TMSD remains largely unexplored. Here, we study TMSD in a simple, physiologically-encountered configuration in which the toehold domain is located in a DNA ‘bubble’, a region where the two strands of an otherwise continuous DNA duplex are dehybridised. We show that this topological confinement reduces the rate of TMSD by ∼1–3 orders of magnitude as a result of alterations to the TMSD free-energy landscape. We further demonstrate that hybridisation of a short DNA strand to the target complex–away from the toehold domain–speeds up TMSD, hence providing a route for allosteric modulation of the reaction rate. Our results highlight the substantial effect of topological confinement on TMSD. These effects must be considered in the optimal design of dynamic nanostructures and molecular reaction networks while offering convenient strategies for the fine-tuning and modulation of reaction rates.
items.authors: Andrew Stannard, Aditya Sengar, Alexander H. Clowsley, Christian Soeller, Thomas E. Ouldridge, Lorenzo Di Michele
items.title_zh: 拓扑约束下的踏脚石介导链置换研究
items.summary_zh: 踏脚石介导链置换（TMSD）被视为合成核酸纳米系统动态驱动的最简单机制，广泛应用于生物传感、分子计算、数据存储与检索及合成生物学等领域。本研究探讨了在生理条件下，踏脚石域位于DNA“气泡”中的TMSD现象，该区域是两条DNA链脱配的地方。结果表明，拓扑约束使TMSD的速率降低了约1-3个数量级，原因在于TMSD自由能景观的变化。此外，我们发现短DNA链在远离踏脚石域的目标复合物上杂交可以加速TMSD，从而提供了一种别构调节反应速率的途径。研究结果强调了拓扑约束对TMSD的显著影响，这些影响在动态纳米结构和分子反应网络的优化设计中必须予以考虑。

items.title: Eugenol Sustained Release from a Non-Innocent Zn-MOF for Antimicrobial Fruit Preservation
items.abstract: Active packaging is an effective strategy to extend food shelf life and reduce waste. In this work, a Zn-based Metal-Organic Framework (ZnBDP) was loaded with the natural antimicrobial eugenol using a vapour-phase impregnation, achieving complete encapsulation within the MOF pores (21 wt%), enabling sustained release in water over 3.5 months. Considering the bioactivity of Zn2+ and eugenol, the combined bactericidal and fungicidal effect of eugenol@ZnBDP_V was enhanced. Eugenol@ZnBDP_V demonstrated a superior activity against the bacteria Escherichia coli compared to free eugenol or pristine ZnBDP. 3 Further, important antifungal activity was observed against 5 plant pathogenic fungi, matching or exceeding the performance of free eugenol. Its practical potential was confirmed in strawberry preservation tests under extreme storage conditions, where fruit quality was maintained for up to 7.2 days. These findings highlight bioactive Zn-MOFs as promising platforms for the controlled delivery of natural antimicrobial agents in fruit packaging.
items.authors: Miriam Abán, Inmaculada Larena, Fabrice Salles, Georgiana Amariei, Sara Rojas, Patricia Horcajada

items.title: Bridging the Training–Application Gap in Kohn–Sham Hamiltonian Learning through Dual-Space Supervision
items.abstract: Predicting the Kohn–Sham Hamiltonian in density functional theory (DFT) via machine learning offers a promising pathway toward efficient electronic structure modeling. Existing models are typically trained by directly minimizing element-wise Hamiltonian matrix errors, yet a significant trainingapplication gap has been observed between Hamiltonian-space loss and errors in derived electronic properties, limiting their utility in practical applications. Noting that these properties are functions on the state space obtained by solving the Hamiltonian eigenvalue problem, this gap can be traced to a misalignment of the error metrics on the Hamiltonian space and its induced state space. The operator-tostate mapping is highly anisotropic, such that Hamiltonian errors of comparable numerical magnitude can induce markedly different downstream property errors. Motivated by the Hamiltonian–state variational duality rooted in Lieb’s convex formulation of DFT, we introduce Dual-Space Loss (DSLoss) to bridge this training–application gap. By leveraging error metrics in both spaces, DSLoss allows Hamiltonian optimization to account for errors in both the predicted operator and its induced state. Across molecular benchmarks, DSLoss consistently improves a broad range of derived properties over conventional element-wise supervision. On the challenging ∇2DFT benchmark, electron density and total energy errors are reduced by factors of 40 and 500, respectively, relative to the strongest competing method. The resulting model also extrapolates robustly to molecules containing up to twice as many heavy atoms as those encountered during training, achieving more than an order-of-magnitude lower errors for multiple properties and substantially outperforming direct density prediction models and endto-end property predictors. Moreover, the model enables stable molecular dynamics simulations with accurate energetics, forces, and vibrational dynamics. These results show that DSLoss addresses an unrecognized bottleneck limiting operator-prediction models across diverse downstream tasks, thereby advancing scalable and reliable electronic structure modeling.
items.authors: Yifei Wang, He Zhang, Xinran Wei, Jingwen Fu, Yongqiang Ma, Miao Kang
items.title_zh: 通过双空间监督缩小Kohn–Sham哈密顿量学习的训练-应用差距
items.summary_zh: 通过机器学习预测密度泛函理论（DFT）中的Kohn–Sham哈密顿量为高效电子结构建模提供了有希望的途径。现有模型通常通过直接最小化哈密顿矩阵的元素误差进行训练，但在哈密顿空间损失与衍生电子性质误差之间观察到显著的训练-应用差距，限制了其在实际应用中的效用。该差距源于哈密顿空间和其诱导状态空间的误差度量不一致。基于Lieb的DFT凸性公式，我们引入双空间损失（DSLoss）来缩小这一差距。DSLoss利用两个空间中的误差度量，使哈密顿优化能够考虑预测算符及其诱导状态的误差。在分子基准测试中，DSLoss在广泛的衍生性质上始终优于传统的元素级监督。在具有挑战性的∇2DFT基准测试中，电子密度和总能量的表现得到了显著改善。

items.title: A Unified Theory for Generalized Step-Growth Polymerization: From Flory’s Equal‑Reactivity to Kinetic Symmetry‑Breaking
items.abstract: For nearly nine decades, Flory’s equal-reactivity hypothesis has universally underpinned the statistics of step-growth polymerization. However, modern monomers featuring rigid fused-ring architectures or catalytic bond-forming mechanisms routinely violate this core assumption. Consequently, the resulting molecular-weight anomalies have long been erroneously misattributed to side reactions or impurities, obscuring the underlying kinetic reality. Here, we resolve this theoretical blind spot by generalizing the AA + BB polycondensation into a strict analytical framework encompassing a kinetic enhancement parameter (𝛼). By exactly solving the infinitely coupled kinetic network, we derive closed-form expressions for the entire parameter space of stoichiometry (𝑟) and kinetics (𝛼), unveiling three macroscopic laws. First, a Terminal Dichotomy: on the A-deficient side (𝑟 1), the reaction undergoes "kinetic freezing," permanently archiving the kinetic 𝛼 -fingerprint within the end-cap inventory; conversely, on the A-excess side (𝑟 1 ), the system exhibits "𝛼 -amnesia," where terminal states are dictated solely by stoichiometry. Second, at the equimolar critical point (𝑟 = 1), the dispersity exhibits a profound singularity with non-commuting limits. Third, a Moving-Target Mechanism: while chain length grows monotonically with the feed ratio at fixed conversion, the optimal stoichiometry at a fixed reaction time migrates dynamically with 𝛼, allowing fast-asymmetric systems to achieve molecular weights nearly an order of magnitude higher than classical equimolar yields. Ultimately, this framework identifies a falsifiable end-group signature to reverse-engineer 𝛼 , transforming long-standing polycondensation anomalies into predictable, mathematically rigorously controllable levers for macromolecular design.
items.authors: Qingquan Tang
items.title_zh: 统一理论揭示广义步增长聚合反应的动力学特征
items.summary_zh: 近九十年来，Flory的等反应性假说普遍支撑了步增长聚合的统计学。然而，现代刚性融合环结构或催化成键机制的单体常常违反这一核心假设，导致分子量异常长期被错误归因于副反应或杂质。本文通过将AA + BB聚缩合推广至包含动力学增强参数（𝛼）的严格分析框架，解决了这一理论盲点。我们精确求解了无限耦合的动力学网络，推导出化学计量比（𝑟）和动力学（𝛼）整个参数空间的封闭形式表达式，揭示了三条宏观规律：首先，终端二分法；其次，在等摩尔临界点（𝑟 = 1）处，分散度表现出深刻的奇点；最后，移动目标机制。

items.title: Revealing the Deactivation Mechanism of Aconitase at the Atomistic Level by Multiscale Simulations
items.abstract: Mitochondrial aconitase is a key enzyme of the citric acid cycle that converts citrate to isocitrate at its [4 Fe−4 S] cluster cofactor. It is widely conserved across vertebrates and also found in numerous other organisms. Oxidation of the [4 Fe−4 S] cluster by reactive oxygen and nitrogen species (ROS/RNS) leads to the release of one Fe center, denoted as Fe α . The remaining [3 Fe−4 S] cluster is catalytically inactive, meaning aconitase oxidation leads to enzyme deactivation. Aconitase deactivation regulates the citric acid cycle and mitochondrial respiration, which leads to decreased ROS and RNS formation. Thus, aconitase serves as a redox sensor that prevents high ROS and RNS concentrations. The deactivation process is well characterized on the macroscopic scale, meaning that the deactivation kinetics and the thermodynamics of oxidation are known.
items.authors: Michael Stier, Kristyna Pluhackova, Johannes Kästner

items.title: Influence of exchange–correlation functional on machine-learnt interatomic potentials accuracy: a systematic study in borosilicate glasses
items.abstract: Machine-learnt interatomic potential (MLIP) has emerged as a strategy to accelerate molecular simulations, offering the promise of quantum chemical accuracy at a cost close to that of classical force fields. They are commonly trained on reference data obtained at the DFT level, which is itself a sufficiently affordable method to generate thousands of configurations and associated energies and atomic forces. However, this approach suffers from an elephant in the room, which is rarely addressed: the choice of exchange–correlation functional. Although it is understood to have a crucial impact on the accuracy of the description of interactions and therefore on the results of the molecular simulations, it has not been systematically evaluated in the past. To go beyond simple benchmarks on selected configurations, we set out to understand the influence of exchange–correlation (XC) functional on the training of MLIPs, and more importantly on the physical properties of the resulting condensed matter systems. As a complex chemical system to test this, we selected borosilicate glasses of a wide variety of compositions. We produced reference data sets of borosilicate glasses with nine different chemical compositions, with five different XC functionals at the GGA, meta-GGA and hybrid levels. We then trained MLIPs for all of them, produced glasses by melt-quenching, and compared their physical and structural properties with available experimental data. We show that there are significant differences between the different functionals. While the influence on bulk properties such as glass densities is minor, fine structural properties are more sensitive to the choice of functional, in particular when it comes to the coordination of boron atoms. Our results show how MLIPs can help us better understand the strengths and weaknesses of DFT functionals, where investigation through direct ab initio molecular dynamics was too expensive in the past. It also highlights that MLIPs depend on the ground truth on which they are trained, a fact often overlooked in practice, and this influence may be drastic on specific physical properties.
items.authors: Fengming Shi, Luca Brugnoli, François-Xavier Coudert
items.title_zh: 交换-相关泛函对机器学习原子势准确性的影响研究
items.summary_zh: 机器学习原子势（MLIP）作为加速分子模拟的一种策略，能够在接近经典力场的成本下提供量子化学的准确性。通常，MLIP是在密度泛函理论（DFT）水平上获得的参考数据上训练的。然而，选择交换-相关泛函对相互作用描述的准确性有重要影响，但过去并未系统评估。为此，我们研究了交换-相关（XC）泛函对MLIP训练及其生成的凝聚态物质系统物理性质的影响。我们选择了多种成分的硼硅酸盐玻璃作为测试对象，生成了九种不同化学成分的参考数据集，并使用五种不同的XC泛函（GGA、meta-GGA和混合型）进行训练。通过熔融淬火制备玻璃，并比较其物理性质。

items.title: (N-Hydroxy)amide-Mediated Ligation of Peptides in Chemical Protein Synthesis
items.abstract: Chemical protein synthesis enables the production of synthetic proteins with precisely controlled structures. Some chemoselective methods for ligation of peptides in water have been developed thus far, and a variety of target proteins were successfully prepared, in which some specific amino acids such as N-terminal Cys, Ser/Thr or surrogates containing different auxiliaries are usually required at the ligation sites. Therefore, it is highly desirable to develop a chemoselective peptide ligation that is not limited by the specific amino acids at the ligation sites for chemical protein synthesis. In this paper, we have developed an efficient chemoselective ligation between C-terminal peptidyl (N-methoxy)aminoacyl hydrazides and N-terminal aminoacyl (N-hydroxy)peptides in water. In this protocol, nitrite oxidation of our prepared C-terminal peptidyl (N-methoxy)aminoacyl hydrazides at pH 3.0 at-15 oC afforded the corresponding peptidyl (N-methoxy)aminoacyl azides, intermolecular N,O-exchange of the in-situ formed peptide (N-methoxy)aminoacyl azides with N-terminal aminoacyl (N-hydroxy)peptides at pH 8.0 at room temperature afforded O-acyl peptides, and intramolecular O,N-acyl transfer of the O-acyl peptides across a six-membered ring gave the corresponding ligated N-methoxy (N'-hydoxy)peptides. Reduction of the N-methoxy (N'-hydoxy)peptides with zinc in water (pH 3.0) at 37 oC produced the ligated long peptides with native amide bonds. This peptide ligation strategy was successfully used in the total synthesis of a long peptide and a protein with biological activities. Interestingly, introduction of the N-methoxy group in C-terminal peptidyl (N-methoxy)aminoacyl hydrazides inhibited epimerization of the (N-methoxy)amino acid residues during the ligation of peptides. The present peptide ligation shows some advantages including no requirement for specific amino acid residues at the ligation sites, rapid ligation (completion within 60 minutes) even at the sterically hindered junctions, almost no epimerization, high yields and avoiding use of thiophenols that are prone to oxidation and have a foul smell in the native chemical ligation. Therefore, this (N-hydroxy)amide-mediated ligation of peptides provides a novel, efficient and versatile strategy for chemical protein synthesis.
items.authors: Weifeng Wang, Yue Zhang, Haijun Yang, Hua Fu
items.title_zh: (N-羟基)酰胺介导的肽在化学蛋白合成中的连接
items.summary_zh: 化学蛋白合成能够生产具有精确控制结构的合成蛋白。本文开发了一种高效的化学选择性连接方法，适用于C-末端(N-甲氧基)氨基酰肼与N-末端氨基酰(N-羟基)肽在水中的反应。在pH 3.0、-15°C条件下，对C-末端(N-甲氧基)氨基酰肼进行亚硝酸盐氧化，生成相应的(N-甲氧基)氨基酰叠氮化物；在pH 8.0、室温下，与N-末端氨基酰(N-羟基)肽发生分子间N,O-交换，生成O-酰肽；随后，O-酰肽通过六元环的分子内O,N-酰转移反应，得到相应的连接(N-甲氧基)(N'-羟基)肽。最后，在37°C、pH 3.0的水中用锌还原(N-甲氧基)(N'-羟基)肽。

items.title: Tweaking the Water Rigidity at Noble Metal Interfaces for Enhanced Alkaline Hydrogen Production via myo-Inositol Coating - A Bioinspired Approach
items.abstract: Can an insulating sugar molecule help in water electrolysis? A unique cyclic polyhydroxy sugar myo-Inositol (MI) is used here to modify the oxide-free noble metal surfaces leading to enhanced electrocatalytic hydrogen evolution reaction (HER) efficacy in alkaline medium. This non-permanent surface coating approach makes the HER activity of platinum in alkaline medium on par with that in acidic medium. This HER enhancement effect of MI is also demonstrated on another metal electrode, gold. A monolayer adsorption of MI on Au and Pt is verified with quartz crystal microbalance assisted studies. The presence of MI at the metal surface introduces weakly hydrogen bonded water molecules at the electrode-electrolyte interface by disrupting the hydrogen bonding network, as proven by the operando surface enhanced infrared spectroscopy studies. This approach highlights the unique role of MI in HER and effectively mitigates the kinetic limitations of alkaline water electrolysis.
items.authors: Nandita Mohandas, Alex Joseph, Anusha P. P., Rashmi S. Jha, KM. Archana Yadav, Ritesh Haldar
items.title_zh: 通过肌醇涂层调节贵金属界面的水刚性以增强碱性氢气生产
items.summary_zh: 本研究探讨了一种绝缘糖分子肌醇（MI）在水电解中的应用。通过在无氧化层的贵金属表面修饰MI，显著提高了碱性介质中电催化氢气演化反应（HER）的效率。该非永久性表面涂层使铂在碱性介质中的HER活性与酸性介质相当。此外，MI在金电极上的HER增强效果也得到了验证。通过石英晶体微天平辅助研究，确认了MI在金和铂上的单层吸附。MI的存在通过破坏氢键网络，引入了弱氢键结合的水分子，改善了电极-电解质界面的性能，相关结果通过原位表面增强红外光谱学研究得以证明。这一方法突显了MI在HER中的独特作用，有效缓解了碱性水电解的动力学限制。

items.title: Collective vibrational strong coupling triggers dissociation reaction by overcoming energy threshold
items.abstract: Ground-state reactions under vibrational strong coupling (VSC) have emerged as one of the central topics in polariton chemistry, yet how the energy redistribution under collective VSC translates into chemical reactivity remains an open question. Here we investigate vibrational predissociation in dilute ensembles of water trimers coupled to an optical cavity using full-dimensional cavity quasi-classical trajectory (cav-QCT) simulations with ab initio-quality potential-energy and dipole-moment surfaces. We demonstrate that collective VSC directly induces an otherwise energetically forbidden dissociation of the water trimer through cavity-mediated intermolecular VET. Remarkably, the enhancement of reactivity remains observable with increasing ensemble size despite reduced effective single-molecule light–matter coupling strength. Trajectory analyses identify collective energy transfer as the microscopic mechanism and reveal largely consistent quantum-state distributions of the reaction products. These findings establish a microscopic link between collective polaritonic energy transport and chemical reactivity, and suggest collective VSC as a route toward simultaneously manipulating reactivity and preserving product-state selectivity.
items.authors: Mingliang Ding, Ruitao Ma, Dianfang Chen, Yongchang Han, Dong H. Zhang, Qi Yu
items.title_zh: 集体振动强耦合克服能量阈值触发解离反应
items.summary_zh: 在振动强耦合（VSC）下的基态反应已成为极化子化学的核心议题之一，但集体VSC下的能量重分配如何转化为化学反应性仍然是一个未解之谜。本文研究了与光学腔耦合的稀水三聚体的振动前解离，采用全维腔准经典轨迹（cav-QCT）模拟，结合从头算质量的势能和偶极矩面。我们证明集体VSC通过腔介导的分子间能量转移（VET）直接诱导水三聚体的解离，尽管有效的单分子光-物质耦合强度降低，反应性增强仍可随着集合体规模的增加而观察到。轨迹分析表明集体能量转移是微观机制，并揭示了反应产物的量子态分布基本一致。这些发现建立了集体极化子能量传输与化学反应性之间的微观联系，并提出集体VSC作为同时操控反应性和保持产物状态选择性的途径。

items.title: A Congener-Substitution Strategy for Docking Heavy Metal Protein-Ligand Complexes with AutoDock Vina
items.abstract: Molecular docking is widely used to predict ligand-protein interactions, but its application to transition metal complexes, particularly those containing second- and third-row elements, remains limited by the lack of explicit metal parameterization in commonly used programs such as AutoDock Vina. Here, we present a simple, practical strategy for docking heavy transition metal complexes without reparameterization: substituting the metal center with its first-row congener (e.g. Ru → Fe; Ir → Co) prior to docking. We applied this approach to a dataset of approximately 60 crystallographically characterized protein-ligand complexes containing Re, Ru, Os, Rh, Ir, Pt and Pd, and then focused on a streptavidin/avidin-biotin validation set of 18 crystallographically characterized protein-ligand complexes (4 Ru, 14 Ir) retrieved from the Protein Data Bank. The experimentally observed binding pose on the full set (rigid docking) was reproduced in 66% of cases, while for the streptavidin/avidin-biotin systems (flexible docking) the crystallography pose was fully or partially reproduced in 60% of cases (3/4 for the Ru systems and 8/14 for the Ir systems). Despite this outcome heterogeneity, the coordination geometry of the metal center and the broader protein-ligand interaction fingerprint were well preserved across the docked complexes, with a smaller perturbation observed for the Ru/Fe pair than for the Ir/Co pair, consistent with the higher pose-recovery rate obtained for the Ru systems. Overall, these results indicate that congener substitution offers a rapid, accessible route to docking second- and third-row transition metal complexes with unmodified AutoDock Vina, particularly in rigid docking, while revealing possible metal- and system-dependent limitations that should be considered when extending the strategy to other systems.
items.authors: Miroslava Nedyalkova, Simone Bernardotto, Fabio Zobi
items.title_zh: 重金属蛋白-配体复合物的同系物替代对接策略
items.summary_zh: 分子对接广泛用于预测配体-蛋白质相互作用，但在过渡金属复合物，尤其是含有第二和第三周期元素的复合物中，其应用受到缺乏明确金属参数化的限制。本文提出了一种简单实用的重金属过渡金属复合物对接策略：在对接前用其第一周期同系物替代金属中心（如Ru替换为Fe，Ir替换为Co）。我们将此方法应用于约60个含Re、Ru、Os、Rh、Ir、Pt和Pd的蛋白-配体复合物数据集，并重点分析了从蛋白质数据银行获取的18个结晶特征的streptavidin/avidin-biotin复合物（4个Ru，14个Ir）。在全数据集（刚性对接）中，实验观察到的结合构象在66%的情况下得以重现，而在streptavidin/avidin-biotin系统（柔性对接）中，结晶构象在60%的情况下完全或部分重现（Ru系统为3/4，Ir系统为8/14）。尽管结果存在异质性，但金属中心的配位几何和更广泛的蛋白-配体相互作用指纹在对接复合物中得到了良好保留。

items.title: Operational insights from the front lines of OpenADMET: lessons from our blind challenges
items.abstract: The gap between reported machine learning (ML) model performance in drug discovery and the experience of using these models in live discovery projects remains a major hurdle for the field, because the retrospective nature of most benchmarks makes it difficult to objectively assess progress. To address this gap, OpenADMET has hosted a series of blind challenges to benchmark and advance predictive modeling in absorption, distribution, metabolism, excretion, and toxicity (ADMET). In this Perspective, we distill the operational, strategic, and community-level lessons from our first four blind challenges, providing a practical blueprint for designing and running collaborative machine learning competitions in the life sciences. In addition, we open-source our blind challenge infrastructure and data-validation tools to lower the barrier to entry for hosting rigorous, community-driven competitions and to foster a sustainable framework for collective learning in computer-aided drug discovery.
items.authors: Hugo MacDermott-Opeskin, Maria Castellanos, Jonathan A. Swain, Jenke Scheen, Sean Colby, Georgia Channing

items.title: Symmetric versus asymmetric electron transfer in symmetric molecules
items.abstract: Photoinduced electron transfer (ET) in symmetric donor-acceptor-donor (D-A-D) or acceptor-donor-acceptor (A-D-A) molecules attracts attention due to applications in advanced materials. It is normally assumed that ET occurs asymmetrically, from one donor to acceptor, thus breaking molecular symmetry and resulting in a dipole moment in the excited state. However, the symmetry can be preserved with symmetric ET from both donors, leading to a nondipolar state with a high quadrupole moment. Here we report on symmetric ET in a D-A-D probe, 5,5'-di(9H-carbazol-9-yl)-2,2'-bipyridine. This probe is weakly solvatochromic in absorption, but highly solvatochromic in emission, revealing a nonlinear spectral shift and strong decay of the oscillator strength in solvents of increasing polarity. We develope a 3-excited-state model that fits the data quite well for symmetric ET, while no reasonable fit is possible for asymmetric ET. The model predicts the symmetric ET to be barrierless and ultrafast, in good agreement with observations.
items.authors: Aswin Jyothilakshmi Ravi, Ilya N. Ioffe, Samuel Palato, Christoph Merschjann, Lucia Anghileri, Florian Ortis

items.title: Multivalent SO4-3-Galactose Glycopolymers Define a Structural Threshold for CD206 Endocytic Inhibition
items.abstract: The Mannose Receptor (CD206) is a critical endocytic receptor involved in immune regulation and various pathologies, yet it remains largely unexplored as a therapeutic target due to the lack of specific modulators. We recently reported that multivalent SO 4 -3-Galactose (SO 4 -3-Gal) glycopolymers inhibit CD206 by blocking its recycling to the cell surface, but the role of ligand valency in this process was undefined. Here, using a monovalent SO4-3-Gal ligand together with a library of SO 4 -3-Gal glycopolymers spanning valencies from 6.5 to 211 – the latter synthesised via a new, scalable, metal-free aqueous RAFT route amenable to multigram production – we establish for the first time a quantitative, biphasic relationship between valency and CD206 inhibitory potency, with a steep increase up to a valency of ~28 SO 4 -3-Gal units followed by a shallower plateau, which may suggest a threshold-dependent, ligandinduced receptor clustering mechanism. Critically, these glycopolymers are non-cytotoxic, leave LPS-induced macrophage cytokine production (IL-6, IL-10, TNF-α) unaltered, and – as shown by bulk RNA sequencing of human macrophages – induce no detectable changes to the macrophage transcriptome, at baseline or upon LPS stimulation, demonstrating that CD206 blockade occurs without detectable perturbation of macrophage inflammatory responses or transcriptional profiles under the conditions tested.
items.authors: Francesca Mastrotto, Greta Bellio, Alexandre Blanchard, Gokhan Yilmaz, Sirina Muntaka, Enrico Gaffo

items.title: Size-Dependent Conductivity of MOF Nanoparticles with Variable-Pressure Impedance Spectroscopy
items.abstract: Variable-pressure conductivity has attracted growing interest in recent years due to the importance of activation volumes for ion transport in energy storage systems like solid state batteries, solid oxide fuel cells and solid oxide electrolyzers. Most variable-pressure conductivity studies have overlooked the effect of particle size and size distributions even though they impact key determinants of charge transport: particle packing, interatomic distances, and lattice strain. Here, we utilize chromium(1,2,3-triazolate)2 nanoparticles as a model system to elucidate particle size effects on variable pressure conductivity. These materials lack deliberate surface capping ligands that would otherwise complicate analysis. Using impedance spectroscopy, we find significant size dependence in the variable pressure conductivity. A combination of strain analysis, density functional theory calculations, and particle packing simulations suggests the major cause of the size dependence is greater surface reactivity in smaller particles, which leads to a greater degree of particle fusion at lower pressures. These results hold practical importance for pressedpellet conductivity measurements of all powder materials in general.
items.authors: Jonathan L. Rowell, Parker Brodale, Nathaniel Skeele, Alexander C. Vastano, Matthias T. Agne, Christopher H. Hendon

items.title: Optimization of Bimetallic Catalysts for the Hydrogenation of Liquid Organic Hydrogen Carriers using Contaminated Hydrogen Gas
items.abstract: Liquid organic hydrogen carriers enable safe storage of H2 at high densities, but scalable application is impeded by the tolerance towards impurities common in industrial H2 streams, notably CO that poisons noble metals. In this work, we investigated synergistic effects in Pd-, Ru-, and Ni-based catalysts on Al2O3 for benzyltoluene hydrogenation under pure H2 and COcontaminated feeds representative of realistic operation. By enforcing identical metal loadings, dispersion, and mesoporosity across a series of mono- and bimetallic samples, intrinsic metalmetal effects were isolated. XPS reveals a more electron-rich Ni surface phase in the bimetallics, with Ru exerting a stronger influence on the electronic state of Ni than Pd. Catalytic activity of the samples in the presence of CO follows Pd–Ni Ni ≳ Ru–Ni Pd ≈ Ru. Ni is essential to retain activity under CO, while monometallic Pd and Ru are strongly poisoned. This is due to Nidriven CO methanation which initiates near 525 K on bimetallics. In case of the best-performing Pd–Ni/Al2O3 catalyst, operando DRIFTS identifies isolated Pd sites embedded in Ni that reversibly segregate/redisperse under CO/H2, forming transient Pd2/Pd3 ensembles. Overall, this work shows that selective incorporation of low noble metal contents into Ni is a viable strategy to produce robust, CO-tolerant, and economically attractive catalyst for benzyltoluene hydrogenation under impure hydrogen.
items.authors: Kevin Alconada, Yaoci Sheng, Lukas Popp, Adrian Seitz, Felix Lott, Felix Herold

items.title: Comparing Symmetry-Adapted Perturbation Theory to Intermolecular Energy Decomposition Analysis Based on Absolutely Localized Molecular Orbitals
items.authors: Narayanan Puthillathu, Montgomery Gray, John M. Herbert

items.title: Aminomutase-Inspired Methylene Insertion for α-to-β Homologative Transposition of Amino Acids
items.abstract: A versatile method for the preparation of synthetically valuable β2-homologated amino acid esters from simple α-amino acid esters is described. Inspired by pyridoxal 5′-phosphate-dependent aminomutase enzymes, the described strategy exploits a straightforward protocol for substrate activation, alkylation, and migration leveraging a bio-inspired 3-exo-trig radical cascade. This approach enables a novel homologative strategy towards β-amino acids via methylene insertion into the Cα–N bond of α-amino acids. A broad substrate scope is demonstrated, and key activator electronic factors are elucidated through experimental and computational mechanistic studies. By engaging α-amino acids directly, the method provides unique access to β2-homologated amino acids.
items.authors: Ayah W. Fidama, Vincent Huang, Yetong Lin, Jaclyn N. Mauro, Ethan T. A. Raffman, Jialin Li

items.title: Examining roles of varying synthesis and assembly conditions on the incorporation of complex multi-lipid extracts into membrane scaffold protein nanodiscs
items.abstract: Nanodiscs are tunable and widely used membrane mimetics that can allow for the in vitro study of membrane proteins in a native-like lipid bilayer environment. The lipids incorporated into nanodiscs can be modulated to represent specific biophysical environments, but many nanodisc applications rely on simplified lipid compositions that inadequately represent native membrane complexity. Natural lipid extracts offer more physiological relevance; however, recent work has shown that (1) lipid composition of a nanodisc does not stoichiometrically reflect the initial mixture and that (2) assembly conditions such as temperature and belt size may influence lipid incorporation. Here, we add to this body of work by implementing an untargeted LC-MS/MS lipidomics workflow to profile the incorporation of multiple, combined natural lipid extracts into membrane scaffold protein nanodiscs, examining not only assembly temperature and belt size, but also the effects of detergent and synthetic lipid additives on lipid incorporation. Species level lipidomic analysis, including trends in acyl chain length and degree of unsaturation were evaluated. We observe that assembly temperatures have minimal impact on lipid incorporation, whereas belt size effects vary across extracts, as smaller scaffolds likely enrich lipids that promote a more tightly packed membrane. Furthermore, we found that lipid solubilization and incorporation into nanodiscs is broadly preserved regardless of detergent identity. Conversely, synthetic lipid additives influence incorporated lipid class composition more strongly than detergent, temperature, or MSP belt size, with unsaturated additives favoring glycerolipid enrichment. Taken together, this data demonstrates the interplay of nanodisc assembly conditions in shaping the incorporated lipid environment.
items.authors: Marina C. Sarcinella, Anusha Vajrala, Samantha A. Edgcombe, Joshua D. Jones, Brady G. Anderson, Charles R. Evans

items.title: CRISPR-Enabled Transition to Adsorption-Coupled Redox Transport: Toward the Use of Conventional Voltammetry in Electrochemical Biosensors
items.abstract: Electrochemical aptamer-based (E-AB) biosensors and clustered regularly interspaced short palindromic repeats (CRISPR) systems have independently advanced molecular diagnostics; however, their integration is less explored. Here, we present a CRISPR-enabled electrochemical sensing platform that directly links CRISPR Cas12a-mediated cleavage of non-specific aptamers to a change of charge transfer at the electrode interface. Methylene blue (MB)-labeled aptamers are immobilized on a gold electrode, forming an electrochemically surface-confined system. Upon target-activated CRISPR cleavage, MB-labeled aptamers are released into the medium, transforming the system into a diffusion-controlled regime. This transition is directly captured through real-time electrochemical monitoring, where alternating current voltammetry reveals a progressive decrease in surface-bound redox reporters, while cyclic voltammetry simultaneously shows an increase in faradaic current due to the accumulation of freely diffusing MB species. Scan rate-dependent analysis confirms a shift from non-ideal surface-limited behavior to diffusion-controlled kinetics, consistent with the Randles–Ševčík relationship. We propose an adsorption-coupled transport model, which supports this interpretation by showing that the plausible post-cleavage voltammetric response is best described by near-surface confinement of released MB-tagged fragments rather than by pure bulk diffusion alone. Dose-response analysis shows that cyclic voltammetry achieves a improved limit of detection (LOD) of approximately , outperforming square wave voltammetry ( across a broader – range), underscoring CV as the more sensitive readout for quantitative biosensing with this platform. By leveraging the exceptional molecular specificity of CRISPR alongside the high sensitivity of E-AB sensors, this work establishes a new sensing paradigm in which conventional steady-state voltammetry can be used for analytical detection.
items.authors: Pouya Soltan Khamsi, Aida Ebrahimi

items.title: Quantum Subspace Expansion for Molecular Excited States: Representability, Stability, and Practical Considerations
items.abstract: Accurate treatment of excited states remains challenging for classical electronic-structure methods, motivating quantum algorithms that may provide more favorable resource scaling. We systematically assess the practical performance of Quantum Subspace Expansion (QSE) for low-lying electronic states across 28 organic molecules from the Thiel benchmark set. Statevector simulations reveal that QSE representability depends strongly on the target state, active space, and molecular electronic structure, with multiconfigurational character emerging as an important factor. In several cases, the one-body QSE subspace cannot adequately represent the target states, while explicit double-excitation operators improve representability at the cost of a larger operator space. Analysis of the QSE overlap matrix shows that although eigenmodes with small eigenvalues drive numerical instability, they cannot be discarded indiscriminately without compromising spectral accuracy. Under finite-shot sampling, energy errors exhibit an empirical scaling of approximately n2 orb/ √ Nshots, which, combined with the growth in measurement groups, yields a total measurement cost of approximately O(n11 orb) for constant accuracy under our direct-estimation protocol. These results expose a central tension between representability, numerical stability, and measurement cost. Encouragingly, we find that the projected matrices exhibit recurring structural patterns, while the finite-shot perturbations in the Hamiltonian and overlap matrices show nontrivial covariance, suggesting opportunities for more efficient structure-aware measurement and reconstruction strategies. Overall, our results provide an assessment of QSE across chemically-relevant organic molecules, identifying present limitations while highlighting potential routes toward more practical future implementations.
items.authors: Naythan Z. X. Yeo, Shi Jun Ang

items.title: Uncovering Chemical Degradation Pathways in Amide-Functional Sulfur Polymers for Room-Temperature Na-S Batteries
items.abstract: Sulfur-containing polymers are widely explored as cathode active materials for room-temperature sodium sulfur batteries because covalent sulfur confinement is generally considered to suppress polysulfide dissolution. However, their chemical stability under cycling remains insufficiently understood. Inverse vulcanization provides an attractive route to sulfur-rich cathode active materials by directly coupling elemental sulfur with unsaturated organic comonomers, thereby combining high sulfur content with tunable chemical functionality. In this study, an amide-rich sulfur material ( P1 ) was synthesized by the inverse vulcanization of elemental sulfur with N,N′ -ethylenebisacrylamide (EBA) and systematically evaluated as the positive electrode in sodium metal cells using an ether-based electrolyte (1 M NaCF 3 SO 3 in TEGDME) to elucidate its degradation pathways. The bifunctional acrylamide co-monomer provides two reactive C=C sites for sulfur incorporation while retaining polar amide environments within the resulting sulfur-rich network. Although P1 initially exhibits sulfur redox activity (initial discharge capacity is approximately 90 mAh g -1 at 500 mAh g -1 ), the electrochemical performance rapidly declines, resulting in rapid capacity decay and low coulombic efficiency. Post-mortem XPS analysis reveals pronounced changes in the S-S and C-S bonding environments, formation of oxidized sulfur species, and substantial irreversible reconstruction of both the carbon-sulfur framework and nitrogen coordination environments. We propose that this degradation is associated with chemical interactions between nucleophilic polysulfide intermediates and reactive amide-containing environments, promoting irreversible sulfur-carbon/nitrogen bond rearrangements. The observed XPS evolution is consistent with the formation of thioamide-like and C-S/N-S environments, although these assignments are treated as part of a proposed degradation pathway rather than a uniquely established reaction mechanism. While these reactions chemically immobilize sulfur, they render it electrochemically inactive. Thus, polysulfide interactions that are initially intended to provide chemical confinement may evolve into irreversible chemical trapping during cycling. These findings identify a critical chemical instability pathway in functional inverse-vulcanized sulfurrich materials in Na-S systems and highlight the need to control balance polysulfide affinity with the chemical stability of co-monomer-derived functionalities for stable sulfur-polymer cathodes.
items.authors: Liwen Yang, Bercis Pektas, Samar Hajjar-Garreau, Angelina Sarapulova, Hatice Mutlu, Sonia Dsoke

items.title: Defect-Rich Fe3+-Substituted RuO2: A Novel Rutile Phase Setting a New Benchmark in Alkaline Water Oxidation
items.abstract: We report a new material exhibiting outstanding oxygen evolution reaction (OER) performance in alkaline media, delivering an ultralow overpotential of 86 mV at 100 mA cm -2 , sustained operation above 200 mA·cm -2 , and exceptional long-term stability over 1000 hours without noticeable degradation.
